paper.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
paper.abstract: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个闭环 benchmark，评测前沿 coding agent 在固定算力预算下能否自主改进 world model 研究代码，而不是只完成预先写死的工程任务。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测资产与协议设计。它把 agent 评测从“按 spec 修代码”推进到“在开放研究方向中做迭代改进”，对研究型 agent 和自动化实验循环有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoWorldModel-Bench：提供统一 starter、固定 compute budget、八个游戏环境和统一 structured-state 表示，刻意剥离感知问题，只保留动力学建模与训练目标选择。这样可以让 agent 在分钟级迭代中修改模型、损失或训练流程，并以闭环结果计分。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 64 个 session，Codex-5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.6 在 63 个 session 中改进了 starter，91% 的获胜编辑不是简单调参而是非平凡研究改动。未见更细的统计显著性、方差分解和与人类研究者对照信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a closed-loop benchmark to test whether frontier coding agents can autonomously improve world-model research code under a fixed compute budget, rather than merely completing spec-defined engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. It pushes agent evaluation from 'implement the requested patch' toward 'iterate on an open research direction,' which is relevant for research agents and automated experimentation loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoWorldModel-Bench provides a common starter, fixed compute budget, eight game environments, and a unified structured-state representation. By removing perception and isolating dynamics modeling, it lets agents iterate quickly on architectures, losses, and training choices in a closed loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 64 sessions where Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improved the starter in 63 sessions, with 91% of winning edits being non-trivial research changes rather than mere hyperparameter tuning. The abstract does not expose deeper variance analysis or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 评测想法比结果更值钱：它把 research agent 测试从 SWE 式修补转到开放式实验循环；只看 benchmark 设计和 state abstraction，模型排名先别太当真。
recommendation.en: The benchmark design matters more than the leaderboard: it shifts research-agent evaluation from SWE-style patching to open-ended experimental iteration; read the protocol and state abstraction, not the rankings.

paper.title: Foresight Without Seeing: Latent Futures for World Action Models
paper.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple future visual prediction with robot action generation, enabling policies to model how the physical world evolves during interaction. Existing WAMs differ in how predictive dynamics are exposed to the action pathway. Explicit-future WAMs provide direct access to predicted scene evolution, but incur substantial inference costs from iterative video denoising. In contrast, direct-policy WAMs efficiently predict actions from the current observation but lack an explic

summary.core_problem: 显式未来World Action Model推理成本高（迭代视频去噪），直接策略WAM缺乏将预测动态暴露给动作生成的接口
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM，不解码未来视频即可为动作生成提供预测上下文
summary.technical_approach: Future-KV对当前视觉latent和随机未来slot做单次Video DiT prefill，复用层KV状态贯穿动作去噪；引入dynamics registers监督预测动态
summary.experiments: 在机器人操作任务上验证，Future-KV单次prefill后复用KV状态，避免迭代视频去噪的高推理成本

summary_en.core_problem: Explicit-future World Action Models incur high inference cost from iterative video denoising, while direct-policy WAMs lack an interface to expose predictive dynamics to action generation
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: dynamics-conditioned direct-policy WAM that provides predictive context for action generation without decoding future videos
summary_en.technical_approach: Future-KV performs a single Video DiT prefill over current visual latent and stochastic future slots, reusing layer-wise KV states throughout action denoising; dynamics registers supervise predictive dynamics
summary_en.experiments: Validated on robot manipulation tasks; Future-KV reuses KV from a single prefill, avoiding the high inference cost of iterative video denoising

recommendation.zh: Future-KV单次prefill复用KV的思路对diffusion LM推理效率有迁移价值，但整体是机器人工作，看方法节即可
recommendation.en: The Future-KV single-prefill KV-reuse idea transfers to diffusion LM inference efficiency, but this is a robotics paper—read the method section only.

paper.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap

summary.core_problem: 现有 embodied world model 评测过度依赖视觉质量或任务成功率，无法直接判断 action-conditioned world model 是否真的具备可用的模拟器忠实度。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测协议与诊断基准，而不是新模型。对做统一 world model、视频预测、行动条件生成的研究员有参考价值，因为它把“看起来像”与“可作为规划模拟器”明确分开。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Observable Simulator Contract，要求一个物理模拟器至少满足两点：输入动作必须诱发对应的 agent 运动，环境响应必须以该已实现运动为条件。基于这个契约构建 WorldSimProbe，包含五组受控测试，覆盖局部控制敏感性、全局轨迹一致性等，用来诊断 ACWM 的 simulator faithfulness，而非只看 rollout 观感。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名单和数值，但可以确认评测对象是 embodied manipulation 中的 action-conditioned world models。实验重点不是 leaderboard，而是揭示现有模型即便视觉上合理、任务上可用，也可能在动作-状态因果一致性上失败。对比维度比常见视频生成评测更贴近 planning/data generation 的真实需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Current evaluations of embodied world models focus too much on visual quality or task success, and fail to directly test whether action-conditioned world models are faithful enough to function as simulators.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a new model. It is relevant to researchers working on unified world models, action-conditioned generation, or planning-oriented predictive models because it separates 'looks plausible' from 'works as a simulator.'
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Observable Simulator Contract: a physical simulator should at minimum ensure that supplied actions induce corresponding agent motion, and that environment responses are grounded in that realized motion. It then builds WorldSimProbe, a controlled diagnostic benchmark with five suites covering local control sensitivity, global trajectory consistency, and related aspects of simulator faithfulness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list exact models or numbers, but the targets are action-conditioned world models for embodied manipulation. The key point is diagnostic: models that look visually plausible or support task-level success may still fail on action-state causal consistency, which standard rollout metrics often miss.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但把 world model 评测口径掰正了：若你关心 action-conditioned generation，先看它怎么定义 simulator contract，再决定该信哪些结果。
recommendation.en: It does not improve models, but it fixes the evaluation lens: if you care about action-conditioned generation, read how it defines simulator faithfulness before trusting flashy rollout results.

paper.title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
paper.abstract: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamic

summary.core_problem: 解决世界模型部署后在分布偏移下难以继续利用自监督信号适配环境、但又不希望更新主模型参数的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作有一点基础模型味道：冻结主干、外接快速状态适配路径、同时做多模态预测与动作条件动态建模。它更接近 embodied/world model 研究，不是 LLM 预训练主线，但对“冻结基座 + 外部状态更新”这个接口有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpikeWorld，一个 1.45M 参数的稀疏脉冲世界模型，联合训练异构感知预测、语义、图文绑定和动作条件动态。部署时完全冻结参数，只通过两条外部路径适配：一条基于累计固定库损失选择有界动作修正，另一条用 route-specific residual matrices 改进下一状态预测；全程不依赖标签、奖励或教师信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出 1.45M 参数规模，并报告联合优化后动作下一状态 MSE 降低 17.10%，同时多模态预测、语义准确率和图文检索也有提升。实验重点是冻结模型后的在线适配，而不是大规模预训练、语言建模或 scaling 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how a deployed world model can keep using self-supervised signals under distribution shift without updating the frozen backbone parameters.
summary_en.importance: This has a mild foundation-model flavor: a frozen backbone with external fast-state adaptation, plus multimodal prediction and action-conditioned dynamics. It is closer to embodied/world-model research than core LLM pretraining, but the interface idea is somewhat relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpikeWorld is a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking world model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding, and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment all weights are frozen, and adaptation happens through two external paths: bounded action correction selected from cumulative fixed-bank losses, and route-specific residual matrices for next-state refinement, without labels, rewards, or teacher outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 1.45M model and a 17.10% reduction in action next-state MSE, along with gains in multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy, and image-text retrieval. The focus is online adaptation after training, not large-scale language pretraining or scaling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但“冻结主干、把适配写进外部状态”这个思路值得记；只看部署期更新机制，别被 spiking 包装带偏。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the idea of keeping the backbone frozen and pushing adaptation into external state is worth noting; read only the deployment-time update mechanism.

paper.title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
paper.abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidi

summary.core_problem: 流式世界模型在长时程 rollout 中常违反物理约束，且从双向 DiT 蒸馏到因果生成器时物理先验会进一步损失。
summary.importance: 数据贡献 + 方法改进：构建 120K 真实物理交互视频数据集 PhyS-120K，并提出三阶段物理先验蒸馏框架 PhyS。
summary.technical_approach: 三阶段框架：(1) 用 PhyS-120K 对双向 DiT 做物理感知 SFT 以获取物理先验；(2) 蒸馏为少步因果生成器；(3) 用结构化物体属性与因果状态转换描述做监督。
summary.experiments: 数据集 120K 视频，覆盖刚体、软体、流体、相变；未给出具体模型规模与定量提升数字。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 团队（Liangliang Zhao 等），Cohere 在多模态与世界模型方向有持续投入。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming world models often violate physical constraints over long rollouts, and physical priors are further lost when distilling bidirectional DiTs into causal generators.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + method improvement: PhyS-120K dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos, plus a three-stage physics-prior distillation framework PhyS.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-stage pipeline: (1) physics-aware SFT of a bidirectional DiT on PhyS-120K to acquire physical priors; (2) distillation into a few-step causal generator; (3) supervision via structured object-property and causal state-transition descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: 120K videos covering rigid-body, soft-body, fluid, and phase-transition dynamics; no explicit model size or quantitative improvement numbers provided.
summary_en.authors_note: Cohere team (Liangliang Zhao et al.); Cohere has ongoing investment in multimodal and world-model research.

recommendation.zh: 世界模型方向的物理先验蒸馏思路，对 LLM 预训练研究员主要价值在数据构建与蒸馏 recipe，看摘要和数据集描述即可。
recommendation.en: A physics-prior distillation recipe for world models; mainly useful for its data construction and distillation pipeline—skim the abstract and dataset section.

paper.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
paper.abstract: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not as

summary.core_problem: 解决现有多智能体世界模型训练与推理时智能体数量固定、无法扩展到任意群体规模的问题
summary.importance: 多智能体世界建模的架构范式创新，通过解耦世界状态演化与渲染实现推理时群体规模可扩展，对通用具身智能体预训练框架有参考价值
summary.technical_approach: 提出Khora框架，将共享世界状态演化与智能体特定渲染解耦，引入群体无关渲染接口，通过查询共享状态生成任意数量智能体的观测，无需重训练
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据与量化对比结果，仅说明支持推理时智能体数量扩展与跨视角一致性

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the fixed agent count limitation of existing multi-agent world models, which prevents scaling to arbitrary population sizes at inference without retraining
summary_en.importance: An architectural paradigm innovation for multi-agent world modeling that decouples state evolution from rendering to enable inference-time population scaling, with relevance to general embodied agent pretraining frameworks
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Khora, which decouples shared world-state evolution from agent-specific rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering interface that queries the shared state to generate observations for any number of agents without retraining
summary_en.experiments: Concrete model scale, training data, and quantitative comparison results are not disclosed in the abstract; only inference-time agent scalability and cross-view consistency are claimed

recommendation.zh: 世界模型解耦状态与渲染的思路对具身智能体预训练框架有弱参考，但实验披露不足，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The decoupled state-rendering design for world models offers weak reference for embodied agent pretraining, but experimental disclosure is insufficient; only skim the method section.

paper.title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role

summary.core_problem: 训练LLM Agent进行长程工具使用时，现有方法依赖外部可执行环境（构建和验证成本高）或独立的LLM模拟器（难以grounding），环境建模始终在行动策略之外，策略无法内化动作与环境响应之间的因果关系。
summary.importance: 提出了将世界模型内化进单一策略的world rehearsal机制，让策略在不依赖外部环境交互的条件下进行RL训练，降低了对昂贵环境基础设施的依赖。测试时的多次rehearsal也为推理前的内部推演提供了轻量方案。方法本身属于Agent后训练范畴，但"让模型自己扮演环境"的思路与统一建模范式存在关联，对思考预训练中模型如何内化世界动态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 单个策略同时承担actor和environment两个角色：每个交互轮次，策略先生成tool call，然后切换角色生成该tool call引发的环境响应（即world rehearsal），再基于这个自生成的响应决定下一步动作。整条trajectory由策略自身展开，而非与外部环境交互产生。两个角色通过task-success reward端到端联合优化。测试时可进行多次rehearsal尝试，在内部推演候选动作的结果后再选择实际执行。
summary.experiments: 在BFCL-v4、τ²-Bench、VitaBench、FinMCP-Bench四个Agent基准上一致优于强基线。消融实验显示：测试时适度的rehearsal预算（多次内部推演）能进一步提升性能；联合学习acting和rehearsal在不同模型规模上均有效，而非单独训练环境模型再与策略配合。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注world rehearsal的训练流程设计——acting和rehearsal如何交替展开、reward如何传播到两个角色，以及测试时rehearsal的具体实现。方法部分的POMDP形式化和实验部分的rehearsal次数消融是核心图表。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Training LLM agents for long-horizon tool use relies on external executable environments (costly to build and verify) or separate LLM simulators (difficult to ground), keeping environment dynamics external to the acting policy and preventing the policy from internalizing action-response relationships.
summary_en.importance: Introduces world rehearsal, a mechanism that absorbs the world model into a single policy, enabling RL training without external environment interaction and reducing dependence on expensive environment infrastructure. Test-time rehearsal provides a lightweight form of internal deliberation before action execution. While the method sits in post-training agent RL, the idea of a model playing both actor and environment resonates with unified modeling paradigms relevant to thinking about how pretrained models internalize world dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single policy alternates between two roles: at each turn, it first generates a tool call as the actor, then switches to produce the environment response induced by that call (world rehearsal), and conditions subsequent actions on this self-generated response. Full trajectories unfold from the policy itself rather than from external environment interaction. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. At test time, multiple rehearsal attempts can be run to internally simulate candidate action outcomes before selecting the actual action.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently outperforms strong baselines across BFCL-v4, τ²-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench. Ablations show that a moderate test-time rehearsal budget further improves performance, and that joint optimization of acting and rehearsal is effective across model scales, compared to training a separate environment model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the training procedure for world rehearsal—how acting and rehearsal interleave within a trajectory, how rewards propagate across both roles—and the test-time rehearsal mechanism. The POMDP formulation in the method section and the rehearsal-budget ablation in experiments are the key sections. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent RL训练的新范式，用自扮演环境替代外部交互，核心思路可迁移到推理模型RL训练，重点看§3方法设计
recommendation.en: Novel paradigm for agent RL training replacing external interaction with self-played environment; core idea transfers to reasoning model RL, focus on §3 method design.

paper.title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
paper.abstract: Reliable robot learning requires a world simulator that can predict action consequences before execution on physical hardware, including risky and failure-prone outcomes. Existing physics simulators require substantial asset construction and calibration and still face a sim-to-real gap, while video generators often lack precise control over their responses to fine-grained robot actions. In this paper, we present the Boundless World Model (BWM), an open-source, low-cost, high-fidelity world simul

summary.core_problem: 为机器人操作学习构建低成本、动作可控的视觉世界模拟器，用于预测执行动作后的未来观测。
summary.importance: 贡献是机器人场景中的 action-conditioned world model 和数据引擎。它与视频生成、世界模型、具身数据合成有关，但主要服务机器人学习，不是 LLM 基座训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: BWM 采用状态化自回归预测未来观测，结合 initial-environment guidance、动态视觉历史和时间对齐的 robot-action conditioning。训练数据通过 trajectory replay、overlapping clip sampling 和 initial-observation enhancement 构造 action-aligned clips。模型既可生成 imitation learning 的增强 rollout，也可用于 policy evaluation。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明 BWM 是开源、低成本、高保真的 world simulator，并用于 imitation-learning data augmentation 和 policy evaluation；给出的片段未包含模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Build a low-cost, action-controllable visual world simulator that predicts future observations for robot manipulation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an action-conditioned world model and data engine for robot learning. It is adjacent to video generation and embodied world modeling, but it is not a direct LLM pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: BWM performs stateful autoregressive prediction of future observations using initial-environment guidance, dynamic visual history, and temporally aligned robot-action conditioning. Action-aligned training clips are built with trajectory replay, overlapping clip sampling, and initial-observation enhancement. The model is used both for imitation-learning rollout augmentation and policy evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes BWM as an open-source, low-cost, high-fidelity simulator for robot manipulation and mentions use as a data engine and evaluation simulator. The provided text does not include model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 和 unified world model 有一点关系；只看动作条件注入和 clip 构造，机器人结果别直接迁移到 LLM 预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Mildly relevant to unified world models; skim the action-conditioning and clip-construction recipe, but do not transfer the robotics claims to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
paper.abstract: Although world-action models (WAMs) enhance long-horizon robot control by predicting visual evolution before acting, long-horizon reliability demands repeated re-grounding in real observations--not recursive rollout. Existing WAMs address this by refreshing history or KV cache with ground-truth data between chunks. However, such chunk-wise feedback operates at a coarse temporal granularity and thus fails to correct prediction errors at the individual time-step level. To address this, we propose

summary.core_problem: 现有世界动作模型的块级反馈时间粒度粗，无法在单步级别修正流匹配预测误差，长时域控制可靠性不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练无关的流匹配异步反馈机制，将重接地引入生成块内部。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FBFM，在流匹配过程中对条件速度场施加掩码伪逆修正：用前一个动作块引导下一个动作块生成，用前一动作执行后的真实观测图像引导下一帧预测，实现跨块细粒度反馈。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验配置、基线模型与量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing world-action models use coarse chunk-level feedback that cannot correct flow matching prediction errors at the individual time-step level, leading to insufficient long-horizon control reliability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation that proposes a training-free asynchronous feedback mechanism for flow matching, bringing re-grounding inside the actively generated chunk.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FBFM, which applies masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field during flow matching: uses the preceding action chunk to guide the next action chunk generation, and uses the real observed image after executing the preceding chunk to guide next frame prediction, achieving cross-chunk fine-grained feedback.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, baseline models, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 流匹配推理时细粒度反馈的思路可迁移到文本Flow LM，仅看速度场伪逆修正部分即可。
recommendation.en: The fine-grained inference-time feedback idea for flow matching is transferable to text flow LMs; only the velocity field pseudoinverse correction matters.

paper.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
paper.abstract: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (\textbf{PT-Flow}), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by

summary.core_problem: 现有的世界模型大多局限于离散时间预测，在捕捉物理世界连续动态方面效率低下。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于连续物理时间流的预测架构，为构建更高效、通用的连续时间潜在世界模型提供了新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow)，学习物理时间下的连续潜在速度场，用 ODE 参数化序列数据的潜在动态。基于此构建 ODEWorld，通过提取时变特征并在动态表示空间和潜在速度场上强制执行 ODE 属性，实现连续时间预测。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体实验细节，主要阐述架构设计。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学交叉信息研究院（IIIS）与上海期智研究院团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing world models are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, exhibiting inefficiency in capturing the continuous dynamics of the physical world.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a continuous predictive architecture based on physical-time flow, offering a new paradigm for building efficient and versatile continuous-time latent world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Physical-Time Flow (PT-Flow) to learn a continuous latent velocity field in physical time, parameterizing latent dynamics with an ODE. Builds ODEWorld upon this, achieving continuous-time prediction by extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the representation space and the velocity field.
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental details provided; focuses on architecture design.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by a team from the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS), Tsinghua University, and Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute.

recommendation.zh: 将连续时间 ODE 引入世界模型，对探索非离散 token 建模的预训练研究员有一定启发，可作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Introduces continuous-time ODEs to world models, offering some inspiration for pretraining researchers exploring non-discrete token modeling; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization
paper.abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWo

summary.core_problem: 潜在世界模型中EP损失对尾部样本梯度消失导致的重尾分布控制不足问题
summary.importance: 方法改进，提出QQ匹配目标替代EP用于潜在分布正则化，改善尾部梯度信号
summary.technical_approach: 用分位数-分位数匹配目标直接将投影潜在样本与秩匹配的高斯分位数对齐，维持尾部有效校正梯度；进一步提出跨批次QQ，用前批次分离样本扩大有效排序池，并分析其偏差-方差权衡
summary.experiments: 在4个控制环境中提升LeWM的平均规划成功率，同时保持计算开销可控

summary_en.core_problem: Insufficient heavy-tailed distribution control in latent world models caused by vanishing EP loss gradients for tail samples
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement proposing QQ matching objective to replace EP for latent distribution regularization, improving gradient signal in the tails
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses quantile-quantile matching objective to directly align projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails; further proposes cross-batch QQ that enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, with bias-variance trade-off analysis
summary_en.experiments: Improves average planning success rate of LeWM across 4 control environments while keeping computational overhead manageable

recommendation.zh: QQ匹配替代EP做分布正则化的思路对扩散模型/流匹配的潜在空间训练有一定参考，但与LLM预训练关联较弱，作为方法备查即可
recommendation.en: Replacing EP with QQ matching for distribution regularization has some relevance for latent space training in diffusion/flow matching models, but weak connection to LLM pretraining; keep as methodology reference.

paper.title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
paper.abstract: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the

summary.core_problem: 解决物理世界模型直接在像素空间预测未来视频、难以显式表示和推理世界状态转移的问题。
summary.importance: 工作试图把世界状态转移压缩成离散的“physical language”，再做 reason-then-render。这个思路对统一离散表示、视频 world model 和 latent reasoning 有一定启发，但当前落点仍是视觉世界建模，不是 LLM 基座预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: PhiZero 从 in-the-wild 视频中自监督学习 physical language，把未来世界演化表示成离散序列；生成时先预测 physical-language sequence，再把这些状态转移渲染成未来视频。整体是显式推理层加视频渲染层的两阶段范式，而不是端到端像素预测。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 generation 和 understanding benchmark 上验证了物理一致性与交互式仿真潜力，但未给出模型规模、tokenizer 细节、离散码本大小或与主流视频 world model 的定量差距。对预训练研究员，最值得确认的是离散表示是否真有组合性与外推性，而不只是中间符号层。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitation of physical world models that predict future videos directly in pixel space without explicitly representing world-state transitions.
summary_en.importance: The paper proposes a discrete 'physical language' for state transitions and a reason-then-render pipeline. This is mildly interesting for unified discrete representations, video world models, and latent reasoning, though it is still outside the mainline of LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhiZero learns a self-supervised physical language from in-the-wild videos, representing future world evolution as a discrete sequence. Generation then proceeds in two stages: predict the physical-language sequence first, and render it into future video afterward.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains on generation and understanding benchmarks plus potential for interactive simulation, but gives no model scale, tokenizer details, codebook size, or quantitative comparison against mainstream video world models. For pretraining researchers, the key question is whether the discrete representation truly supports compositionality and extrapolation rather than acting as a cosmetic intermediate layer.

recommendation.zh: 可以当作“离散中间语言做 world model”的样本看，但先别高估；只需确认 physical language 是否真带来可组合推理，而不是换皮 latent code。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a data point on discrete intermediate languages for world models, but don’t overread it; the key is whether the physical language is genuinely compositional rather than just a relabeled latent code.

paper.title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM agent 强化学习过度依赖稀疏任务奖励、没有显式利用每一步动作后的环境反馈，导致长程任务中规划和泛化不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / agentic RL 方法，但对预训练研究也有启发。它强调 rollout 中的环境转移反馈是一种密集、动作条件化的训练信号，可以约束模型对“动作会怎样改变状态”的内部表征。这个思路和预训练里的 next-token loss 有相似点：不是只优化最终答案，而是让模型在交互轨迹中学习局部因果结构。对后续做 RL pretrain、交互式数据合成、world-model-style LM 训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TAPO 是一个交替训练框架。常规阶段使用现有 agentic RL 算法做 policy optimization，例如基于 group relative advantage 的方法；辅助阶段复用同一批在线 rollout 数据，把每个 transition 转成监督样本，让共享 backbone 根据当前观察状态和已执行动作预测环境返回的后续反馈。这样做有两个取舍。第一，它不单独训练一个外置 world model，而是把转移预测作为共享模型的辅助目标，避免测试时增加额外推理模块。第二，它不额外采集专家数据或环境数据，而是复用标准 RL rollout，因此成本主要来自训练阶段的额外监督 loss。和先预训练 transition model 再做 RL 的方法相比，TAPO 把 transition supervision 放进 RL 过程内部，用来持续校准策略模型对环境动态和动作后果的敏感性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个长程 agent benchmark：WebShop 和 ALFWorld。论文声称 TAPO 在不同模型规模和不同 policy optimization 算法上都带来稳定提升，说明转移监督不是依赖某一个具体 RL 实现。分析部分的主要结论是，加入 transition supervision 后，模型对环境反馈更敏感，长程决策更有效。给定内容没有提供具体参数规模、训练步数、奖励提升幅度或消融表数字，因此不宜夸大定量结论；读结果表时应重点看 TAPO 相对原始 RL baseline 的提升、不同辅助 loss 权重的消融、以及是否存在 transition prediction 与 task reward 不一致时的退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。优先看方法图和训练流程，确认 policy optimization 与 transition supervision 如何交替、transition target 具体预测的是环境 observation 还是更结构化的 feedback。然后看 WebShop / ALFWorld 的主结果表，判断提升是否跨环境、跨模型规模、跨 RL 算法成立。消融部分比主表更重要：需要看去掉 transition supervision 后的差距、不同采样数据量下的效果、辅助目标权重对最终 reward 的影响。若关注预训练，可重点思考这种 transition prediction 是否能扩展到大规模交互语料，成为 agent LM 的持续预训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a weakness in RL training for LLM agents: standard methods rely heavily on sparse task rewards and do not explicitly use the dense environmental feedback observed after each executed action.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and agentic RL paper, but it has clear relevance to pretraining-oriented research. It treats transition feedback from rollouts as a dense, action-conditioned learning signal that can shape the model’s internal understanding of how actions change the environment. This connects to broader questions in RL pretraining, interactive data generation, and world-model-like objectives for language models: the model should not only optimize final success, but also learn local consequence structure along a trajectory.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAPO is an alternating training framework. One stage performs ordinary policy optimization with existing agentic RL methods, such as group-based relative-advantage algorithms. The other stage reuses the same online rollout data as supervised transition data: given the current observation and the executed action, the shared backbone is trained to predict the subsequent environmental feedback. The design avoids training a separate external world model and adds no inference-time module. It also avoids extra expert data or additional environment sampling, since the supervision is extracted from standard RL trajectories. Compared with approaches that pretrain a transition model before RL, TAPO injects transition supervision inside the RL loop, so the policy model is repeatedly nudged to represent action consequences while its policy is being optimized.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two long-horizon agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. The paper reports consistent gains across model scales and policy optimization algorithms, suggesting that the benefit is not tied to a single RL implementation. The analysis claims that transition supervision increases the model’s sensitivity to environmental feedback and improves long-horizon decision making. The provided content does not include exact parameter sizes, rollout budgets, reward numbers, or ablation values, so the quantitative strength should be checked directly in the result tables. Important evidence would include gains over the corresponding RL baseline, robustness across environments, auxiliary-loss weight ablations, and cases where transition prediction may conflict with reward optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the method figure and training loop to see how policy optimization alternates with transition supervision, and clarify whether the target is raw observation text or a more structured feedback signal. Then inspect the WebShop and ALFWorld result tables to verify whether the gains hold across environments, model sizes, and RL algorithms. The ablations matter more than the headline numbers: look for the effect of removing transition supervision, changing the amount of rollout data, and tuning the auxiliary loss weight. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is whether transition prediction can scale into a continual pretraining objective for agent-oriented language models.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 rollout 里的环境反馈重新解释成密集建模信号，值得看方法节和 ablation；若增益只出现在小环境，就当作 agent world-model 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reframes environment feedback as dense modeling signal; read the method and ablations, and treat it as weak evidence unless gains hold beyond toy agent setups.

paper.title: Tycho: Active Abstraction with Programmatic World Models for ARC-AGI-3
paper.abstract: ARC-AGI-3 turns abstraction into an interactive problem of skill acquisition. A player must infer an unfamiliar game's rules, hidden state, and goal while maintaining action efficiency because every move counts. We formalize these environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines and introduce Tycho, a coding-agent system that constructs and uses game-specific models during interaction. Tycho separates actionable observations from intermediate animation, level-completion, and g

summary.core_problem: ARC-AGI-3交互式抽象任务中，Agent如何在动作效率约束下推断未知游戏规则并高效求解
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于程序化世界模型的主动抽象Agent架构，在ARC-AGI-3公开集上达到人类级动作效率
summary.technical_approach: 将环境建模为参数化渲染的确定性Moore机；Tycho系统分离可执行观测与动画/结束帧，从结构化历史中构建、测试、规划、修复或绕过可执行假设；采用Actor请求委派给模型构建器的编排策略
summary.experiments: 在25个公开游戏上对比4种编排策略，Claude Opus 4.8下最优策略RHAE达88.49；GPT-5.6 Sol和Opus 5均达到100.00 RHAE

summary_en.core_problem: How agents can infer unknown game rules and solve efficiently under action-efficiency constraints in ARC-AGI-3 interactive abstraction tasks
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an active abstraction agent architecture with programmatic world models, achieving human-level action efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 public set
summary_en.technical_approach: Models environments as parameterized rendered deterministic Moore machines; Tycho system separates actionable observations from animation/end frames, building, testing, planning with, repairing, or bypassing executable hypotheses from structured history; uses an actor-requested delegation to model builder orchestration policy
summary_en.experiments: Compared 4 orchestration policies on 25 public games; best policy reaches 88.49 RHAE with Claude Opus 4.8; both GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 reach 100.00 RHAE

recommendation.zh: 程序化世界模型+主动抽象的思路对Agent推理范式有参考价值，但属于特定benchmark的系统工作，看摘要和结果表即可
recommendation.en: The programmatic world model + active abstraction idea is informative for agent reasoning paradigms, but it is a benchmark-specific system work; read abstract and results tables only.

paper.title: Scaling GUI Agents with Visual State Transitions
paper.abstract: We introduce State Transition Pretraining (STP) as a new scaling axis for GUI agents. During the STP stage, we continually pretrain a unified multimodal model on visual state transitions by jointly optimizing inverse dynamics (predicting actions from state changes) and forward dynamics (predicting next states from current states and actions). This optimization equips the model with better action-grounded visual representations and an internal world model of GUI dynamics. When subsequently fine-t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 GUI agent 的一个老问题：高质量任务轨迹贵、RL 交互训练重，而直接用 instruction-conditioned trajectory fine-tuning 又把视觉定位、界面动态理解、动作语义和任务规划全压进一个 next-action objective 里，导致数据效率和优化都不理想。作者要解决的是，能不能在不依赖额外任务级标注的前提下，先用更便宜、更容易扩展的 state transition 数据，把 GUI 交互里最基础的 action-grounded visual representation 和局部 dynamics 先学出来，再去做任务轨迹微调。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不算最高，因为它主要是 GUI agent 训练范式，而不是通用 LLM 预训练。但它有两个值得注意的点。第一，它把“状态转移建模”明确当成一个独立于 trajectory SFT 的 scaling axis，这个思路和语言模型里把局部结构学习与高层任务对齐解耦是相通的。第二，它采用 unified multimodal model 同时做 image-text-to-image 的 forward dynamics 和 image-image-to-text 的 inverse dynamics，这种把生成式 world modeling 与 action recovery 结合的预训练方式，对多模态 agent pretraining 有启发。若从更广义的 pretrain/post-train 接口看，这篇论文提供了一个例子：先用廉价、局部、密集监督学环境动力学，再用稀缺、长程、任务级数据学规划。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 State Transition Pretraining，简称 STP。训练样本是单步转移三元组 (s_t, a_t, s_{t+1})，可以从已有轨迹切出来，也可以在交互环境中自动收集。STP 有两个联合目标。其一是 forward dynamics：输入当前界面状态和动作，预测下一界面状态，相当于 image-text-to-image 建模。作者希望模型借此形成 GUI dynamics 的内部表征，知道点击、输入、滚动之后界面会怎么变。其二是 inverse dynamics：输入前后两个截图，预测中间发生的动作，相当于 image-image-to-text 建模。这个目标迫使模型关注真正发生交互的位置和变化区域，从而学到更细粒度、与动作相关的视觉特征。论文的一个关键选择是使用 unified multimodal model 作为 backbone，而不是把视觉编码、动作分类、状态预测拆成多个专用模块。这样 forward 和 inverse 两个目标可以在统一 token 空间里共享表示，也更容易无缝衔接后续 trajectory fine-tuning。作者强调 STP 不是替代任务微调，而是提供更好的初始化。与直接 trajectory SFT 相比，它把局部可学习结构单独拿出来，减少 instruction-following、planning、grounding、dynamics 几种能力在同一损失里互相干扰。消融部分还表明，forward 和 inverse 是互补的：只做其中一个都有收益，但联合训练最好；另外，transition 按完整轨迹采样还是按独立 step 采样，效果接近，说明收益主要来自状态转移监督本身，而不是序列组织方式。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖桌面和移动端 GUI benchmark。桌面端在 AgentNetBench 上，在相同 trajectory fine-tuning 配置下，加入 STP 后平均 success rate 提升 2.3% 到 6.2%，coordinate success rate 提升 1.6% 到 6.8%，提升幅度会随 fine-tuning data split 而变化。移动端在 AndroidControl 上，step success rate 提升 0.9%，coordinate prediction accuracy 提升 1.3%；在 GUIOdyssey 上，step success rate 提升 0.6%，coordinate prediction accuracy 提升 1.6%。论文还给出优化层面的证据：Figure 1 左图显示 STP 初始化能改善后续 trajectory fine-tuning 的 cross-entropy loss 曲线，说明它不只是多看了些数据，而是让优化更顺。可扩展性实验有两条。第一，在固定 fine-tuning 数据时，增加 transition pretraining 数据会稳定提升下游表现，说明 STP 确实是一条可扩展的数据轴。第二，在固定 STP 设置时，把 trajectory fine-tuning 数据从 2K 扩到 18K，STP 仍持续优于 fine-tune-only baseline，说明收益不是简单的数据重复曝光，而是来自 forward/inverse dynamics 提供的结构化监督。对预训练研究者来说，这组结果最有价值的不是绝对分数，而是“便宜的局部转移监督可以持续改善昂贵的任务级训练”这个趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先读 Introduction 里对 direct trajectory fine-tuning 两个瓶颈的拆解：数据稀缺和目标耦合。然后直接看 STP 方法部分，重点理解为什么 forward dynamics 和 inverse dynamics 要一起做，而不是只做 action prediction。接着看主结果表和 Figure 1 左图，确认它既带来最终指标提升，也改善优化过程。最后看 scalability 和 ablation：这两部分决定它是不是一个真正独立的 scaling axis，而不只是额外预训练带来的偶然增益。若只是泛读，30 分钟左右足够。最值得留意的点有三个：统一多模态 backbone 的训练接口、forward/inverse 的互补性、以及 step-level transition 数据是否能替代部分昂贵轨迹监督。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a bottleneck in GUI-agent training: instruction-conditioned trajectory fine-tuning is expensive to scale and mixes several hard subproblems into one next-action objective. A model must learn visual grounding, local GUI dynamics, action semantics, and task planning all at once, while high-quality trajectory data remains costly. The paper asks whether a cheaper and denser supervision source—single-step visual state transitions—can be used as a separate pretraining stage to learn action-grounded representations and local environment dynamics before task-level fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is not core LLM pretraining in the narrow text-only sense, but it is relevant as a multimodal pretraining recipe for agents. The main idea is to treat state-transition modeling as an additional scaling axis, separate from trajectory supervision. That is useful beyond GUI control: it is an example of decoupling local environment modeling from high-level instruction following. The paper is also interesting because it uses a unified multimodal model to jointly learn forward dynamics and inverse dynamics, combining world-model-like prediction with action recovery. For researchers thinking about pretrain-to-post-train interfaces, the message is clear: dense, local, annotation-light supervision can improve the efficiency of later training on sparse, long-horizon, task-labeled trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is State Transition Pretraining, or STP. Training data consists of step-level tuples (s_t, a_t, s_{t+1}), which can be extracted from existing trajectories or collected automatically from interactive environments. STP jointly optimizes two objectives. Forward dynamics predicts the next GUI state from the current state and action, effectively an image-text-to-image task. This is meant to build an internal model of how GUI states change under actions such as click, type, or scroll. Inverse dynamics predicts the action from consecutive screenshots, an image-image-to-text task. This forces the model to identify what changed, where the interaction occurred, and which visual details are action-relevant. A notable design choice is the use of a unified multimodal model rather than separate modules for perception, action classification, and state prediction. That allows both objectives to share a common tokenized interface and makes the pretrained model easier to transfer into downstream trajectory fine-tuning. The paper positions STP as initialization rather than replacement: it removes some of the burden from trajectory SFT by learning local structure first. The ablations suggest that forward and inverse dynamics provide complementary signals, and that the gains are not sensitive to whether transitions are sampled as full trajectories or as independent steps.
summary_en.experiments: The main results cover both desktop and mobile GUI benchmarks. On AgentNetBench, under matched trajectory fine-tuning settings, STP improves average success rate by 2.3% to 6.2% and coordinate success rate by 1.6% to 6.8%, depending on the fine-tuning split. On AndroidControl, it improves step success rate by 0.9% and coordinate prediction accuracy by 1.3%. On GUIOdyssey, it improves step success rate by 0.6% and coordinate prediction accuracy by 1.6%. The paper also provides optimization evidence: the left panel of Figure 1 shows better cross-entropy behavior during downstream trajectory fine-tuning when initialized with STP. The scalability results are important. With fine-tuning data fixed, increasing transition-pretraining data steadily improves downstream performance. With STP fixed, scaling trajectory fine-tuning data from 2K to 18K still leaves STP ahead of the fine-tune-only baseline. That suggests the gains are not just due to extra data exposure, but to the structure of the forward and inverse dynamics objectives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivation section that explains why direct trajectory fine-tuning is data-hungry and optimization-heavy. Then read the STP method carefully, especially the rationale for combining forward and inverse dynamics instead of using only action prediction. After that, inspect the main benchmark tables and the optimization plot in Figure 1. Those establish both end performance gains and easier downstream training. If time permits, read the scalability and ablation sections, since they determine whether STP is a real scaling axis or just a one-off pretraining trick. A useful skim should take around 30 minutes. The most informative details are the unified multimodal training interface, the complementarity between forward and inverse objectives, and the evidence that step-level transition data can substitute for part of the expensive task-level supervision.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 STP loss 和 data scaling 图；它把 GUI agent 的瓶颈从指令轨迹转向状态动力学，值得内部复现小版。
recommendation.en: Read the STP losses and data-scaling plots; it reframes GUI-agent scaling around state dynamics rather than instruction trajectories.

paper.title: Persistent Computational State: A Session-Centric Runtime for Generative World Models
paper.abstract: Generative world models are increasingly driven as simulators: a planner forks a state, rolls out futures, backtracks, and returns to a visited viewpoint. Recent benchmarks establish that current video world models fail this usage, and attribute it to the model, prescribing new architectures and training objectives. We show this attribution is incomplete, and for an important class of models simply wrong. Snapshotting the state the runtime already holds -- an observation plus RNG state, a memory

summary.core_problem: 生成式世界模型做规划时的状态分叉、回滚、续接能力差，此前普遍归因于模型架构或训练目标缺陷，本文指出该归因不成立。
summary.importance: 纠正了领域内对世界模型规划能力缺陷的错误归因，指出问题出在从LM serving继承的请求中心化运行时设计而非模型本身，为生成式模拟器runtime设计提供了新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 识别出生成模型运行时中三类不可重算的状态内核（观测值+RNG状态、记忆库、窗口化KV上下文），通过对这些状态做快照与恢复即可实现字节级一致的续接，仅破坏RNG状态就会导致续接质量下降。
summary.experiments: 在三类不同架构的生成世界模型上完成机制验证：快照恢复状态可复现字节级一致的续接结果，仅损坏RNG状态会显著降低续接质量，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据集。

summary_en.core_problem: Generative world models perform poorly on state forking, backtracking and resumption during planning, which was previously attributed to model architecture or training objective flaws; this paper disproves this attribution.
summary_en.importance: Corrects the widespread misattribution of world model planning failures, locating the root cause in the request-centric serving design inherited from LLM serving rather than model capability, opening new directions for generative simulator runtime design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies three classes of non-recomputable state kernels in generative model runtimes (observation + RNG state, memory bank, windowed KV context); snapshotting and restoring these states enables byte-identical continuation, while corrupting only RNG state degrades performance.
summary_en.experiments: Mechanism validation across three generative world model architectures: snapshot-restore reproduces byte-identical never-left continuation, while isolated RNG corruption significantly degrades continuation quality; no specific model sizes or datasets are disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 指出把runtime问题错归为模型缺陷的普遍偏差，结论值得知道，全文聚焦世界模型无需细读。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing the core misattribution insight; no need to read the full paper as it focuses narrowly on world model runtimes.

paper.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
paper.abstract: Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and ef

summary.core_problem: AlayaWorld 解决的是交互式视频世界模型的长程生成问题：模型既要跟随连续相机控制和可切换文本意图，又要在数十秒到更长 rollout 中保持场景身份、空间结构和局部动态不漂移。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的启发主要在统一世界建模 recipe，而不是单点视觉效果。它把视频 diffusion prior、短块自回归生成、空间记忆、历史纠错训练和少步蒸馏放到同一套训练流程里，展示了视频世界模型从“生成片段”走向“可交互持续环境”时需要哪些训练信号。对 LLM 基座研究员更有用的是两点：第一，长程生成不能只靠扩大上下文，必须引入有结构的有界记忆；第二，训练时要显式暴露模型自己的 rollout 残差，否则推理阶段的小错误会沿时间放大。
summary.technical_approach: 模型基于 15B video diffusion transformer，输出 24-fps、540p 和 720p 视频。生成方式不是一次性生成长视频，而是在 latent 空间按短 chunk 自回归推进，每个 chunk 接收相机轨迹和当前文本 prompt。核心设计是 bounded visual context：包括全局场景 anchor、压缩近期历史、几何对齐的 spatial memory，以及最近帧条件。temporal memory 用来维持短期运动和帧间连续性；spatial memory 存储历史观察，并在回到已访问区域时按目标视角重投影。这样上下文规模随 rollout 长度保持近似常数，避免长视频生成成本线性增长。训练分三阶段：先把通用双向视频 prior 适配到世界建模数据；再转换为带相机控制和时空记忆的自回归生成器；最后用 corrupted histories 和模型自身 rollout 中收集的 replay prediction residuals 做恢复训练，降低长程漂移。推理加速部分采用 discrete autoregressive distillation，结合 distribution-matching distillation、self-forcing++ 和 consistency distillation，把每个 chunk 的采样步数从约 30 步降到 4 步，同时保留控制和记忆模块。
summary.experiments: 数据侧包含 222,147 个 clip，来自 7 个来源，包括内部整理的 MUGEN 和 GameVerse。数据混合覆盖真实世界视频、游戏录像、合成渲染和生成事件视频；每条记录统一为视频、相机内参与位姿，以及和时间线对齐的层级 caption。论文在 iWorld-Bench 上评估生成质量、轨迹跟随和记忆能力，报告 AlayaWorld 在整体指标上优于对比方法。消融重点围绕长程稳定性、空间记忆、历史损坏训练和蒸馏步数。最有信息量的实验结论是：仅依赖近期帧不足以支撑 revisitation；加入几何对齐的 spatial memory 后，回到旧视角时能更好保持场景结构；用模型自身 rollout 残差训练，比只在干净历史上训练更能抑制长程 blur、光照漂移和几何漂移。少步蒸馏把推理步数压到 4 步/块，但论文也承认模型仍主要依赖可见视觉、估计几何和视觉记忆，对物体隐状态、物理因果和长期任务结构的理解有限。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 里对 interaction、consistency、stability、efficiency 四个约束的拆分，这决定了方法为什么不能只是一个更大的 video diffusion model。然后看 Training Data，重点关注真实视频、游戏、合成渲染和生成事件的混合方式，以及相机位姿和层级 caption 如何统一成训练记录。方法部分优先看 bounded visual context 和 spatial memory 的设计，尤其是历史观察如何存储、压缩和重投影。实验部分重点看 iWorld-Bench 的 memory ability、trajectory following，以及 corrupted history / replay residual 的消融。蒸馏章节适合快速读，关注 30 步到 4 步的代价和画质控制取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: AlayaWorld targets long-horizon interactive video world modeling: the model must follow continuous camera controls and changing text intents while preserving scene identity, spatial layout, and local dynamics over extended autoregressive rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is the full training recipe rather than the visual demo alone. The work combines a video diffusion prior, chunk-level autoregressive generation, structured bounded memory, rollout-error recovery training, and few-step distillation. It makes a clear point: long-horizon generative stability cannot be solved only by increasing context length. The context has to be structured, and training must expose the model to its own imperfect histories so that small rollout errors do not accumulate unchecked.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built on a 15B video diffusion transformer and generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Instead of producing a full long video in one pass, it generates short latent chunks autoregressively. Each chunk is conditioned on camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. The central mechanism is a bounded visual context composed of a global scene anchor, compressed recent history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. Temporal memory maintains short-range dynamics and frame continuity. Spatial memory stores past observations and reprojects them into the current target view when the camera revisits a region. This keeps per-chunk compute approximately constant as rollout length grows. Training has three stages: adapt a general bidirectional video prior to world-modeling data; convert it into an autoregressive generator with camera control and spatiotemporal memory; then train with corrupted histories and replay prediction residuals collected from the model’s own rollouts. For inference, the paper uses discrete autoregressive distillation with distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing sampling from roughly 30 steps to 4 steps per chunk while keeping the control and memory stack active.
summary_en.experiments: The training corpus contains 222,147 clips from seven sources, including internally curated MUGEN and GameVerse data. It mixes real-world videos, gameplay recordings, synthetic renderings, and generated event videos. Each record is normalized into video frames, camera intrinsics and poses when available or recoverable, and timeline-aligned hierarchical captions. Evaluation is performed on iWorld-Bench, covering generation quality, trajectory following, and memory ability. The paper reports stronger overall performance than compared systems. The most informative ablations concern spatial memory, corrupted-history training, replay residuals, and distillation. The reported pattern is consistent: recent-frame conditioning alone is insufficient for revisitation; geometry-aligned memory improves preservation of previously seen regions; training on model-induced imperfect histories reduces long-horizon blur, illumination drift, and geometric drift. The paper also states a clear limitation: the model still represents the world mainly through visible observations, estimated geometry, and visual memory, so object state, physical causality, and long-term task structure remain weak.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Start with the Introduction’s decomposition into interaction, consistency, stability, and efficiency; it explains why a larger video generator is not sufficient. Then read the Training Data section for the mixture of real videos, gameplay, synthetic renderings, generated events, camera poses, and hierarchical captions. In the method, focus on bounded visual context and spatial memory, especially how past observations are stored, compressed, and reprojected. In experiments, prioritize iWorld-Bench memory ability, trajectory following, and the ablations on corrupted histories and replay residuals. The distillation section can be read more quickly, with attention to the trade-off behind reducing sampling from about 30 steps to 4 steps per chunk.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 pretrain，但长时程记忆怎么做得“有界而不崩”讲得很像下一代统一生成模型；先看 bounded context 设计，再看训练课程。
recommendation.en: Not a text-pretraining paper, but the bounded-memory recipe for stable long-horizon generation is directly relevant to unified generative modeling; read the context design first, then the curriculum.

paper.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
paper.abstract: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressiv

summary.core_problem: 用 masked diffusion LM 替代自回归 LM 作为文本世界模型，为 agentic RL 提供可全局条件化、可按需扩展多样性的环境动力学模拟器。
summary.importance: 把离散 diffusion LM 的 any-order 特性直接用到 agent world model 场景，指出 AR 左到右偏置在全局状态锚点（工具 schema、历史轮次、期望结果）条件化上的结构性缺陷；同时提供了跨 9 个开源环境、12 个前沿模型族的 239k 条 grounded 轨迹数据。
summary.technical_approach: 将文本世界建模形式化为 steerable transition-dynamics 问题，分解为初始状态、任务上下文、工具 schema、领域规则、steering directives；用 masked diffusion LM 做 any-order 条件生成，允许在任意位置锚定全局约束后并行补全状态转移，而不是 AR 的单向 rollout。
summary.experiments: 构建 239,403 条 grounded state-action 轨迹，覆盖 9 个开源环境和 12 个前沿模型族；对比 AR world model 在 rollout 质量、全局条件一致性、多样性上的表现（abstract 截断，具体数值未给出）。

summary_en.core_problem: Use masked diffusion language models instead of autoregressive LMs as text-based world models, providing globally conditionable, on-demand diversity for agentic RL environment simulation.
summary_en.importance: Exploits the any-order nature of discrete diffusion LMs for agent world modeling, identifying a structural limitation of AR left-to-right bias when conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors (tool schemas, prior turns, expected outcomes); also contributes 239k grounded trajectories across 9 open-source environments and 12 frontier model families.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives; uses a masked diffusion LM for any-order conditional generation, allowing arbitrary global anchors to be fixed before parallel state completion rather than unidirectional AR rollout.
summary_en.experiments: Curates 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning 9 open-source environments and 12 frontier model families; compares against AR world models on rollout quality, global conditioning consistency, and diversity (abstract truncated, exact numbers not provided).

recommendation.zh: 把 MDLM 类 any-order LM 拉到 world model 场景是少见的对位论证，重点看它如何量化 AR 左到右偏置在全局锚点条件化上的损失。
recommendation.en: A rare head-to-head argument for any-order LMs as world models; focus on how they quantify AR left-to-right bias under global-anchor conditioning.

paper.title: Thinking in Video: Can Video Generators Really Reason About the Real World?
paper.abstract: Recent advances in world models and video generation have given rise to an emerging reasoning paradigm that leverages video generative models to simulate, predict, and reason about real-world dynamics. We redefine this paradigm as Thinking in Video, where video is not merely an output artifact but a medium for constructing, extending, and verifying causal thought. However, this promise remains unverified: convincing rollouts may reflect memorized appearances rather than causal understanding, whi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的问题很直接：视频生成模型看起来能“滚动未来”，但这种滚动到底是因果理解，还是高频视觉模式的拟合。作者把这个问题命名为 Thinking in Video，并进一步指出，现有评测把画面逼真度和语义逻辑拆开了，所以无法判断视频模型能不能把视频当作推理媒介。核心问题不是视频生成质量，而是 world-model 式能力是否真的存在、存在到什么程度。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的相关性主要在评测层，而不是训练方法层。它提供了一个较清楚的判断框架：如果一个模型真能作为世界模拟器，那么它既要能识别因果前提，也要能把后果在时间维度上正确生成出来。这个区分对多模态统一建模、视频 world model、AR+diffusion 联合系统都重要，因为很多系统在 demo 上看起来“懂物理”“懂社会互动”，但缺少把显式理解和隐式生成拆开测的协议。论文的价值在于把 perception-prediction gap 明确化：模型可能会生成看似合理的后续，却并不真正具备稳定的因果表征。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出的是一个 benchmark/evaluation framework，叫 Causal-Generative Dual-Judge，简称 CGDJ。它分成两个互补模块。第一是 Explicit Causal Perception：测试模型能否从视频中识别并表达因果结构。因为多数视频生成器不支持视频-文本交错输入，作者设计了 Flatten Temporal Video，把多帧视频和栅格化问题拼成统一图像网格，转成可直接判分的视觉问答形式。这样做的目的，是逼模型显式暴露它“看懂了什么因果关系”，而不是只靠继续生成来蒙对。第二是 Implicit Generative Prediction：给定因果前件，让模型直接生成后果视频，检查生成的时间演化是否符合因果逻辑。

这个设计的关键不在 judge 本身，而在把“知道答案”和“能把答案渲染出来”拆成两个维度。作者还讨论了 audio-visual misalignment：有些模型在语言或显式判断上能说对，但在视频渲染上做不对；也有模型反过来，能生成一个看似合理的后续，但显式因果问答几乎崩掉。这样的拆分比单纯 FVD、VBench 或静态 VQA 更接近 world model 研究真正关心的能力结构。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较鲜明。显式因果感知这一侧，闭源强模型如 Sora-2、Veo-3.1 有可测的 causal perception，开源视频生成模型在 flatten 后的推理协议下表现接近失效。隐式生成这一侧，开源模型虽然显式理解弱，但仍能生成中等程度上“看起来合理”的因果后续，于是形成作者强调的 Perception-Prediction Gap。换句话说，视觉动作连续性可以高于显式因果理解。

作者还报告了一种 audio-visual misalignment：模型有时在口头或文本层面更容易说对因果逻辑，但生成的视频并没有把这个逻辑稳定落到像素空间。这个观察对多模态预训练很有意思，因为它暗示不同模态头共享的世界知识并不充分，或者说知识到渲染的接口仍然很脆弱。

从你关心的角度看，实验更像 benchmark paper，而不是机制论文。摘要没有给出详细数字，全文重点也不是追求一个统一总分，而是展示不同模型在两个子任务上的错位表现。若想把它用于研究判断，重点不是谁分高，而是“显式理解”和“隐式生成”是否同步提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction，理解作者为什么要把“Thinking in Video”从一般视频生成里单独拎出来。然后直接看 CGDJ 框架图和两个模块的任务定义，尤其是 Flatten Temporal Video 的构造方式；这是全文最有方法信息量的部分。结果部分优先看闭源与开源模型在 Explicit Causal Perception 和 Implicit Generative Prediction 上的对照图，再看作者如何定义并分析 Perception-Prediction Gap。最后浏览 audio-visual misalignment 的案例分析。预计 25 分钟左右可以抓住主线。如果你做视频 world model 或统一多模态预训练，这篇更适合作为评测设计参考，而不是训练 recipe 参考。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a clean question: when a video generator produces a plausible future, is it actually reasoning about causal structure, or merely replaying high-frequency visual regularities? The authors frame this as “Thinking in Video,” where video is treated not just as output but as a medium for constructing and verifying thought. The central issue is therefore not video quality, but whether current video generators deserve to be interpreted as world models with usable causal understanding.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly evaluative rather than algorithmic. The paper offers a useful decomposition for multimodal pretraining and world-model work: a system that genuinely reasons through video should both recognize causal structure and render the correct temporal consequence. That distinction matters because many current systems look impressive in demos while existing metrics mostly reward realism, smoothness, or text alignment. By making the perception-prediction gap explicit, the paper gives a more disciplined way to discuss what video models do and do not understand.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main contribution is the Causal-Generative Dual-Judge (CGDJ), a benchmark and evaluation framework with two complementary modules. The first is Explicit Causal Perception, which tests whether a model can identify and articulate causal structure from visual evidence. Since most video generators do not support interleaved video-text prompting, the authors introduce Flatten Temporal Video: multiple frames plus rasterized queries are packed into a unified image grid, turning the task into a directly judgeable visual QA setup. This forces the model to expose what causal relation it recognizes instead of hiding behind free-form continuation.

The second module is Implicit Generative Prediction. Given a causal antecedent, the model must generate the consequent future video. This tests whether the model can enact its putative reasoning in the pixel domain over time. The key idea is to separate “knowing” from “rendering.” A model may answer causal questions correctly yet fail to generate a causally valid rollout, or it may generate something visually plausible without robust explicit causal understanding. That decomposition is more informative for world-model claims than standard fidelity metrics such as FVD or static multimodal QA benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical picture is fairly clear. On the explicit side, stronger closed-source systems such as Sora-2 and Veo-3.1 show measurable causal perception, while open-source video generators largely collapse under the flattened reasoning protocol. On the generative side, however, open-source models can still produce moderately plausible causal continuations. This yields the paper’s main finding: a Perception-Prediction Gap, where visual continuation can look more competent than explicit causal understanding.

The authors also report an audio-visual or verbal-visual misalignment: some models can articulate the correct causal logic more reliably than they can render it in video. That observation is interesting for multimodal pretraining because it suggests that causal knowledge, if present, is not robustly grounded into the generative visual pathway. The paper is not trying to establish a single leaderboard score; the more useful signal is the mismatch pattern between the two sub-evaluations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction first to understand why the authors separate “Thinking in Video” from ordinary video generation. Then go straight to the CGDJ framework and the task definitions for the two modules, especially Flatten Temporal Video; that is the most methodologically informative part. In the results, focus on the side-by-side comparison between Explicit Causal Perception and Implicit Generative Prediction across closed and open models. After that, skim the case studies on the perception-prediction gap and the verbal/audio-visual misalignment. Around 25 minutes is enough for a solid skim. For researchers working on video world models or unified multimodal pretraining, this is more useful as an evaluation-design reference than as a training-method paper.

recommendation.zh: 做世界模型/多模态预训练的人可重点看评测协议设计和失败案例统计，方法本身无范式突破。
recommendation.en: Useful for world model / multimodal pretrain researchers; focus on the evaluation protocol and failure case statistics, no paradigm-level novelty.

paper.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
paper.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing

summary.core_problem: 训练动作条件视觉世界模型时，如何让模型同时满足物理合理性、动作遵循性和视觉质量，并能处理专家数据之外的动作。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 embodied AI 世界模型的训练目标和 RL 框架设计；对 LLM 预训练不直接，但对“生成模型如何用 reward 信号补齐像素重建损失”有一定旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: PAVXploreRL 建在预训练 latent world model 上，用强化学习显式优化 Physical Plausibility、Action Adherence、Visual Fidelity 三类 reward；同时混合专家轨迹和噪声驱动的 OOD action exploration，减少模型只拟合专家动作分布的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调方法在 ID expert demonstrations 和 OOD actions 上评估世界模型的 PAV 表现，但未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train action-conditioned visual world models that satisfy physical plausibility, action adherence, and visual fidelity, while generalizing beyond expert action distributions.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a reward-driven training framework for embodied visual world models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is somewhat relevant to how generative models can move beyond reconstruction losses using task-structured rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: PAVXploreRL starts from a pretrained latent world model and applies reinforcement learning to optimize three reward families: Physical Plausibility, Action Adherence, and Visual Fidelity. It combines expert in-distribution trajectories with noise-driven out-of-distribution action exploration.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims evaluation on both in-distribution expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution actions, focusing on the PAV objectives. The provided text does not specify model size, training-data scale, baseline list, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 设计和 OOD action exploration；若在想 RL 信号怎么改造生成式 world model，这篇可作弱参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the reward design and OOD action-exploration setup; it is a weak but relevant reference for RL-tuning generative world models.

paper.title: Orbis 2: A Hierarchical World Model for Driving
paper.abstract: Current world models operate at a single level of abstraction, with most prioritizing perceptual fidelity while lacking the spatial reasoning and semantic understanding required for real-world downstream tasks. We present a hierarchical driving world model that factorizes future prediction across two levels operating at distinct temporal and abstraction scales: a high-level predictor that forecasts coarse scene structure over extended temporal horizons, and a low-level generator that produces de

summary.core_problem: 现有驾驶世界模型采用单一层级抽象，难以同时满足感知保真度与空间语义推理需求
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出分层驾驶世界模型，并明确对比扩散强迫与教师强迫两种预训练目标的效果差异
summary.technical_approach: 设计双层分层结构：高层预测长时域的粗粒度场景结构，低层基于高层输出生成细粒度细节；提出结合扩散强迫与教师强迫的两阶段预训练策略，兼顾表征丰富度与自回归稳定性
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露量化结果，仅提及扩散强迫预训练的内部表征更丰富，教师强迫的自回归滚动更稳定
summary.authors_note: 弗莱堡大学Thomas Brox团队，Thomas Brox为计算机视觉领域知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing driving world models use a single level of abstraction, making it difficult to simultaneously meet perceptual fidelity and spatial-semantic reasoning requirements
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a hierarchical driving world model is proposed, with a clear comparison of the effects of diffusion forcing and teacher forcing pretraining objectives
summary_en.technical_approach: A two-layer hierarchical structure is designed: a high-level predictor forecasts coarse scene structure over long horizons, and a low-level generator produces fine-grained details conditioned on the high-level output; a two-stage pretraining strategy combining diffusion forcing and teacher forcing is proposed to balance representation richness and autoregressive stability
summary_en.experiments: Quantitative results are not fully disclosed in the abstract; it is only mentioned that diffusion forcing pretraining yields richer internal representations, while teacher forcing produces more stable autoregressive rollouts
summary_en.authors_note: Thomas Brox's group at University of Freiburg; Thomas Brox is a well-known scholar in computer vision

recommendation.zh: 扩散强迫与教师强迫的表征-稳定性trade-off有参考价值，但实验仅限驾驶领域，仅看预训练目标对比部分即可
recommendation.en: The representation-stability trade-off between diffusion forcing and teacher forcing is worth noting, but experiments are limited to driving; only read the pretraining objective comparison

paper.title: When a Verified World Model Still Loses: Play-Adequacy vs Prediction-Accuracy in LLM-Synthesized Code World Models
paper.abstract: Large language models can synthesize a game's rules as executable code - a Code World Model (CWM) - which a classical planner then searches over. Such models are typically accepted when they reach high transition accuracy on sampled trajectories. We argue this is the wrong notion of adequacy for planning.   We show four things. (1) An LLM-synthesized CWM can pass a sampling gate at 100% transition accuracy and be $\geq 98\%$ state-accurate on the planner's own search distribution, yet lose syste

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM合成代码世界模型（CWM）的通用验收标准是“在随机采样的轨迹上达到1.0转移准确率”，但这一标准无法保证CWM能够支撑下游规划器（如MCTS）的有效决策，核心矛盾是随机采样轨迹的状态分布与规划器实际搜索时聚焦的高策略价值状态分布存在系统性偏移。
summary.importance: 揭示了“预测准确率”和“规划可用性”之间的结构性gap，直接影响所有“LLM合成可执行环境模型+经典搜索”类范式的验收逻辑，适用于世界模型验证、RL环境构建、决策类任务的合成数据质量评估场景：仅靠随机采样的轨迹正确率无法覆盖智能体主动探索诱导出的关键状态。
summary.technical_approach: 工作首先在井字棋、四子棋等小型完备信息博弈上复现现有基线，确认随机轨迹验收在这些场景下的有效性；随后构造最小反例场景：为army5x5a棋类添加一条“棋子达容量上限时的平局判定”规则，该规则在随机对弈中触发率仅2.5%，但在高水平对弈中决定约50%的对局结果；最后通过手工构造的、与缺省该规则的CWM严格等价的控制组agent，在算力预算匹配的条件下隔离测量该gap的因果效应，再通过端到端的实际CWM合成流程验证结论。
summary.experiments: 基线复现结果：四子棋场景下，通过1.0随机轨迹准确率验收的CWM搭配UCT-MCTS，以29:1的胜率大幅领先同规模LLM直接作为策略的方案，全量实验API总成本约2美元，单局对战的LLM调用成本仅0.001-0.005美元。小型博弈场景下的零结果：在井字棋、四子棋等规则简单、状态空间小的游戏中，通过随机轨迹准确率门槛的CWM在MCTS实际访问的状态上均无错误，该场景下随机采样的轨迹足够有辨识性，不存在gap。构造的反例场景中，省略了上述低触发率关键规则的CWM可以顺利通过1.0随机轨迹准确率验收，但实际规划时因为MCTS会主动搜索进入触发该规则的高价值状态，导致决策出现系统性错误，该效应通过控制变量排除了其他混淆因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言对verified-vs-correct gap的定义、3.2节小型游戏上的零结果解释、3.3节最小反例的构造逻辑，无需深究具体游戏的规则细节，核心要理解“验收数据分布与模型实际使用时面临的诱导分布存在偏移”这一结构性问题，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The standard acceptance criterion for LLM-synthesized Code World Models (CWMs) — perfect transition accuracy on randomly sampled trajectories — does not guarantee the model is sufficient for downstream planning with algorithms like MCTS. The core issue is a systematic distribution shift: states visited by random play diverge from the high-strategic-value states that planning algorithms focus on during actual gameplay.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a structural gap between prediction accuracy on held-out random samples and play adequacy for planning, which applies broadly to all pipelines that use LLMs to generate executable environment models paired with classical search. The finding is relevant to world model validation, RL environment construction, and synthetic data quality checks for decision-making tasks: random trajectory accuracy alone cannot capture failure modes on states that competent agents deliberately seek out.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study first replicates existing CWM baselines on small perfect-information games (tic-tac-toe, Connect Four) to confirm when the random-trajectory gate works as intended. It then constructs a minimal adversarial test case: a variant of the army5x5a game with a material-at-cap tiebreak rule that triggers in only 2.5% of random games, but decides roughly 50% of games between competent players. The causal effect of the gap is isolated using a hand-built, play-equivalent agent matched in compute budget to the incomplete CWM missing this rule, then validated end-to-end through the full CWM synthesis pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: Baseline replication: On Connect Four, CWMs that pass the 1.0 random-trajectory accuracy gate paired with UCT-MCTS beat the same LLM used as a direct policy by a 29-1 margin, with total API cost across all experiments around $2, and per-game LLM cost for the direct policy baseline at $0.001–$0.005. Null result on small games: For tic-tac-toe and Connect Four, no gap exists — CWMs that pass the random gate make no errors on states actually visited by MCTS search, as no compact incorrect rule set can fit all random trajectories while diverging on search-relevant states. On the constructed adversarial variant, CWMs missing the rare tiebreak rule consistently pass the 1.0 accuracy gate, but exhibit systematic decision failures during play, as MCTS actively steers trajectories into states where the missing rule applies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the core conceptual point. Focus on the definition of the verified-vs-correct gap in the introduction, the null result on small games in Section 3.2, and the minimal adversarial example design in Section 3.3. There is no need to dive into domain-specific game rule details; the key takeaway is the structural distribution shift between evaluation data and model deployment conditions. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在提新 agent，而是在拆穿一个常见验收幻觉：高局部准确率不等于可规划；只看 verified-vs-correct gap 和 danger law 就够了。
recommendation.en: This is not a new agent paper but a useful demolition of a common acceptance illusion: high local accuracy does not imply plan adequacy; read the verified-vs-correct gap and the danger law.

paper.title: Learning Safe Agent Behaviour from Human Preferences and Justifications via World Models
paper.abstract: We address the problem of safely training an agent policy and deploying a good and safe policy, in settings where the environment dynamics are unknown and no suitable reward function is available. In the context of safety-critical environments, we consider traditional reinforcement learning impractical and resort to the resource of human input. We introduce DROPJ, a human-centred method for both safe training and deployment. We first learn a world model (a learned simulator) from a dataset of pr

summary.core_problem: 在环境动力学未知、无合适奖励函数的安全关键场景下，传统在线RL的随机探索会带来不可接受的风险，需安全训练和部署Agent策略的方法。
summary.importance: 提出结合世界模型与带理由人类偏好的安全Agent训练框架，避免真实环境中的不安全探索，为低数据安全关键场景的Agent训练提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从离线真实轨迹学习世界模型（可学习模拟器）；人类在世界模型中交互生成模拟轨迹，采样轨迹段对并标注偏好及选择理由；基于带理由的偏好数据训练奖励模型，结合世界模型通过模型预测控制（MPC）直接部署策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要提及开展真实用户实验，但未披露具体环境、基线模型和量化效果（摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: In safety-critical settings with unknown environment dynamics and no suitable reward function, random exploration in traditional online RL introduces unacceptable risks, requiring methods for safe training and deployment of agent policies.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a safe agent training framework combining world models with justified human preferences, avoiding unsafe exploration in the real environment, and provides a new approach for agent training in low-data, safety-critical scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First learns a world model (learned simulator) from offline real-world trajectories; humans interact with the world model to generate simulated trajectories, sample trajectory segment pairs and annotate preferences along with justifications; trains a reward model on the justified preference data, and deploys policies via model predictive control (MPC) using the world model and reward model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions real-user experiments but does not disclose specific environments, baselines, or quantitative results (abstract truncated).

recommendation.zh: 传统安全RL工作，带理由的偏好奖励建模思路可备查，与LLM预训练/对齐关联较弱。
recommendation.en: A traditional safe RL work; the justified preference reward modeling idea is useful as background, but has weak relevance to LLM pretraining/alignment.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是通用图像/视频生成模型迁移到机器人场景时的失配问题：自然图像生成只需要视觉上合理，而具身生成还要求多视角一致、几何连贯、机器人本体约束和时间动态一致。作者的核心做法不是把基础生成模型窄化成机器人专用模型，而是把具身合成放回统一的多模态生成预训练框架里。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在两点。第一，它把机器人数据合成看成统一世界模型训练的一部分，而不是下游适配任务，这对多模态预训练的数据配比和任务设计有参考意义。第二，它强调继续训练时必须保留通用图像/视频生成任务，否则小规模、重复性强的机器人数据会削弱基础模型原有的语义和可控生成能力。贡献量级更偏系统整合和训练范式验证，不是新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 是一个 38B 参数的多模态自回归模型。它从已有 world foundation model 出发，在通用域数据和具身数据上做联合继续训练，统一优化 text-to-image、image editing、embodied scene generation、embodied transfer 和 embodied video generation。关键取舍是：不只用机器人轨迹继续训练，因为这会造成能力遗忘；也不只做单步场景生成，因为机器人策略需要可 rollout 的时序数据。论文进一步把 interleaved embodied sequences 和 manipulation videos 放到多时间分辨率下联合建模，用同一自回归框架同时覆盖静态多视角场景、结构化编辑迁移和视频 rollout。这个设计更像 Chameleon/Emu3/Janus 一类 unified autoregressive multimodal modeling 在机器人世界模型上的延伸。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的主要结果包括：在 embodied scene generation 和 embodied transfer 的人工评测中优于 GPT-Image-2.0；在 World Arena benchmark 上取得较强结果；生成数据能提升下游机器人策略的 out-of-distribution robustness。给定全文片段没有提供具体分数、胜率、数据规模、tokenizer 细节和训练配比，因此这些结论需要在实验表格中核对。对预训练研究更有信息量的实验不是视觉样例，而是：联合训练是否优于机器人数据单独继续训练，通用生成能力是否被保留，生成轨迹加入策略训练后在 OOD 条件下的提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三类内容：一是模型输入输出表示和自回归序列化方式，特别是图像、视频、多视角和机器人状态如何被组织成同一序列；二是训练数据与任务 mixture，尤其是通用生成任务和具身任务的比例、采样策略、loss 权重；三是 ablation，确认联合继续训练是否真的缓解遗忘，并带来机器人策略收益。定性图可以快速浏览，不应作为主要判断依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete mismatch between foundation image/video generators and embodied generation.
