Natural image generation only needs plausible visual outputs, while robotic scenarios require multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, embodiment constraints, and temporally consistent interaction dynamics. The proposed direction is to treat embodied synthesis as part of unified multimodal generative pretraining, rather than as a narrow robot-only adaptation stage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the training recipe and task formulation. The work argues that robot-world modeling should remain coupled with general image and video generation tasks during continual training, because robot datasets are smaller, more repetitive, and less diverse than web-scale visual corpora. This is a useful lesson for multimodal foundation model training: domain specialization can easily trade away the broad controllability and semantic coverage that made the base model useful. The contribution is mainly a large-system formulation and empirical validation, not a new modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is described as a 38B multimodal autoregressive model. It starts from a world foundation model and continues training on both general-domain and embodied datasets under one autoregressive objective. The task mixture includes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. The important design choice is to avoid robot-only finetuning, which may cause capability forgetting, and to go beyond single-step scene synthesis by modeling interleaved embodied sequences and manipulation videos at multiple temporal resolutions. In spirit, it extends unified autoregressive multimodal modeling, as seen in systems such as Chameleon, Emu3, and Janus, into robot-centric world modeling.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports stronger human preference results than GPT-Image-2.0 on embodied scene generation and embodied transfer, strong performance on the World Arena benchmark, and improved out-of-distribution robustness for downstream robot policies when generated data is used. The provided content does not include exact scores, win rates, dataset sizes, tokenizer details, or mixture ratios. The most informative results to verify are the ablations: joint general-plus-embodied training versus robot-only continual training, preservation of general generation ability, and the magnitude of downstream policy gains from synthetic trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the representation and serialization scheme for images, videos, multi-view observations, and robot-conditioned inputs; the data and task mixture used during continual training; and the ablation tables around forgetting, embodied generation quality, and policy improvement. Qualitative galleries are useful for sanity checks but should not drive the main assessment.

recommendation.zh: 38B统一具身生成的系统工作，参考其多任务联合训练设置，以及复用通用预训练能力适配具身约束的设计思路。
recommendation.en: 38B unified embodied synthesis system work; reference its multi-task joint training setup and design for adapting general pretrained generation capabilities to embodied constraints.

paper.title: Is Energy Guidance All You Need? Training-Free Norm Injection for Driving World Models
paper.abstract: Driving world models built on large video-diffusion backbones generate realistic scenes but are hard to control: enforcing a traffic norm typically means retraining the backbone or conditioning it on hand-built layouts. We ask whether controllability requires training at all. Our experiment shows that a rectified-flow driving world model, which jointly generates future video and a planned ego trajectory, can have its planned trajectory steered entirely at sampling time by differentiable energy f

summary.core_problem: 现有基于大视频扩散骨干的驾驶世界模型可控性差，施加交通规范通常需要重训练骨干或依赖手工布局条件
summary.importance: 方法创新+实证分析，首次验证整流流驾驶世界模型可通过采样时的能量引导实现轨迹控制，无需重训练扩散骨干
summary.technical_approach: 在联合生成未来视频和自车轨迹的整流流世界模型中，采样时注入编码驾驶规范的可微能量函数，直接引导规划轨迹；基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干实现
summary.experiments: 基于Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT骨干构建驾驶世界模型，验证可通过能量引导实现反事实目标下的刹车控制，但生成视频尚未跟随引导轨迹，跨流耦合是端到端可控的关键瓶颈

summary_en.core_problem: Existing driving world models built on large video diffusion backbones have poor controllability—enforcing traffic norms typically requires retraining the backbone or conditioning on hand-built layouts
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation and empirical analysis, first verifying that rectified-flow driving world models can achieve trajectory control via sampling-time energy guidance without retraining the diffusion backbone
summary_en.technical_approach: In a rectified-flow world model that jointly generates future video and ego trajectory, differentiable energy functions encoding driving norms are injected at sampling time to directly steer the planned trajectory; implemented on the Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone
summary_en.experiments: Built on Open-Sora 2.0 MM-DiT backbone, verifies that energy guidance can achieve braking control under counterfactual targets, but generated videos do not yet follow the steered trajectory, with cross-stream coupling identified as the key bottleneck for end-to-end controllability

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型训练-free能量引导的思路对文本扩散LM可控生成有微弱参考，仅看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: The training-free energy guidance idea offers marginal reference for controllable diffusion LM generation; only the abstract conclusion is needed

paper.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
paper.abstract: We present ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that turns text, image, and video inputs into high-fidelity, explorable 3D worlds. At the heart of our framework is a unified Spatial Generative Primitive (SGP), a compact tuple of a high-quality panorama and a spatial point cloud that delivers an efficient description of any 3D space. Multimodal inputs are first lifted into this primitive; a 3D-consistent panoramic video generator then explores the primitive along a planned trajec

summary.core_problem: 把文本、图像、视频等输入统一转成可探索、可重建的 3D 世界。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 3D 生成系统。它尝试用统一的中间空间表示连接输入理解、视频生成和 3DGS 重建，对“世界模型”和跨模态生成接口有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是 Spatial Generative Primitive，一个由高质量全景图和空间点云组成的紧凑 tuple。系统先把多模态输入 lift 到 SGP；再用 3D-consistent panoramic video generator 沿规划轨迹探索该 primitive；最后通过 panoramic video reconstruction engine 转成 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting 世界。多视角或视频输入走几何恢复路径，单图或文本输入走生成补全路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调可覆盖 rich inputs 和 single image/text 两类 regime，并生成高保真、可探索 3DGS 世界；未提供模型参数、训练数据、baseline、用户研究或定量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to turn text, images, and videos into explorable 3D worlds through a unified world-modeling pipeline.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal 3D generation system contribution. Its main value is the intermediate representation that links input understanding, video generation, and 3DGS reconstruction. It is relevant to world-model interfaces, but only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central object is the Spatial Generative Primitive, a compact tuple consisting of a high-quality panorama and a spatial point cloud. Inputs are lifted into this primitive; a 3D-consistent panoramic video generator explores it along planned trajectories; a panoramic video reconstruction engine then converts the generated video into a clean photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting world. Rich inputs use geometry-grounded recovery, while a single image or text prompt is generatively completed.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims coverage of both rich-input and single-image/text regimes and high-fidelity explorable 3DGS outputs. It does not provide model size, training data, baselines, user studies, or quantitative gains in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 可作 3D world-model 接口备查；只读 SGP 表示设计即可，别把它当成语言模型范式信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for 3D world-model interfaces; read the SGP representation design, but do not treat it as an LM-paradigm signal.

paper.title: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in multi-step planning tasks, but existing approaches like LATS (Language Agent Tree Search) and ReAct rely heavily on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational costs and stochastic behavior. We present \textbf{GATS} (Graph-Augmented Tree Search), a planning framework that combines systematic UCB1-based tree search with a layered world model to eliminate LLM calls during inference while achieving superior planning performanc

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent规划方法（LATS、ReAct）在规划阶段过度依赖LLM推理，导致计算成本高、行为随机性强的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出结合树搜索与分层世界模型的Agent规划框架，在降低推理成本的同时提升规划成功率
summary.technical_approach: 原创GATS框架，三层世界模型分别为L1精确符号动作匹配、L2执行日志统计学习、L3未知动作的LLM预测，结合UCB1树搜索，推理时无需频繁调用LLM
summary.experiments: 合成规划任务上成功率100%（LATS为92%、ReAct为64%）；在覆盖编码、网页导航、长程任务的12种场景压力测试中保持100%成功率

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent planning methods such as LATS and ReAct rely excessively on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational cost and high stochasticity
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an agent planning framework combining tree search with layered world models, improving planning success rate while reducing inference cost
summary_en.technical_approach: Original GATS framework with a 3-layer world model: L1 exact symbolic action matching, L2 statistical learning from execution logs, L3 LLM-based prediction for unknown actions, paired with UCB1 tree search to minimize LLM calls during inference
summary_en.experiments: 100% success rate on synthetic planning tasks (92% for LATS, 64% for ReAct); maintains 100% success rate on 12-scenario stress tests covering coding, web navigation, and long-horizon tasks

recommendation.zh: Agent规划侧的增量改进，分层世界模型替代LLM调用的思路可参考，无需深读，作为方法库备查即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on agent planning; the layered world model design for reducing LLM calls is worth noting for reference only, no deep reading required

paper.title: Write-Protected Discrete Bottlenecks for Language-Grounded World Models: A Structural Limitation and Sufficient Fix
paper.abstract: How should language interface with a world model's discrete symbol system? The dominant paradigm -- end-to-end injection of LLM/VLM features into robot world models (RT-2, Octo, PaLM-E) -- implicitly assumes that language gradients can directly shape physical symbol representations. We ask whether this assumption is safe, find that it is not, and characterize the minimal architectural constraint that prevents the failure. Any language gradient entering a Gumbel-softmax-based discrete symbol bott

summary.core_problem: 当前具身世界模型普遍采用端到端方式把 LLM/VLM 特征注入离散符号瓶颈，默认语言梯度可以直接塑造物理符号表示；该工作验证这一假设在结构层面不成立，语言梯度穿过离散瓶颈时必然触发「符号坍缩」与「语义学习失败」的二选一困境。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：离散瓶颈（VQ、Gumbel-softmax 等）与梯度信号的交互存在结构性约束，不能默认「把任意模态的梯度灌进离散层就能同时学到好的离散表示与语义对齐」——这一结论不仅适用于机器人世界模型，也对语音/图像离散 tokenizer、统一多模态预训练中的离散接口设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 首先通过实验证明：无论 vanilla Gumbel-softmax 还是四种抗坍缩策略（高温、低学习率、谱归一化、熵奖励），都无法同时维持符号多样性和语义标签学习精度。随后提出三层最小修复方案：1）Gradient Cut：在离散符号瓶颈处切断语言梯度（z.detach()），只允许物理交互梯度塑造符号；2）Gradient-Free Semantic Channel：用非参数化的共现统计字典（symbol_id → 标签计数）建立符号与语言标签的绑定；3）Collision Resolution：用 DP-Means 流式聚类检测并拆分多标签共享同一符号的冲突。三者构成最小完备集，缺一不可。
summary.experiments: 共 74 次独立运行。实验 1 证明：物理交互本身比语言预训练能产生更好的符号；语言梯度进入离散瓶颈后，要么坍缩到 2.2/64 个符号，要么维持 4–17/64 的中等多样性但语义精度最高仅 9.2%（接近随机 2.8%）。实验 2 在三种编码器（CNN、V-JEPA 300M、CLIP ViT-L）、两种环境（网格世界、MuJoCo 3D 桌面）、三种纹理条件下验证：32 个 seed 全部零坍缩，语义绑定精度 79–100%，可训练参数少于 2M，LLM 仅作为外部调用者，不进入训练循环。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第 3 节的坍缩实验与诊断指标，理解「多样性-语义精度」此消彼长的具体表现；第 4 节三层修复方案的因果消融（每去掉一层会出现什么失败模式）是方法核心，约 15 分钟可读完；第 5 节跨设置验证部分可快速浏览图表。对离散 tokenizer 或多模态统一建模研究者，重点关注 Gumbel-softmax 在跨模态梯度下的失效机制。预计总阅读时间 40–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current embodied world models inject LLM/VLM features end-to-end into discrete symbol bottlenecks, implicitly assuming language gradients can directly shape physical symbol representations. This work shows the assumption is structurally unsound: language gradients passing through a discrete bottleneck force an unavoidable trade-off between symbol collapse and semantic learning failure.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the key takeaway is that discrete bottlenecks (VQ, Gumbel-softmax, etc.) have structural constraints in how they interact with gradient signals. One cannot assume backpropagating arbitrary multimodal gradients through a discrete layer will simultaneously yield good discrete representations and semantic alignment. The finding applies beyond robotics, with direct implications for speech/image discrete tokenizers and discrete interface design in unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, the paper empirically demonstrates that neither vanilla Gumbel-softmax nor four anti-collapse strategies (high temperature, low learning rate, spectral normalization, entropy bonus) can simultaneously maintain symbol diversity and semantic label accuracy. A minimal three-layer fix is then proposed, each layer validated by its failure mode when removed: (1) Gradient Cut: z.detach() blocks language gradients at the discrete bottleneck, letting only physical interaction gradients shape symbols. (2) Gradient-Free Semantic Channel: a non-parametric co-occurrence dictionary (symbol_id → label counter) binds symbols to language labels without backprop. (3) Collision Resolution: streaming DP-Means clustering detects and splits clusters where multiple labels share one symbol. The three layers form a minimal complete set — no subset of two suffices.
summary_en.experiments: 74 independent runs total. Experiment 1 shows physical interaction produces better symbols than language pretraining alone; once language gradients enter the discrete bottleneck, systems either collapse to 2.2/64 symbols or maintain 4–17/64 diversity but reach at most 9.2% semantic accuracy (barely above 2.8% chance). Experiment 2 validates across three encoders (CNN, V-JEPA 300M, CLIP ViT-L), two environments (grid world, MuJoCo 3D desktop), and three texture conditions: zero collapse across all 32 seeds, 79–100% semantic binding accuracy, fewer than 2M trainable parameters, with the LLM used only as an external caller outside the training loop.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 3's collapse experiments and diagnostic metrics to understand the diversity-accuracy trade-off. Section 4's causal ablations of the three-layer fix — which failure mode appears when each layer is removed — contain the core methodological insight; this section takes roughly 15 minutes. Section 5's cross-setting validation can be skimmed via figures and tables. Researchers working on discrete tokenizers or unified multimodal modeling should pay special attention to the failure mechanism of Gumbel-softmax under cross-modal gradients. Estimated total reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做统一多模态/离散tokenizer的可重点关注，核心结论是Gumbel瓶颈接语言梯度有结构性trade-off，直接看§3失效分析和§4约束设计即可。
recommendation.en: For unified multimodal/discrete tokenizer researchers, the structural trade-off of Gumbel bottlenecks with language gradients is non-trivial; read §3 failure analysis and §4 constraint design.

paper.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
paper.abstract: We present LingBot-World 2.0 (also known as LingBot-World-Infinity), an advanced iteration of LingBot-World featuring four distinct upgrades. (1) Our model achieves an unbounded interaction horizon while maintaining consistent output quality, benefiting from a carefully crafted causal pretraining paradigm. (2) Through distilling a real-time variant from the base model, our system guarantees rapid response time, sufficient to drive 720p video streams at 60 fps. (3) Compared to the previous versio

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：交互式世界模型在长时间自回归生成中容易漂移，同时高分辨率、低延迟、多动作交互很难兼顾。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和文本 LLM 预训练不是直接同一条线，但对多模态基座和世界模型预训练有参考意义。关键点有三个。第一，长时程 causal video generation 的稳定性问题类似语言模型长上下文和自回归误差累积，只是视觉域的错误更快显性化。第二，数据管线强调把异构视频转成带全局语义、局部状态、动作控制信号的训练样本，这对交互式视频预训练的数据组织方式有启发。第三，它把生成模型、实时蒸馏和 agentic harness 组合起来，说明世界模型不只是帧预测器，还需要外部控制、状态读取和事件调度机制才能形成可持续交互。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由四部分组成。第一是 causal world model 预训练，用因果方式逐帧或逐段生成，并针对长时间反馈误差设计训练范式，以提升生成稳定性。第二是数据引擎：原始视频来自自采第一视角视频、游戏和 Unreal Engine 合成数据、大规模网络视频；经过统一 metadata 规范、技术过滤、VLM profiling，再生成 video-level global captions 和 chunk-wise local captions。局部 caption 用于描述短时间状态变化、交互结果和控制敏感转移，全局 caption 提供场景语义上下文。第三是实时蒸馏：用较强的基础模型作为 teacher，蒸馏出可驱动 720p、60 fps 交互视频流的 student。第四是 agentic harness：pilot agent 根据当前画面选择角色动作，director agent 持续注入内容、道具、事件和环境变化，避免生成过程变成单调的被动漫游。
summary.experiments: 论文主张系统可以进行超过一小时的连续生成，视觉质量没有明显衰减，并支持 720p、60 fps 的实时交互。交互范围不只包括移动，还包括攻击、射箭、施法、射击，以及雨雪等文本驱动环境变化。对比表显示，已有开放或闭源世界模型通常稳定生成时间为分钟级，语义交互较少，动态程度有限；LingBot-World 2.0 的目标是小时级或无界交互，并保持开源和实时。可见的实验更偏系统验证和演示压力测试，量化指标细节需要重点核查，包括长时程质量如何度量、是否有自动指标、人工评测协议，以及蒸馏后相对 teacher 的质量损失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。优先看 introduction 中对长时程漂移和实时性的定义，再看 data pipeline，因为这部分最接近预训练研究：数据来源、过滤、VLM profiling、全局/局部 caption、动作信号如何对齐。若时间有限，蒸馏和 agentic harness 部分可以快速扫过，重点确认它们是系统工程贡献还是训练范式贡献。实验部分要带着两个问题读：一小时稳定生成是如何评估的；720p 60 fps 是单卡、多卡还是特定部署配置下实现的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in interactive world models: drift during long-horizon causal video generation, and the difficulty of maintaining high-resolution, low-latency, action-conditioned interaction.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal foundation models and world-model pretraining. The long-horizon stability issue is the visual analogue of autoregressive error accumulation, where small prediction errors are fed back into the model and become visible as texture smear, geometry distortion, or scene drift. The data pipeline is also informative: heterogeneous videos are converted into training examples with global semantics, local state descriptions, and control-sensitive transitions. This is a useful design pattern for interactive video pretraining. The agentic harness adds another lesson: a generative world model needs state inspection, action selection, and event scheduling to behave like an open-ended environment rather than a passive frame predictor.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines a causal video-generation backbone, a structured data engine, a real-time distilled student, and an agentic interaction layer. The data engine normalizes videos from self-collected egocentric footage, synthetic game and Unreal Engine environments, and web-scale video sources. It applies technical filtering and VLM-based profiling, then produces video-level global captions and chunk-level local captions. The local annotations describe state changes, interaction outcomes, and control-sensitive transitions; the global captions provide scene-level semantic context. The base model is trained with a causal pretraining paradigm intended to reduce feedback-induced drift. A smaller real-time variant is then distilled from the base model to support interactive 720p video at 60 fps. On top of the generator, a pilot agent chooses actions from the current scene, while a director agent injects new content, props, events, and environmental changes.
summary_en.experiments: The reported system-level result is an uninterrupted session exceeding one hour, with no visible quality decay, and real-time rendering at 720p and 60 fps. The action space includes navigation as well as attacks, archery, spell-casting, shooting, and text-driven weather or environment changes. The comparison table positions prior systems as mostly minute-scale, with limited semantic interaction and varying dynamic richness, while LingBot-World 2.0 targets hour-scale or unbounded interaction with open-source release and real-time operation. The visible evidence is mainly a stress test and qualitative/system comparison. The most important details to verify are the long-horizon evaluation protocol, any automatic or human quality metrics, the hardware used for 720p 60 fps serving, and the quality gap between the distilled model and the teacher.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand how the paper defines drift, interactivity, and real-time constraints. Then read the data pipeline carefully, since it is the part most relevant to pretraining: source mixture, filtering, VLM profiling, global and local captions, and action-signal alignment. The distillation and agentic harness sections can be read more selectively unless the deployment setup is of interest. In the experiments, focus on two checks: how the one-hour stability claim is measured, and what compute configuration is required for 720p 60 fps interaction.

recommendation.zh: 读 causal pretraining 和实时蒸馏部分；若评测干净，它会影响交互式世界模型的数据闭环设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the causal pretraining and distillation parts; if the eval is clean, it matters for interactive world-model data loops.

paper.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
paper.abstract: The future of World Models depends not only on scaling model capability, but also on scaling practicality and inference efficiency. High-frame-rate inference enables responsive perception, planning, and control in real-world autonomous systems. To this end, we present MoWorld, a cost-effective yet high-performance Flash World Model with an end-to-end framework spanning data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference, enabling up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic

summary.core_problem: 面向真实交互系统，构建能以较低成本实现高帧率推理的视觉世界模型。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在多模态生成和世界模型工程链路：把数据生成、预训练、蒸馏和高效推理放在同一套框架里优化，目标不是单纯提高视频质量，而是让世界模型具备接近实时交互能力。
summary.technical_approach: MoWorld 使用可扩展的 3D-native 数据引擎，而不是主要依赖大规模自然视频语料；该数据引擎从 3D 视觉和生成建模流水线中构造几何一致的训练数据。系统还包含预训练、蒸馏和推理优化，以在普通硬件上提升交互帧率。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称可达到最高 50 FPS 的实时交互，并保持电影级视觉质量，且不依赖高端 GPU。给出的信息未包含模型参数量、训练数据规模、具体 baseline、消融结果或量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets practical visual world models that can run at high frame rates for real-time interaction.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an engineering-oriented multimodal generation pipeline: data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference are optimized jointly for deployable world modeling rather than only visual fidelity.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoWorld relies on a scalable 3D-native data engine instead of primarily using large-scale video corpora. The engine produces geometrically consistent training data from a 3D vision and generative modeling pipeline, followed by pre-training, distillation, and inference optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic visual quality without high-end GPUs. It does not provide model size, data scale, detailed baselines, ablations, or numerical gains in the supplied text.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据引擎和蒸馏链路即可；它像世界模型工程报告，对语言预训练没有直接方法增益。
recommendation.en: Skim only the data engine and distillation pipeline; this is closer to a world-model engineering report than a direct signal for LM pretraining.

paper.title: WorldBagel: Uncovering the Power of Unified Multimodal Models for Vision-Language-Action-World Modeling
paper.abstract: World models aim to capture environment dynamics in ways that support perception, reasoning, and action, and have recently become a central direction in Vision-Language-Action-World (VLAW) modeling. Meanwhile, unified vision-language models have demonstrated strong multimodal generation capabilities, yet their potential as world models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce \texttt{WorldBagel}, a unified VLAW framework built on BAGEL, a modern multimodal unified model, and use it to s

summary.core_problem: 现有研究存在两条割裂的路线：世界模型侧重视觉动力学建模但未深度融合语言与大规模多模态知识，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型侧重动作预测但未显式建模环境动力学；同时，BAGEL这类双塔结构的统一多模态模型，能否作为通用的视觉-语言-动作-世界（VLAW）基座、如何适配具身建模需求，缺乏系统验证与方案。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发包括：统一多模态预训练的双塔（理解+生成）专家架构，可直接扩展到具身世界建模场景，无需新增动作专属模块；连续动作的傅里叶token化、异构多模态数据的自适应重加权（借鉴自LLM预训练）两类设计，可迁移到通用具身多模态基座的训练流程；统一建模确实能提升分布偏移下的表征鲁棒性，为具身多模态的scaling策略提供实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 基于BAGEL的双塔（UND理解专家+GEN生成专家）架构扩展出WorldBagel，核心改动有三点：1）傅里叶特征动作tokenizer：将连续控制信号映射到共享多模态token空间，复用现有双塔路由机制处理动作相关任务，不新增动作专家；2）交错序列计划建模：将视觉观测、语言指令、动作token、未来帧预测按多种随机采样的顺序组织为自回归序列，联合完成多目标训练；3）自适应数据集重加权：借鉴多模态预训练的采样策略，稳定异构机器人多任务数据的训练过程，提升跨任务鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 在LIBERO、Language Table、Franka三个机器人操作基准上完成验证：1）多任务操作表现优于多种强VLA基线；2）傅里叶动作模块提升动作预测准确率，特征值谱分析验证其动作嵌入的结构更规整、信息量更高；3）在动作动力学分布偏移的测试场景下，未来世界状态预测更稳定，表征的结构丰富度优于任务专属模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分的傅里叶动作tokenizer设计、序列计划的采样规则，以及第4节的分布偏移实验与表征分析内容；可跳过原BAGEL架构的底层实现细节。预计阅读时间25-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Two research lines remain disconnected: world models focus on visual dynamics modeling but barely integrate language or large-scale multimodal knowledge, while vision-language-action (VLA) models prioritize action prediction without explicit environment dynamics modeling. Meanwhile, there is no systematic validation or framework for adapting dual-tower unified multimodal models (such as BAGEL) as general vision-language-action-world (VLAW) bases for embodied scenarios.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three transferable insights: dual-expert (understanding + generation) unified multimodal pretraining architectures can be extended to embodied world modeling without dedicated action modules; Fourier-based continuous action tokenization and adaptive heterogeneous data reweighting (borrowed from LLM pretraining) are applicable to general embodied multimodal foundation model training; unified modeling improves representation robustness under distribution shifts, providing empirical support for scaling strategies of embodied multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldBagel extends BAGEL's two-tower (UND understanding expert + GEN generation expert) architecture with three core modifications: 1) A Fourier feature action tokenizer maps continuous control signals to the shared multimodal token space, reusing existing tower routing for action-related tasks without adding an extra action expert; 2) An interleaved sequence-plan framework organizes observations, language instructions, action tokens, and future frame predictions into autoregressive sequences with multiple randomly sampled orderings for joint multi-objective training; 3) An adaptive dataset reweighting strategy adapted from multimodal pretraining stabilizes training on heterogeneous multi-task robotic corpora and improves cross-task robustness.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three robotic manipulation benchmarks (LIBERO, Language Table, Franka): 1) Multi-task manipulation performance surpasses multiple strong VLA baselines; 2) The Fourier action module improves action prediction accuracy, with eigenvalue spectrum analysis confirming more structured and informative action embeddings; 3) Under test scenarios with shifted action dynamics, the model produces more stable future world state predictions and retains richer representation structure than task-specific alternatives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Methodology) for the Fourier action tokenizer design and sequence-plan sampling rules, plus Section 4's distribution shift experiments and representation analysis. Skip low-level implementation details of the original BAGEL architecture. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 统一多模态建模向具身世界模型延伸的实证，关注§4中统一架构vs任务拆分的消融即可。
recommendation.en: Empirical study extending unified multimodal modeling to embodied world models; focus on §4 ablations comparing unification vs. task-specific splits.

paper.title: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni Technical Report
paper.abstract: General-purpose embodied agents must understand multimodal instructions, anticipate how their environment will evolve, and produce precise control actions over extended horizons. Existing approaches typically specialize in visual-language reasoning, video-based world modeling, or action generation, while cascaded pipelines that first synthesize future observations and then infer actions can introduce interface bottlenecks and compound prediction errors. We present iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni, a unifie

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告想解决具身模型里语义理解、未来状态预测和动作生成割裂的问题，尤其是级联式“先生成未来视频、再用逆动力学推动作”带来的接口瓶颈和误差累积。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态建模，而不是纯机器人控制。它把图像、视频、语言和动作放进一个共享注意力框架中训练，说明“动作”可以被当作一种可生成模态，与视觉世界模型和语言规划共同对齐。对做跨模态预训练的人，值得关注的是三点：一是动作标注数据和无动作 embodied video 如何混合；二是视频生成目标如何为动作策略提供环境动态信号；三是为什么保留模态专用模块，同时用共享 self-attention 做信息交换，而不是把所有 token 简单拼在一起建模。论文更偏系统整合，预训练范式上的新意有限，但方向和训练 recipe 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 模型被组织成一个 Omni 框架。VLM 和 VGM 被称为高层“brain”，负责语言指令理解、任务规划、进度跟踪和未来视觉状态预测；AGM 被称为低层“cerebellum”，负责把计划或子目标转成动作 chunk。关键设计不是把视频模型、视觉语言模型和动作模型串成流水线，而是让它们在共享 multimodal self-attention 中通信。这样 AGM 可以直接读取语言语义、当前视觉上下文和世界预测相关表示，不必依赖一个显式生成出来的未来图像作为中间接口。论文强调保留各模态专用表示，因为语言、视频和动作的抽象层级、时间粒度、训练目标差异很大；如果完全统一 token 和目标，容易让表示对齐变弱。训练上使用多源混合数据，包括带动作标注的具身视频、无动作具身视频、具身推理与感知数据，以及通用图文数据。训练流程是四阶段：先分别强化 VLM、VGM、AGM 的能力，再做整体联合微调，使理解、世界建模和动作生成逐步对齐。
summary.experiments: 报告给出的关键结果集中在具身操作基准。模型在 zero-shot LIBERO-Plus 上达到 89.6% 平均成功率；在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，Clean 设置为 93.68%，Rand 设置为 93.16%。这些数字支持一个判断：共享上下文下的规划、未来状态预测和动作生成，对多阶段任务和随机扰动场景有帮助。材料中没有给出可核验的模型参数量、各数据源 token 或 episode 规模、训练算力和完整消融数字，因此不宜把结果解读为清晰的 scaling 结论。更应把它看作一个统一 embodied multimodal pretraining recipe：动作生成不是附在 VLM 后面的 policy head，而是参与共享上下文建模的生成模块。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。建议先看 Introduction 中对 VLA、WAM 和级联 pipeline 的问题定义，明确它要避免的接口瓶颈。随后看模型架构图和方法部分，重点关注 VLM/VGM/AGM 如何通过共享 self-attention 连接，以及 AGM 输入中是否使用显式未来帧或隐式上下文表示。训练部分值得看数据混合和四阶段流程，尤其是 action-free video 如何服务于动作模型。实验部分重点看 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0，以及是否有去掉 VGM、去掉共享注意力、改成级联动作推断的消融。如果没有充分消融，结论应限制在系统设计有效性，而不是证明某个建模范式更优。
summary.authors_note: 机构可从标题判断为 iFLYTEK；给定材料未提供完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The report addresses the fragmentation between semantic instruction understanding, future-state prediction, and action generation in embodied models, with a particular focus on avoiding the bottlenecks of cascaded video-to-action pipelines.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in unified multimodal modeling rather than robotics as a downstream task. The work treats actions as a generative modality that can be aligned with language, images, and videos under a shared attention context. For pretraining researchers, the useful parts are the modality mixture, the staged training recipe, and the decision to keep modality-specialized components while allowing information exchange through shared multimodal self-attention. The contribution is more of a system-level integration than a new language modeling objective, but it is informative for native multimodal pretraining that includes control signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni combines a vision-language model, a video generation model, and an action generation model within one Omni framework. The VLM and VGM act as a high-level module for instruction understanding, task planning, progress tracking, and future visual prediction. The AGM serves as a low-level action generator that emits executable action chunks. The main design choice is to avoid a hard cascade where a future video is first generated and an inverse dynamics model then recovers actions. Instead, the action model directly consumes the shared multimodal context. This lets action generation condition on semantic intent and world-dynamics representations without depending on a rendered future frame as an intermediate interface. Training uses a multi-source mixture of action-annotated embodied videos, action-free embodied videos, embodied perception and reasoning data, and general image-text data. A four-stage schedule first specializes the VLM, VGM, and AGM, then jointly fine-tunes the full system.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are mainly on embodied manipulation benchmarks. The model achieves an average zero-shot success rate of 89.6% on LIBERO-Plus. On RoboTwin 2.0, it reaches 93.68% in the Clean setting and 93.16% in the Rand setting. These results suggest that coupling semantic planning, world prediction, and action generation can help long-horizon execution and robustness to randomized settings. The provided material does not include enough verifiable detail on model size, data scale, compute, or full ablations, so the numbers should not be read as a scaling-law result. The safer takeaway is the training and architectural recipe for including actions in a unified multimodal pretraining stack.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand the stated gap between VLA models, world-action models, and cascaded video-to-action systems. Then inspect the architecture section for how VLM, VGM, and AGM communicate through shared self-attention. The training section is the most relevant part for pretraining researchers: focus on the data mixture and the four-stage schedule, especially how action-free embodied videos are used. In the experiments, look for ablations that remove the video model, remove shared attention, or replace the direct AGM with a cascaded inverse-dynamics setup. Without such ablations, the evidence should be treated as support for the integrated system rather than a definitive comparison of modeling paradigms.
summary_en.authors_note: The title indicates iFLYTEK as the institution; the provided material does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 多模态统一预训练的具身模型技术报告，共享自注意力的跨模态融合设计值得参考，读架构章节即可。
recommendation.en: Technical report on unified multimodal embodied pretraining; shared self-attention cross-modal fusion design is worth referencing, read only the architecture section.

paper.title: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
paper.abstract: World models are rapidly becoming a core infrastructure for embodied intelligence and interactive agents: they provide controllable simulators in which agents can perceive, act, forecast, and acquire scalable experience. Yet current video generation world models are still organized around isolated control interfaces, such as camera trajectories, robot actions, or hand-joint signals. This fragmentation is increasingly a scaling bottleneck. The central challenge is not the absence of controllable

summary.core_problem: 如何把相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节等“异构控制信号”统一到同一个可扩展的世界模型里，而不是为每种控制单独训练/适配一个生成模型。
summary.importance: 属于“可控生成世界模型”的统一接口问题：用统一建模吸收多种 action supervision，减少控制接口碎片化带来的 scaling 瓶颈；对做多模态/生成式 world model 的预训练配方与路由设计有参考价值，但对纯文本 LLM 预训练关联中等。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Worldscape-MoE：以 Diffusion Transformer 为骨干，在控制侧引入 Mixture-of-Experts，把不同控制类型视作对同一潜在世界动力学的不同约束；通过 MoE 路由把异构控制映射到共享生成主干上，实现可扩展的“多控制统一训练”。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确的模型规模、数据规模、对比基线与量化提升幅度；仅能确认其在“异构控制条件下的视频/世界生成”场景做验证，并强调可扩展性与统一控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify heterogeneous control signals (camera trajectories, robot actions, hand joints, etc.) into a single scalable world model, instead of training separate controllable generators per interface.
summary_en.importance: Targets the interface fragmentation bottleneck in controllable generative world models: a unified learning framework that can absorb diverse action supervision while sharing world dynamics. Moderately relevant to foundation-model pretraining researchers, more so for multimodal/world-model pretraining than text-only LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Worldscape-MoE: a Diffusion Transformer backbone with a Mixture-of-Experts control mechanism, treating different controls as different constraints over shared underlying dynamics; MoE routing maps heterogeneous controls into a shared generative core for scalable multi-control training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains; it only indicates validation on controllable video/world-model generation with heterogeneous controls and claims improved scalability/unification.

recommendation.zh: 把“多控制接口”问题用 MoE 路由统一到 diffusion world model 上，思路对做统一条件建模的人有用；但摘要缺关键实验细节，先看路由/训练目标再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: MoE-routing as a unification layer for heterogeneous controls in diffusion world models is a useful design pattern; however, the abstract lacks critical experimental specifics—skim routing/training objective first.

paper.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
paper.abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, t

summary.core_problem: 现有单玩家世界模型将其他智能体视为环境一部分，无法处理多智能体强耦合物理交互下的动态场景建模与长时序一致性。
summary.importance: 范式创新+规模突破，首次提出多人交互式世界模型，验证了5B级潜扩散模型在多智能体动态场景下的实时生成与长时域稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 构建条件于多智能体动作流的5B参数潜扩散模型，基于公开bot采集的Rocket League游戏数据训练，将场景变化归因到对应玩家以保证任意动作组合下的一致性。
summary.experiments: 5B参数模型，训练数据为10000小时公开bot采集的游戏对局；单张Nvidia B200 GPU上可20fps生成4人比赛画面；仅用短片段训练但rollout分布质量稳定到5分钟，实际可连续运行数小时无明显漂移。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-player world models treat other agents as part of the environment, failing to model tightly coupled physical interactions and maintain long-horizon coherence across multiple agents in highly dynamic scenes.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation + scale breakthrough: first multiplayer interactive world model, validating real-time generation and long-horizon stability of a 5B-parameter latent diffusion model for multi-agent dynamic scenes.
summary_en.technical_approach: A 5B-parameter latent diffusion model conditioned on action streams of multiple agents, trained on Rocket League gameplay data collected by public bots, which attributes scene changes to corresponding players to ensure coherence under arbitrary action combinations.
summary_en.experiments: 5B parameters trained on 10,000 hours of public bot-collected gameplay; generates 4-player matches at 20 FPS on a single Nvidia B200 GPU; trained only on short clips but maintains stable distributional quality up to 5 minutes of rollout, with practical rollouts lasting hours without obvious drift.

recommendation.zh: 纯世界模型领域工作，长时序rollout稳定性观测可作为扩散预训练长程建模的弱参考，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Pure world model work; long-horizon rollout stability observation serves as weak reference for diffusion pretraining long-range modeling, no need to read full text.

paper.title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
paper.abstract: We present WorldDirector, a highly controllable video world model framework designed for persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration. Unlike existing world models that entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and rely on continuous visual observation to sustain motion, our framework explicitly decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation. By leveraging an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories with camera movements and subsequently employing these

summary.core_problem: 解决视频世界模型在长事件生成中难以保持动态物体身份、离屏后再出现不稳定、视角探索受限的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成系统创新。它把语义级运动编排从像素生成中拆出来，用 LLM 组织 3D 轨迹和相机运动，再把轨迹作为视频生成控制信号；对世界模型和长程视频生成有方法参考，但不是 LLM 基座训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: WorldDirector 显式解耦 physical dynamics 与 pixel rendering：先由 LLM 协调动态实体的 3D 轨迹和相机运动，形成可执行的语义运动计划；再将这些轨迹输入视频生成模块，作为强控制条件。这样避免依赖持续视觉观测来维持运动状态，并尝试让离屏对象重新入镜时保持身份一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法支持复杂长事件合成、不受限视角探索、动态对象持久记忆和外观身份稳定；未提供模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名称或定量指标。项目页存在，但摘要没有足够实验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon video world models that fail to preserve dynamic object identity, lose objects after they leave the view, and restrict camera exploration.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generation system design. It separates semantic motion orchestration from pixel rendering by using an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories and camera motion, then feeds those trajectories as controls to video generation. This is relevant to world-model design but not directly to LLM base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldDirector explicitly decouples physical dynamics from visual rendering. An LLM first produces coordinated 3D trajectories for dynamic entities and camera movement; these trajectories then condition a video generator. The design avoids relying on continuous visual observation to maintain state and aims to preserve entity identity after long out-of-view intervals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims support for complex extended events, unrestricted viewpoint exploration, persistent dynamic object memory, and stable appearance identity. It does not report model size, training-data scale, named baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 读系统图和轨迹控制部分就够；它对“LLM 做世界模型状态层”有参考，但证据强度取决于项目页实验细节。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and trajectory-control design; the useful signal is the LLM-as-state-layer idea, while the evidence depends on details beyond the abstract.

paper.title: OPINE-World: Programmatic World Modeling with Ontology-error-Prioritized Interactive Exploration
paper.abstract: Learning how an environment behaves from interaction is central to building agents that adapt to unfamiliar tasks. World models learned with deep networks are flexible but data-hungry and transfer poorly beyond their training distribution. Program-synthesized world models, written as source code by LLMs and refined through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS), are instead data-efficient and reusable, yet they have been demonstrated mainly on structured-state worlds with a given obje

summary.core_problem: 现有程序化世界模型仅适用于有给定对象词汇的结构化状态环境，无法扩展到需要灵活假设对象结构的像素渲染环境
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出双协作Agent的在线程序化世界建模框架，支持像素级环境的对象中心式世界模型学习
summary.technical_approach: 采用双协作Agent的假设-测试循环：交互Agent在环境中行动探索，模型合成Agent以代码形式生成世界模型，通过回放验证和基于模型的规划迭代优化，并以本体错误优先级引导探索方向
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验设置与量化结果，仅阐述了方法框架与设计思路

summary_en.core_problem: Existing programmatic world models only work for structured-state environments with a given object vocabulary, and cannot scale to pixel-rendered environments where object structures must be flexibly hypothesized.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a dual-agent online programmatic world modeling framework that supports object-centric world model learning for pixel-level environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts a hypothesis-test loop with two cooperating agents: an interaction agent explores the environment, and a synthesis agent generates the world model in code, iterates via replay verification and model-based planning, and steers exploration with ontology-error prioritization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide complete experimental setup or quantitative results, only describing the method framework and design rationale.

recommendation.zh: 程序化世界建模的思路有一定新意，但属于Agent领域的细分方向，与预训练关联度较低。
recommendation.en: The programmatic world modeling idea has some novelty, but it is a niche agent research direction with low relevance to pretraining.

paper.title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
paper.abstract: As agent planning moves from short tool chains toward persistent workflows with thousands or tens of thousands of steps, failures will occur inside large planning graphs rather than in isolated predictions. Replanning the entire graph after every mistake is neither computationally realistic nor desirable: full-graph replay consumes large context budgets, exposes the LLM to many irrelevant symptoms, and can degrade long-context retrieval. This paper studies the missing component in such systems:

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 规划图中局部失败后，全图重规划开销大、上下文占用高且易引入噪声，缺乏原位修复机制。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出世界模型子图放大修复范式，区别于传统基于症状扫描的局部修复工程方案，面向万步级长程规划场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WM-SAR，不扫描可见错误症状，而是通过子图放大机制定位规划图中世界模型假设失真的根因区域，针对性修复而非处理表面症状；对比两类修复器：工程化局部扫描修复与根因导向的子图放大修复。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据集与量化指标，仅提及工程化 LLM 修复器在大上下文下有一定帮助，WM-SAR 为其提出的替代方案。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon agent planning graphs with thousands to tens of thousands of steps, full-graph replanning after local failures is computationally expensive, context-heavy, and noise-prone, with no in-place correction mechanism available.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a world-model subgraph amplification repair paradigm for root-cause-oriented planning graph correction, targeting ten-thousand-step long-horizon workflows and departing from symptom-scanning engineering correctors.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces WM-SAR, which avoids scanning visible failure symptoms and instead amplifies subgraphs to locate root regions where the world-model assumptions break, repairing causes rather than surface artifacts; benchmarks against two corrector families: engineered local-scan correctors and the proposed root-cause method.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose model sizes, datasets, or quantitative metrics; only notes engineered LLM correctors help under large context windows, with WM-SAR presented as an alternative approach.

recommendation.zh: 长程 Agent 规划修复的新视角，但实验披露不足，作为方向信号备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: A fresh angle on long-horizon planning repair, but experimental disclosure is insufficient; treat as directional signal, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
paper.abstract: Mobile manipulation is a key capability for general-purpose robots, yet remains challenging for current embodied learning methods. VLA policies are typically reactive and lack explicit world modeling, while existing World Action Models (WAMs) are still poorly aligned with the structure of mobile manipulation: they operate on coarse video chunks, model entangled navigation-manipulation actions, and train inverse dynamics under supervision that does not match autoregressive inference. As a result,

summary.core_problem: 移动操作机器人中的 world action model 如何同时处理导航与精细接触操作，并减少长程自回归 rollout 的误差累积。
summary.importance: 这是具身智能/机器人 world model 方法论文，和 LLM 基座研究的交集在于动作 token、视频 latent、world model 与自回归训练-推理一致性。贡献偏机器人系统，不应按通用 LLM 预训练论文处理。
summary.technical_approach: ABot-M0.5 强调三类对齐：时间粒度、动作空间、训练-推理一致性。方法引入 intermediate latent actions 表示局部视觉状态转移，作为 video latents 与真实 embodied actions 之间的桥接空间；同时试图区分导航与操作动作，避免 action distribution conflict，并让 inverse dynamics 的监督形式更接近自回归推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、机器人平台、任务集或成功率提升。实验应围绕移动操作长程 rollout、接触动态建模和误差累积展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a world action model for mobile manipulation can handle both navigation and fine-grained contact manipulation while reducing error accumulation in long autoregressive rollouts.
summary_en.importance: This is an embodied AI and robotics world-model paper. Its connection to LLM pretraining lies in action tokens, video latents, world modeling, and train-inference consistency for autoregressive prediction. The main contribution remains robotics-oriented.
summary_en.technical_approach: ABot-M0.5 frames the problem as alignment along temporal granularity, action space, and train-test consistency. It introduces intermediate latent actions that capture local visual state transitions and bridge video latents with embodied actions. It also aims to disentangle navigation and manipulation actions and align inverse-dynamics supervision with autoregressive inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter count, training data scale, robot platform, task suite, or success-rate gains. The evaluation likely targets long-horizon mobile manipulation, contact dynamics, and rollout error accumulation.

recommendation.zh: 机器人味较重，但 latent action 作为视频到动作的中间 token 值得记；不要把成功率当通用结论。
recommendation.en: Robotics-heavy, but the intermediate latent-action bridge from video to action is worth noting; do not generalize the success rates blindly.

paper.title: ForgeDrive: Bidirectional Cross-Conditioning for Unified Visual-Action Generation in Autonomous Driving
paper.abstract: World-model-based autonomous driving endows the model with the ability to understand scene evolution. Yet this promise is undermined by the prevailing imagine-then-act paradigm, which allows errors from the more challenging visual generation stage to cascade into action planning. We introduce ForgeDrive, a unified autoregressive diffusion framework with visual-action cross-conditioning that closes this gap through act-then-imagine paradigm. ForgeDrive factorizes the future as a sequence of per-t

summary.core_problem: 解决自动驾驶世界模型中先生成视觉未来、再进行动作规划时，视觉生成误差向规划阶段级联的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是领域化的多模态生成范式改造。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但“视觉-动作联合建模”和“AR + diffusion”的耦合方式可作为统一多模态生成建模的弱参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ForgeDrive，将未来分解为逐时间步的 frame-action pair，并用统一自回归扩散框架进行双向 cross-conditioning。训练时解耦图像和动作两个模态的 diffusion timestep，并引入 UniDiffuser-style noise scheduler，使模型可以从动作推视觉，也可以从视觉推动作；推理时采用 act-then-imagine，先生成动作再补全对应视觉观测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、数据规模、baseline 名称或具体指标。可确认的实验结论是作者声称动作生成能力可在训练中内化，并通过 act-then-imagine 推理减少 imagine-then-act 的误差传播。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles error cascading in autonomous-driving world models where visual futures are imagined first and then used for action planning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a domain-specific multimodal generation formulation. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but its coupled visual-action modeling and AR-plus-diffusion setup are a useful weak signal for unified multimodal generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForgeDrive factorizes the future into per-timestep frame-action pairs and trains a unified autoregressive diffusion model with bidirectional cross-conditioning. It decouples diffusion timesteps across image and action modalities and uses a UniDiffuser-style noise scheduler to infer either modality from the other. At inference, it switches to an act-then-imagine procedure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter count, training data size, baselines, or quantitative gains. The main reported finding is that action generation can be internalized during training and that act-then-imagine reduces error propagation from visual generation.

recommendation.zh: 只看建模分解即可：frame-action pair 的 AR+diffusion 设计有借鉴，驾驶实验别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the factorization: the frame-action AR-plus-diffusion design is useful, but the driving-domain results should not be over-generalized.

paper.title: World-Model Collapse as a Phase Transition
paper.abstract: Water looks unchanged as it warms, then at a critical point it boils. We ask whether long-horizon language agents show an analogous transition in their implicit world models. In some parameter settings, changing state load by a small amount, or adding a single step of horizon, leaves behavior nearly unchanged; near a critical boundary, the same small change causes a sudden world collapse. We study this effect in a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold state. A large grid search over

summary.core_problem: 研究长程语言 Agent 的隐式世界模型是否会在状态负载或任务 horizon 小幅增加时出现突然崩塌。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可测量现象提出。它把长程 Agent 失败从平均性能下降改写为相变式边界问题，并区分世界状态保真度与动作合法性两个层面的失败。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造一个确定性任务族，带有精确的逐步 gold state。通过网格搜索状态基数、依赖密度、horizon、branching、观测模式和 mutation rate，绘制 solved plateau、transition band 和 collapse floor 组成的 phase diagram。逐步 trace 用于判断错误先出现在状态维护还是动作选择。
summary.experiments: 实验采用可控合成任务而非真实开放环境。摘要称大规模网格搜索发现窄转移带；逐步轨迹显示 world-state fidelity 先于 action validity 下降；更强模型可以移动临界边界，但不能消除这种定性相变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-horizon language agents undergo abrupt implicit world-model collapse when state load or horizon increases slightly.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic analysis and a measurable failure phenomenon. It reframes long-horizon agent degradation as a phase-boundary problem and separates world-state fidelity from action validity.
summary_en.technical_approach: It builds a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold states. A grid search varies state cardinality, dependency density, horizon, branching, observation mode, and mutation rate to produce a phase diagram with a solved plateau, a narrow transition band, and a collapse floor. Per-step traces are used to identify whether errors first appear in state maintenance or action choice.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use controlled synthetic tasks rather than open-ended real environments. The abstract reports a narrow transition band, state-fidelity failure before action-validity failure, and stronger models shifting the critical boundary without removing the qualitative transition.

recommendation.zh: 读 phase diagram 和 per-step trace；toy setup 不能外推太远，但它给长程 Agent 失败一个可复现实验形状。
recommendation.en: Read the phase diagram and per-step traces; the toy setup limits extrapolation, but it gives long-horizon agent failure a reproducible shape.

paper.title: Orca: The World is in Your Mind
paper.abstract: We introduce Orca, an initial instantiation of a general world foundation model. Orca learns a unified world latent space from multimodal world signals and exposes it through multimodal readout interfaces. Rather than optimizing isolated next-token, next-frame, or next-action prediction, we are centered on Next-State-Prediction modeling, offering a unified state-transition modeling route toward understanding, predicting, and acting upon the world. Orca learns through two complementary paradigms:

summary.core_problem: 论文试图把“世界建模”从 next-token/next-frame/next-action 这些各自为政的预测任务，统一到 next-state prediction：学习一个可跨模态读出的世界潜状态 S，并建模其在隐式动力学与显式条件（如指令）下的状态转移。核心问题是：能否用大规模视频与事件级语言监督，学到一个可扩展的 world latent space，使得在冻结 backbone 的情况下，通过轻量 readout 就能完成文本、图像与动作等多种输出。
summary.importance:
对 LLM 预训练研究的启发点在“范式”而不在可复现的 recipe：它把预训练目标从 token 级生成推进到状态空间建模，并明确区分两类训练信号——无标注的密集状态转移（unconscious learning）与带语言约束的稀疏事件转移（conscious learning）。这与近期把 AR LM 扩展到统一多模态/世界模型的趋势一致，也与“latent variable + transition”类建模（视频 world model、行动条件生成、以及部分 diffusion/flow 的状态演化视角）在概念上相通。

但从全文片段看，它更像一个宏大系统设想 + 大数据工程 + 探针式 readout 证明，而不是直接给出可迁移到纯文本 LLM 的优化器/损失/数据配比结论。若关注“预训练目标如何组织多模态信号”“冻结 backbone、用 readout 验证表征质量”的研究者，会更有收获。
summary.technical_approach:
Orca 将世界信号 X（当前版本主要是视觉与语言）编码为潜状态 S=f_θ(X)，并学习状态在时间上的前向/后向演化：S_{>t} 或 S_{<t}，同时引入两类因素：
- z_t：不可观测的隐式动力学（物理规律、对象属性、场景动力等）。
- c_t：可观测的显式条件（人类指令/语言约束）。

训练上分两条互补路径：
1) Unconscious learning：从连续视频中学习“密集自然转移”，用自监督方式预测下一时刻的 latent（类似把视频当作状态序列，做 latent-level 的 next-step prediction）。重点是覆盖大量无标注转移，逼迫表征吸收动力学。
2) Conscious learning：用语言描述的事件与 VQA 监督学习“稀疏但有语义的转移”，把状态变化与决策/任务结果对齐。

读出层（Decoder/readout）覆盖文本、图像、动作，但作者刻意把它定位为 probing：预训练 backbone 冻结，只训练轻量 readout，用来回答“world latent 是否随规模变强、是否能支撑多种输出”。这点与常见端到端多模态生成（直接追任务指标）不同：它更强调表征与状态空间作为统一接口。
summary.experiments:
数据与规模信息（摘要与正文片段明确给出）：
- 预训练数据：125K 小时视频 + 1.6 亿事件标注（event annotations），覆盖多种场景（自我视角交互、第三视角操作、机器人执行、事件级转移）。
- 结论型结果：训练损失随模型规模与数据规模继续下降；冻结 backbone 后，文本生成、交互式图像预测、具身动作生成等 readout 能力随预训练规模提升而提升；在“可比规模”下优于若干专用基线。

但当前提供的全文片段缺少关键可核对的细节数字：具体模型参数量分档、训练 token/帧数、各 readout 的定量指标与提升幅度、以及 unconscious vs conscious 的消融贡献。要做严肃复盘需要把实验章节的表格与附录补齐后再判断其工程可迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 先读方法总览图与公式定义：S、z_t、c_t、前向/后向预测各自对应什么训练任务，避免停留在口号。
2) 重点看两种学习范式的具体实现：unconscious 的预测目标是在像素、离散 token 还是 latent；conscious 的事件标注如何组织成条件与监督。
3) 实验部分优先核对三件事：
- scaling：loss/能力随模型与数据的曲线是否平滑、是否有拐点；
- probing 设计：冻结 backbone 的 readout 训练预算是否公平，是否排除了“readout 太强掩盖 backbone”的可能；
- 消融：去掉 conscious 或 unconscious 后，哪些能力掉得最明显。

如果时间有限，只看：数据构成与标注定义 + scaling 曲线 + 冻结 readout 的对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes to unify disparate prediction paradigms (next-token / next-frame / next-action) into next-state prediction: learn a latent world state space S from multimodal signals and model state transitions under implicit dynamics and explicit conditions (e.g., language instructions). The key question is whether large-scale video plus event-level language supervision can produce a scalable world latent that supports multiple downstream readouts (text, image, action) with a frozen backbone and lightweight decoders.
summary_en.importance:
Its value to LLM pretraining researchers is mainly paradigm-level: it reframes pretraining around state-space representation and transitions, and explicitly separates two supervision regimes—dense unlabeled transitions vs. sparse semantically meaningful event transitions. This aligns with broader trends toward unified multimodal/world models and latent-transition modeling.

However, it is less about transferable training recipes (optimizer, data mixture for text LMs, tokenizer choices, stability tricks) and more about a large system + data inventory + probing-style validation. Readers interested in how to organize multimodal pretraining objectives and how to evaluate representation quality via frozen-backbone readouts will get the most out of it.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Orca encodes world signals X (in this version, primarily vision and language) into a latent state S = f_θ(X), and learns forward/backward evolution of states over time. Two factors are introduced:
- z_t for unobserved/implicit dynamics (physics, object properties, scene dynamics).
- c_t for observed/explicit conditions (instructions).

Training uses two complementary paradigms:
1) Unconscious learning: self-supervised learning from continuous videos to capture dense natural transitions, implemented as predicting next-step latents (latent-level temporal prediction rather than explicit semantic supervision).
2) Conscious learning: instruction- and event-conditioned learning using language-described events and VQA supervision to model sparse but meaningful transitions tied to decisions and outcomes.

A notable design choice is evaluation via readouts: the backbone is frozen during decoder post-training, and only lightweight readout modules are trained for text/image/action outputs. This positions the decoders as probes of the learned world latent rather than task-optimized generators.
summary_en.experiments:
Confirmed scale/data from the provided content:
- Pretraining inventory: 125K hours of video and 160M event annotations, spanning egocentric interaction, exocentric manipulation, robot execution, and event-level transitions.
- Reported qualitative conclusions: training losses keep decreasing with model/data scale; frozen-backbone readouts for text generation, interactive image prediction, and embodied action generation improve with scaling; at comparable scale, Orca outperforms specialized baselines.

What is not verifiable from the current excerpt (and should be checked in the full experimental section/appendix): exact parameter scales, compute budget, metrics per readout task, absolute/relative gains, and ablations isolating unconscious vs. conscious learning contributions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the framework figure and the formal definition of S, z_t, c_t, and forward/backward prediction to avoid staying at the slogan level.
- Read the concrete objective implementations: whether unconscious learning predicts pixels, discrete tokens, or latents; how conscious learning structures event annotations into conditions and supervision.
- In experiments, prioritize: (1) scaling curves, (2) frozen-backbone probing protocol and fairness of readout training budget, (3) ablations removing either learning paradigm.

If time is tight: data/annotation definition + scaling plots + the main readout comparison table.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 AR token prediction 之外还能怎样统一多模态预训练，这篇值得看任务定义和数据接口；先读方法图和数据构成，别急着信“world model”口号。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the objective shift from token prediction to state-transition modeling; focus on the formulation and data interface first, not the world-model branding.

paper.title: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
paper.abstract: Interactive video generation systems for camera-controlled world exploration roll out growing sequences of latent video frames, entangling state transition with high-frequency observation synthesis. We propose Walking in the Implicit, a scene-centric paradigm that changes the rollout variable from frame latents to a fixed-length, renderable implicit state, termed Neural Implicit Scene (NIS). This factorizes interactive generation into stochastic transition of a compact scene state and determinis

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频生成中逐帧 rollout 容易把状态转移和高频观测合成混在一起的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成和世界模型范式上的改造：把 rollout 变量从视频帧 latent 改为可渲染的固定长度隐式场景状态。它对“如何用紧凑 latent 表示可交互世界”有参考价值，但不是 LLM 基座训练的直接论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Walking in the Implicit / NeuWorld。模型先用 transformer VAE 从稀疏带位姿帧学习局部锚定的 Neural Implicit Scene，再用 diffusion transformer 根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知的历史检索来演化 NIS。渲染阶段根据采样到的 NIS 和相机位姿确定性生成观测。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明模型从公开数据从头训练，但提供信息被截断，未给出具体数据规模、baseline 列表、指标或定量提升。核心实验应关注长程交互 rollout 的稳定性、相机可控性和场景一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the entanglement of state transition and high-frequency observation synthesis in interactive video generation with camera-controlled rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a generative world-modeling paradigm: replacing frame-latent rollout with a fixed-length renderable implicit scene state. This is relevant to compact latent world representations, but it is not directly a language-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Walking in the Implicit / NeuWorld learns a locally anchored Neural Implicit Scene with a transformer VAE from sparse posed frames, then evolves that NIS with a diffusion transformer conditioned on future camera trajectories and geometry-aware retrieved history. Rendering is deterministic given the sampled scene state and camera pose.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that NeuWorld is trained from scratch on public data, but the provided text is truncated and does not include data size, baselines, metrics, or quantitative gains. The key experiments are likely about long-horizon rollout stability, camera control, and scene consistency.

recommendation.zh: 只看 NIS factorization；它对 latent world model 有借鉴，和 LLM pretrain 的连接还停在类比层。
recommendation.en: Read only the NIS factorization; it is useful for latent world-model design, but the link to LLM pretraining remains mostly analogical.

paper.title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Video generation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied world simulation. However, both general-domain video generators and robot-specific data fine-tuned models can still produce physically implausible manipulations, including discontinuous motion trajectories and inconsistent robot-object interactions, which limits their reliability as world simulators. Through extensive experiments, we find that such physical instability mainly arises from two factors: deformation of moving

summary.core_problem: 解决机器人操作视频生成中的物理不一致问题，尤其是物体形变、接触关系错误和运动轨迹不连续。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向具身世界模拟的视频生成训练方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对用生成式视频模型构建 VLA/world model 的训练信号设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PhysisForcing 训练框架，把监督集中到更能反映物理一致性的区域。方法包括像素级轨迹对齐损失，用参考点轨迹监督 DiT 特征；还引入语义级约束来改善交互实体之间的时空相关性，重点处理接触阶段的物理失真。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到进行了大量实验，发现物理不稳定主要来自运动物体形变和交互实体的错误时空相关性。具体模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称和提升幅度在给定信息中未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets physical inconsistency in robotic manipulation video generation, including object deformation, discontinuous trajectories, and implausible contact dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training framework for video-based embodied world simulation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the supervision design is mildly relevant for researchers thinking about generative world models for VLA training.
summary_en.technical_approach: PhysisForcing focuses learning on physics-informative regions. It uses a pixel-level trajectory alignment loss to supervise DiT features with reference point trajectories, together with semantic-level constraints intended to improve spatiotemporal correlations among interacting entities during contact.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments and diagnoses two main failure modes: deformation of moving objects and implausible spatiotemporal correlations during interaction. Model scale, dataset size, baselines, and exact gains are not available from the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 只需看物理监督信号如何接到 DiT 特征；对 LLM 预训练不是主线，但可作为 VLA world model 数据生成的弱参考。
recommendation.en: Skim only how the physics losses are attached to DiT features; this is not core LLM pretraining, but it is a weak signal for VLA world-model data generation.

paper.title: Internalizing the Future: A Unified Agentic Training Paradigm for World Model Planning
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capability in sequential decision-making, yet they remains fundamentally reactive in long-horizon tasks. Unlike humans who employ "what-if" reasoning to evaluate potential plans before commitment, standard agents lack an internal world model to simulate future outcomes. Therefore, we propose to internalize future-aware planning by training a single autoregressive model to verbalize both a prospective state rollout and a plan-conditioned

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM Agent 在长视野任务中缺乏内部世界模型进行前瞻性规划（what-if reasoning）的问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的自回归训练范式，将未来状态的 rollout 和类似 Q-value 的成功率估计内化到单个模型中，避免了纯 SFT 带来的“表面模仿”问题。
summary.technical_approach: 识别出“格式-能力鸿沟”（format-capability gap），提出三阶段训练范式：1) WM-AMT（世界模型 Agentic 中期训练）将潜在预测能力注入策略；2) FE-SFT（格式诱导 SFT）结构化这种能力；3) 结合强化学习（未在摘要中详述，但通常是第三阶段）进一步对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型参数量和 baseline 数据，但强调了相比于直接在 look-ahead 轨迹上进行 SFT，该方法能产生真正的预测性 grounding。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自腾讯和蚂蚁集团等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of an internal world model for forward-looking planning (what-if reasoning) in LLM agents during long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified autoregressive training paradigm that internalizes future state rollouts and Q-value-like success estimates into a single model, avoiding the 'superficial mimicry' caused by pure SFT.
summary_en.technical_approach: Identifies a 'format-capability gap' and introduces a three-stage training paradigm: 1) World Model Agentic Mid-Training (WM-AMT) to inject latent predictive capabilities; 2) Format-Eliciting SFT (FE-SFT) to structure this capability; 3) (Likely RL, though truncated in abstract) for further alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract lacks specific model sizes and baselines but emphasizes that the method achieves genuine predictive grounding compared to direct SFT on look-ahead traces.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Tencent, Ant Group, etc.

recommendation.zh: 将世界模型的前瞻规划能力内化到自回归 LLM 中的尝试，其提出的 'format-capability gap' 和三阶段训练（特别是 Mid-Training 的设计）对后训练和 RL 阶段有启发。
recommendation.en: An interesting attempt to internalize world-model planning into an AR LLM; the identified 'format-capability gap' and the mid-training stage offer insights for post-training and RL.

paper.title: Grounded Iterative Language Planning: How Parameterized World Models Reduce Hallucination Propagation in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: World models for language agents come in two useful forms. An agent-based world model calls an LLM API and reasons flexibly in language, but its errors appear as hallucinated state changes that are hard to score with ordinary regression losses. A parameterized world model is a trained transition predictor; its errors are easier to measure with quantities such as NodeMSE, delta accuracy, and validity accuracy, but it is usually weaker as a standalone planner. We compare these two families on four

summary.core_problem: 纯 LLM 驱动的语言 agent 世界模型易产生幻觉状态转移，而参数化世界模型单独规划能力较弱，二者优势未被有效结合。
summary.importance: 方法创新：对比两类世界模型并提出 GILP 框架，通过参数化骨干与 LLM 推理协同抑制幻觉传播。
summary.technical_approach: 定义 agent-based 与 parameterized 两类世界模型，设计可操作的幻觉度量指标；提出 GILP：仅训练小型参数化骨干提供合法动作、状态增量预测与风险值，LLM 生成动作与想象增量，一致性门控检测分歧并触发修订。
summary.experiments: 在 4 个图结构规划基准上验证，使用 GPT-4o-mini 作为 API 调用模型，摘要未披露具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Pure LLM-driven agent world models hallucinate state transitions, while parameterized world models are weak standalone planners; their complementary strengths have not been effectively combined.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: compares two families of world models and proposes GILP to suppress hallucination propagation via a parameterized backbone coupled with LLM reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes agent-based vs. parameterized world models and designs operational hallucination metrics; GILP trains only a small parameterized backbone to supply valid actions, predicted state deltas, and risk, while an LLM drafts actions and imagined deltas, with a consistency gate triggering revision on disagreement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 4 graph-structured planning benchmarks using GPT-4o-mini as the API model; abstract does not report exact gain magnitudes.

recommendation.zh: 用小参数化模型做 LLM agent 的状态一致性校验，思路可迁移到推理时自检，看方法节即可，无预训练侧价值。
recommendation.en: Using a small parameterized model as a state-consistency checker for LLM agents is transferable to test-time self-verification; read only the method section, no pretraining-side value.

paper.title: Einstein World Models
paper.abstract: Does intelligence require the ability to reason about phenomena beyond direct experience? It is natural to suspect that some complex thought cannot be captured through language alone. However, of particular concern to this work, is whether visualising counterfactual events can complement language as a mechanism for complex thought. We ask whether LLMs can be trained to utilise such visualisation mechanisms, in a way that benefits their reasoning abilities. Motivated by this question, we propose

summary.core_problem: 探索纯语言推理是否足够支撑复杂反事实思维，验证可视化反事实事件作为中间表示能否补充语言机制提升LLM推理能力。
summary.importance: 提出了融合视觉时间rollout到LLM推理trace的框架蓝图，探索非文本中间表示对复杂推理的增益。
summary.technical_approach: 设计Einstein World Models框架，LLM在推理过程中调用视觉world module生成待考察场景的短视觉时间rollout，将rollout作为可检查的中间假设而非最终答案，融入后续推理步骤，扩展了链式思考的表示空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置、模型参数量、baseline及效果数据，仅提出框架设计思路。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自东北大学，其中Kentaro Inui是知名NLP研究者，长期从事自然语言推理、常识推理研究

summary_en.core_problem: Explores whether pure language reasoning is sufficient for complex counterfactual thought, and whether visualizing counterfactual events as intermediate representations can complement language mechanisms to improve LLM reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a blueprint for integrating visual temporal rollouts into LLM reasoning traces, exploring the benefits of non-text intermediate representations for complex reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs the Einstein World Models framework, where the LLM calls a visual world module during reasoning to generate short visual temporal rollouts of target scenes, treats the rollouts as inspectable intermediate hypotheses rather than final answers, and integrates them into subsequent reasoning steps, extending the representation space of chain-of-thought.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose complete experiment setups, model sizes, baselines, or performance results, only presents the framework design.
summary_en.authors_note: The team is from Tohoku University; Kentaro Inui is a well-known NLP researcher with long-standing work on natural language inference and commonsense reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 探索视觉表示在推理中作用的思路对多模态预训练有弱启发，但目前仅为概念框架无实证支撑，只看动机即可。
recommendation.en: The motivation of exploring visual representations in reasoning offers weak inspiration for multimodal pretraining, but it is currently only a conceptual framework with no empirical support; skim the motivation only.

paper.title: One Image is All You Need: Agentic One-Shot Image Generation via Text-Based World Models for Long-Tail Spatial Perception
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial decision automation, such as autonomous driving and maritime surveillance, critically depends on robust visual perception. However, real-world spatiotemporal data exhibits severe heterogeneity, often manifesting as extreme long-tail distributions for safety-critical scenarios. This data scarcity induces dataset shift that degrades detection performance and pose safety risks. While synthetic data generation offers a potential solution, existing generative approaches, such as diff

summary.core_problem: 在长尾安全关键场景数据稀缺下，如何从单张参考图出发生成具备空间一致性与结构约束的场景数据，用于提升空间感知/决策系统鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏生成式数据合成框架：把“单图→结构化场景表示→受约束生成”做成agentic流水线，针对长尾空间关系一致性问题；对多模态数据合成（用于训练/评测）有一定参考，但更偏CV生成而非LLM基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: WMGen-v1：用大型VLM从单张图构建结构化场景表示（显式空间/对象关系），再由LLM进行规划/约束生成流程（文本世界模型/场景脚本），最后驱动扩散/GAN类生成器产出满足空间约束的合成图像（摘要未给出具体生成器与约束实现细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据与定量指标；主要宣称在长尾空间感知数据生成上比无显式结构约束的生成方法更一致、更可控（需看正文的空间一致性度量、下游检测/定位增益与消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: Under long-tail data scarcity for safety-critical spatial perception, how to generate spatially consistent, structurally constrained scenes starting from a single reference image.
summary_en.importance: A generative data synthesis pipeline: it operationalizes an agentic “single image → structured scene → constrained generation” workflow for long-tail spatial consistency. Some relevance as multimodal synthetic data tooling, but it’s closer to CV generation than foundation LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: WMGen-v1: a large VLM extracts a structured scene representation from one image; an LLM acts as a planner/world-model to produce constrained textual scene specifications; a generative model (e.g., diffusion/GAN) renders images that satisfy spatial/physical constraints (exact generator/constraints not detailed in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: No model sizes, training data, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract; claims improved spatial/physical consistency over unconstrained generators (check main paper for metrics, downstream gains, and ablations).

recommendation.zh: 当作“结构化场景→受约束生成”的数据合成思路备查即可；除非正文给出干净的空间一致性指标和下游增益，否则对基座预训练帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for “structured scene → constrained generation” data synthesis; unless the paper has clean spatial-consistency metrics and downstream gains, it won’t move pretraining decisions.

paper.title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
paper.abstract: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是一个很基础、也很少被讲透的问题：一个看起来“纯 model-free”的 value-based agent，到底有没有在内部学到环境动力学，也就是 world model。传统看法把 model-free 和 model-based 分成两条路，原因在于 value equivalence：不同的转移核可能导出相同的 value function 和最优策略，所以仅凭单一任务上的 Q 值，通常无法唯一恢复环境。作者要解决的核心问题是：如果 agent 不是只为一个 reward 训练，而是在足够丰富的一组 goals 或 reward functions 上训练，那么这些 Q-values 是否已经隐式编码了唯一且准确的转移模型 P；如果是，怎样把它从 Q 中反推出去。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不属于 LLM 预训练主线，但在“从训练信号中恢复隐式世界知识”这个层面有方法论意义。它把 model-free / model-based 的边界重新画了一遍：当训练覆盖足够丰富的目标时，goal-conditioned RL 可能已经是隐式混合范式，而不是纯 model-free。这个结论对做 foundation model 的人有间接启发，尤其是那些关心 latent world model、implicit planning、reward-conditioned pretraining、以及“模型内部到底学到了什么结构”的研究者。贡献量级主要在理论与概念统一：一方面给出可识别性条件，说明什么时候 Q 足以确定 P；另一方面给出一个实际可运行的反演算法 P-learning，把 Bellman 方程从“已知 P 求 Q”改成“已知 Q 反求 P”。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线有两条：一个算法，一个可识别性理论。

算法部分提出 P-learning，可以看成 Q-learning 的逆问题。普通 Q-learning 在固定环境转移核 P 下，通过 Bellman 更新逼近 Q；P-learning 则把一组固定的 (Q^g, π^g, r^g) 当作观测，迭代更新候选 world model，使它与这些 value functions 的 Bellman 关系越来越一致。作者在 tabular 情形下把这个过程写成线性方程组，并证明收敛到一个由 Moore–Penrose 伪逆给出的解。直观上，Q、policy 和 reward 提供了关于“从状态动作对出发，后继状态分布必须满足什么约束”的大量线性条件；当这些条件足够丰富时，P 就能被唯一识别。文中也说明在很多实际设置里，π 往往由 Q 通过 argmax 或 softmax 导出，因此输入可以近似理解为一组 goal-conditioned Q 和 reward。

理论部分是全文更核心的内容。作者系统分析了在不同 MDP 类型下，什么样的 goal set 能打破 value equivalence。结论分四类。第一，有限状态、确定性 MDP 中，一个“generic” goal 就可能足够识别真实 P。这里 generic 的意思不是任意 goal，而是能让不同后继状态在回报结构上被区分开。第二，有限状态、随机 MDP 中，goals 需要张成状态空间；换句话说，reward family 必须足够丰富，才能把随机转移分布的自由度约束住。第三，确定性连续状态情形里，有限个 goals 有时也足够，这一点有些反直觉，因为连续空间通常让人预期需要无限监督。第四，随机连续 MDP 中，关键不再是 goal 的个数，而是 coverage：对 Gaussian rewards，需要 goal set 有非空内点；对 indicator rewards，需要覆盖状态空间。作者还给出当 Q 只有 ε 近似精度时，恢复出的 P 的误差界，说明 world model 的准确性会随 value 误差平滑退化，而不是脆弱崩掉。

这套方法与传统 world model learning 的区别在于，它不直接拟合转移样本，而是从 agent 已经学到的价值结构中反演环境。与 successor features、forward-backward learning、一般 goal-conditioned RL 的关系则是：这些方法原本被视为多目标 value learning，这篇论文说明在目标集足够丰富时，它们携带的信息量其实接近显式动力学模型。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕两个问题展开：P-learning 能不能真的恢复 world model；恢复出的模型是否对训练目标之外的规划有用。

在有限 MDP 上，作者用 FourRooms 的三个版本验证理论：确定性、windy 和 teleporting。随着环境随机性增加，所需 goals 数量也增加，文中给出的代表数字是 |G|=1、|G|=4、|G|=20 分别足以实现接近完美的恢复。这和理论判断一致：确定性环境中少量目标即可打破歧义，随机环境则需要更丰富的 reward basis。

在连续控制上，作者考察 Reacher。一个很有意思的结果是，只用 |G|=4 个 goals，就能恢复出相当准确的隐式 world model，而且这种准确性不仅体现在 reward 直接依赖的变量上，还扩展到 reward 从未直接约束的变量。更进一步，基于恢复出的 world model 做规划，可以在一批 out-of-distribution goals 上接近最优，包括训练时只用 position-based goals、测试时却要求到达特定 angular velocity 的设定。这说明 agent 学到的不是狭义的 reward-specific shortcut，而是更完整的动力学结构。

作者还在 MountainCar 上研究这种“隐式泛化能力”。一个关键观察是，如果把训练目标反过来，只用 velocity-based goals 训练，恢复出的 world model 与 position-goal 训练得到的模型几乎相同。这说明不同目标族训练出的 agent，内部可能收敛到相近的环境模型，只是外层 policy/value 读出不同。最后，文中报告 agent 性能与恢复 world model 准确性之间有很强相关性，Spearman ρ=0.98。这个结果不能证明因果，但至少说明在这些设置里，学得更好的 goal-conditioned value function，通常也意味着更准确的隐式环境建模。
summary.reading_guide: 如果时间有限，先读 Introduction，把问题设定和四类理论结论的地图建立起来。然后直接看 Section 3 的 P-learning，重点理解“逆 Bellman”到底在解什么方程、为什么需要 (Q, π, r) 而不是只靠 Q。接着看 Section 4 的 identifiability theorems，不必一开始就抠完所有证明，先抓住 deterministic/stochastic、finite/continuous 四种情形下 goal richness 的差异：有限随机情形讲 span，连续随机情形讲 coverage。实验部分优先看 FourRooms、Reacher、MountainCar 三组结果，它们分别对应理论验证、连续空间恢复、以及 OOD 规划与隐式泛化。若要深挖，值得细看误差界和伪逆解的推导，因为这里决定了方法对近似 Q 的稳健性。作为 skim 级阅读，30–45 分钟可以把主要思想和结论读明白；若想真正吃透理论，需要更长时间跟证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a precise version of a long-standing question in reinforcement learning: when does a seemingly model-free, value-based agent actually encode a world model of the environment? The usual separation between model-free and model-based RL is justified by value equivalence: different transition kernels can induce the same value functions and optimal policies, so a single-task Q-function generally does not identify the true dynamics. The paper asks whether this changes once the agent is trained over a sufficiently rich family of goals or reward functions, and if so, how to recover the latent transition kernel from the learned values.
summary_en.importance: This is not directly a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it matters conceptually for anyone interested in implicit world models, latent planning, or what training signals force a model to internalize environment structure rather than just task-specific behavior. The main contribution is to weaken the standard model-free/model-based dichotomy.
