Under rich enough goal-conditioned training, the collection of Q-functions can become informationally equivalent to the transition kernel. That is a meaningful theoretical result, and the paper backs it with a practical recovery algorithm. The contribution is strongest as a theory-and-methods bridge rather than as a new high-performance RL recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical pillars: P-learning as an inversion algorithm, and identifiability results that characterize when inversion is possible.

P-learning is introduced as an inverse analogue of Q-learning. In standard Q-learning, the transition kernel is fixed and Bellman updates are used to estimate values. Here the values, policies, and rewards are treated as given, and the transition model is updated so that the Bellman equations become increasingly consistent with those fixed quantities. In the tabular setting, this becomes a structured linear inverse problem, and the paper proves convergence to a solution expressed through the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse. Intuitively, each tuple (Q^g, pi^g, r^g) imposes constraints on what the next-state distribution must be for every state-action pair. If the goal family is rich enough, those constraints pin down the true kernel.

The more fundamental part is the identifiability theory. The paper characterizes when value equivalence can be broken in four regimes. In deterministic finite MDPs, a single generic goal can be sufficient to identify the true dynamics. In stochastic finite MDPs, the reward family must span the state space; otherwise the stochastic degrees of freedom remain hidden behind equivalent values. In deterministic continuous MDPs, somewhat surprisingly, a finite number of goals can still suffice in some cases. In stochastic continuous MDPs, the key notion is coverage rather than cardinality: for Gaussian rewards, the goal set needs non-empty interior; for indicator rewards, it must cover the state space. The paper also provides error bounds showing that if the Q-functions are only epsilon-accurate, the recovered model degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically.

This differs from standard world-model learning because the method does not fit transitions directly from rollouts. Instead, it extracts dynamics from the value structure already learned by the agent. It also reframes goal-conditioned RL, successor-feature style methods, and related approaches as potentially implicit model-learning procedures when the goal family is sufficiently expressive.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments ask two main questions: can P-learning recover accurate world models in practice, and are the recovered models useful beyond the training goals?

For finite MDPs, the paper validates the theory on three FourRooms variants: deterministic, windy, and teleporting. As stochasticity increases, the number of goals needed for near-perfect recovery also increases. The headline numbers are that |G| = 1, 4, and 20 goals are sufficient, respectively, for quasi-perfect recovery in those three settings. This aligns well with the theory: deterministic environments need much less reward diversity than stochastic ones.

In continuous control, the paper studies Reacher and finds that only |G| = 4 goals are enough to recover an accurate implicit world model. A notable result is that the recovered model is accurate even on variables that the reward never directly depends on. Planning inside the recovered model then transfers to out-of-distribution goals, including angular-velocity targets despite training only on position-based goals. That is a strong sign that the agent has internalized more than a narrow reward-specific shortcut.

The MountainCar experiments probe this implicit generalization further. Training on velocity-based goals instead of position-based goals yields an almost identical recovered world model, suggesting that agents optimized for very different objectives may still internalize similar dynamics. Finally, the paper reports a very strong correlation between agent performance and recovered world-model accuracy, with Spearman rho = 0.98. This does not establish causality, but it supports the view that successful goal-conditioned value learning is often accompanied by accurate implicit dynamics learning.
summary_en.reading_guide: If reading selectively, start with the introduction to get the problem framing and the four-regime map of the theory. Then read the P-learning section carefully enough to understand what is being inverted in the Bellman equation and why the method uses (Q, pi, r) rather than Q alone. After that, go to the identifiability section and focus on the distinctions between deterministic vs. stochastic and finite vs. continuous settings. The main conceptual split is that finite stochastic settings are about spanning the state space, while continuous stochastic settings are about coverage. In the experiments, prioritize FourRooms for theory validation, Reacher for continuous-state recovery, and MountainCar for out-of-distribution planning and implicit generalization. A 30–45 minute pass is enough to capture the main ideas; fully digesting the proofs will take longer.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但它在动摇一个老 prior：足够丰富的 value learning 可能已经学出 world model；先看理论命题和恢复条件，再决定要不要借到 latent reasoning 上。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it challenges an old prior: rich enough value learning may already contain a world model; read the theorem statements and recovery conditions before mapping it to latent reasoning.

paper.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
paper.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We

summary.core_problem: 讨论机器人 World Action Model 是否必须生成未来视频，还是只需借用图像编辑先验来预测动作。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是建模假设修正。它对通用 LLM 预训练不是直接工作，但对多模态 world model、VLA 和行动模型中的生成目标选择有参考价值：并非所有控制任务都需要显式长视频 rollout。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ImageWAM，把预训练图像编辑模型改造成机器人动作预测框架。相比视频生成，图像编辑只建模当前帧到目标帧的变换，更集中于动作相关视觉差异。摘要还强调推理时不解码目标图像，而是利用编辑模型中的条件表示来服务动作预测，以降低多帧生成带来的成本和误差传播。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体机器人数据集、模型参数、训练规模、baseline 或定量提升。声称 ImageWAM 相比 video-based WAM 避免密集未来 token、高成本推理和长时域想象误差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether robotic World Action Models need future video generation, or whether an image-editing prior is enough for action prediction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modeling-assumption revision. It is not direct LLM pretraining work, but it is relevant to multimodal world models and VLA systems because it questions whether explicit long-horizon video rollout is the right training and inference target for control.
summary_en.technical_approach: ImageWAM repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. Instead of generating dense future videos, it models a current-to-target frame transformation focused on action-relevant visual differences. The abstract states that the target frame is not decoded at inference time; the model uses conditional editing representations to support action prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide robot datasets, model sizes, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It argues that ImageWAM avoids dense future tokens, expensive video inference, and error-prone long-horizon imagination.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道的地方是负结果味道：控制模型未必需要视频生成；读 abstract 和方法框架就够。
recommendation.en: The useful signal is the negative result flavor: control models may not need video generation; the abstract and framework diagram are enough.

paper.title: Looped World Models
paper.abstract: Current world models face a fundamental tension: faithful long-horizon simulation demands deep computation, but deeper models are expensive to deploy and prone to compounding errors. We resolve this by introducing Looped World Models (LoopWM), which are the first looped architectures for world modelling. Our method iteratively refines latent environment states through a parameter-shared transformer block. This yield up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional approaches with adaptive compu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是世界模型里一个很具体但长期存在的矛盾：长时程预测通常需要更深的计算，才能在每一步状态转移上做足够细的推断；但把模型直接做深，会同时抬高参数量、部署成本和训练难度，而且 rollout 越长，误差越容易累积。作者把这个问题改写成“单步转移是否可以通过共享参数的迭代细化来完成”，也就是不靠堆更多独立层，而是对同一个 latent transition operator 反复应用，让模型在固定参数预算下增加‘内循环深度’。论文的关键点不只是把 looped transformer 搬到 world model，而是把环境动力学中的重复作用规律，与共享更新算子的迭代 refinement 对齐，并进一步处理了循环深度增加后数值不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不在纯文本 LLM，而在“深度是否必须等于参数量”这个更一般的建模问题。它提出了 iterative latent depth 作为新的 scaling 轴：模型容量不只靠参数、数据和上下文长度扩展，还可以靠测试时增加循环次数来提升单步推断质量。这一点和 looped LM、test-time compute、latent reasoning 的研究方向是连着的。若实验结论成立，意义主要有三层。第一，参数共享的深度递归在时序生成模型里也能成立，不局限于语言。第二，world model 这种对 rollout stability 很敏感的场景，反而更能检验 looped architecture 是否真的学到“迭代求精”而不是浅层拟合。第三，它给统一生成模型一个启发：对于视频、交互环境、甚至多模态 token 序列，内循环计算可能是比简单加深 backbone 更经济的扩展方式。量级上，这篇更像范式验证和 scaling 方向探索，不是已经定型的通用 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Looped World Model：用一个参数共享的 transformer block，对同一时刻的 latent state 进行多次迭代更新，而不是用一串彼此独立的深层 block 做一次前向。这样单步状态转移被拆成“外层时间推进 + 内层迭代 refinement”两层结构。外层仍然是 world model 的时间演化；内层则对下一状态的隐表示反复修正。

从文中描述看，作者借鉴了近期 looped transformer 的稳定化做法，在循环更新里引入了带谱约束的 state-retention parameterization。直观上，它把一部分更新写成收缩性的线性保留项，再叠加输入注入和 transformer 非线性项。这样做不是为了表达某个精确物理方程，而是为了保证当内循环次数增加时，latent trajectory 不会因为共享块反复作用而发散。这个设计和普通 residual stack 的区别在于：普通深层 transformer 的每一层参数不同，稳定性主要靠初始化、归一化和优化过程；这里因为同一个块被反复调用，状态转移矩阵的谱性质会直接决定深度扩展时是否稳定，所以需要显式约束。

另一个重要点是 adaptive computation。论文强调不同预测步的难度不同，因此不必给每个时间步分配相同的内循环深度。LoopWM 可以按样本或按时间步自适应决定迭代次数，让复杂转移多算几步，简单转移少算几步。这和固定深度 world model 的差别很大：后者把所有状态转移都用同样计算预算处理，容易在简单步上浪费算力、在困难步上算力不足。

从建模立场看，这篇不是 diffusion world model，也不是单纯 RSSM/AR transformer 的替代，而是给现有 backbone 增加一个“共享参数的深度维度”。因此它与扩大模型宽度、增加训练数据、延长上下文是正交的。作者也明确把 iterative latent depth 视为新的 scaling axis。
summary.experiments:
从引言能确认的核心结果有两点。第一，参数效率提升最高可到 100×，这是论文最醒目的数字。这里应理解为：在达到相近世界建模效果时，looped 架构所需独立参数量远低于常规深层方案，而不是同等 FLOPs 下无条件提升 100×。第二，模型支持 adaptive computation，推理时可按预测复杂度动态扩展内循环深度。

不过，当前给出的全文片段没有完整实验表和具体 benchmark 数字，因此无法可靠复述更细的结果，例如使用了哪些环境、latent tokenizer 形式、与 Dreamer/IRIS/EMERALD 等基线相比的绝对分数、不同 loop 次数下的 rollout error 曲线、以及谱约束对稳定性的消融幅度。若按论文叙事推断，最值得确认的实验应包括：1）固定参数量下与非共享深层 transformer/RSSM 的比较；2）固定训练预算下，增加 loop 次数是否持续改善长时程 rollout；3）训练时 loop 深度与测试时 loop 深度不一致时，是否仍有 test-time compute scaling；4）没有谱约束时是否出现发散、性能回退或梯度不稳；5）adaptive halting 相比固定 loop 的收益是否主要来自效率还是也改善质量。

如果精读全文，建议重点提取三类数字：参数量与性能的 Pareto 曲线、长时程 rollout 指标随 loop 深度变化的曲线、以及不同环境复杂度下的自适应计算分配统计。这三类结果决定这篇工作到底是“省参数”，还是“真的引入了新的可扩展计算轴”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读偏精读之间的方式。先看引言里作者如何定义问题：不是单纯做更小模型，而是把世界模型的单步预测改成迭代 refinement。然后直接看方法部分关于 looped update、state-retention parameterization、谱约束和 adaptive computation 的公式与结构图。这里是整篇最有信息量的地方。

实验部分建议优先看四类图表：1）参数量-性能曲线；2）loop 次数增加时的性能变化；3）长时程 rollout 误差或视频质量退化曲线；4）稳定性消融，尤其是有无谱约束的对比。如果论文提供不同训练 loop 与测试 loop 的交叉实验，也值得重点看，因为这关系到 test-time compute scaling 是否成立。

预计阅读时间 25 到 40 分钟。若只想判断是否与 LLM pretrain 有迁移价值，看方法和参数效率实验即可；若想挖深一点，重点思考两个问题：共享深度是否真的学到迭代算法，还是只是更强的正则化；以及这种内循环深度能否迁移到视频 token LM、diffusion transformer 或 any-order sequence model。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural tension in world modeling: faithful long-horizon simulation often needs deeper computation per transition, but simply making the model deeper increases parameter count, deployment cost, and instability, while rollout errors still compound over time. The proposed reframing is to treat a single transition not as a one-shot forward pass through many distinct layers, but as an iterative refinement process driven by a shared latent update operator. The contribution is not merely “using looped transformers for world models.” The more important claim is that environment dynamics are naturally compatible with repeated application of a shared transition law, and that this can be exploited as an inner computational loop, provided the recurrent latent dynamics are stabilized.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but real. The paper is about a broader scaling question: does more effective depth have to come from more parameters? LoopWM argues for iterative latent depth as an additional scaling axis, alongside model size, data, and context length. That connects naturally to looped language models, test-time compute scaling, and latent reasoning. If the empirical story holds, the contribution matters in three ways. First, parameter-shared depth recursion may be viable beyond language. Second, world models are a stringent testbed because rollout stability is unforgiving; if looping works there, it is stronger evidence than a mild perplexity gain in text. Third, it suggests a path for video, interactive simulation, and unified multimodal sequence models where extra compute is allocated through recurrent refinement rather than a permanently larger backbone. This is more a paradigm probe than a settled recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core architecture is a Looped World Model in which a parameter-shared transformer block is applied repeatedly to refine the latent state for a single transition. This creates a two-level structure: an outer temporal evolution over environment steps, and an inner iterative refinement loop for the next latent state. Instead of using a stack of distinct layers once, the model reuses the same transition operator multiple times.

A central technical ingredient is a spectrally constrained state-retention parameterization, adapted from recent work on stabilizing looped transformers. The intuition is straightforward: part of the recurrent update is written as a contractive linear retention term, combined with input injection and transformer nonlinearities. The goal is not to encode exact physics, but to keep the latent dynamics bounded as the number of inner-loop iterations grows. This is a meaningful departure from standard deep transformers. In ordinary residual stacks, stability is mostly handled implicitly through initialization, normalization, and optimization. In a looped model, the same block is reapplied many times, so the spectral properties of the induced state transition become directly tied to whether deeper recurrence remains stable.

The paper also emphasizes adaptive computation. Different transition steps have different difficulty, so a fixed amount of inner-loop compute is wasteful on easy steps and insufficient on hard ones. LoopWM allows the number of refinement iterations to vary, effectively allocating more compute where the transition is harder. That is a substantial modeling difference from conventional fixed-depth world models.

Conceptually, this is not a diffusion world model and not simply a replacement for RSSM or autoregressive transformer dynamics. It adds a shared-depth computational dimension that is orthogonal to scaling width, data, or context. The paper explicitly frames iterative latent depth as a new scaling axis.
summary_en.experiments:
Two headline claims are visible from the provided full text. First, the model achieves up to 100× parameter efficiency relative to conventional approaches. That should be read as a Pareto-style claim—similar modeling quality with far fewer independent parameters—rather than a blanket statement under equal FLOPs. Second, the architecture supports adaptive computation, allowing inference depth to scale with transition complexity.

The excerpt does not include the full experimental tables, so it is not possible to safely reproduce benchmark-specific numbers, environment names, or exact gains over baselines such as Dreamer, IRIS, or EMERALD. The most important experiments to verify in the full paper are likely: (1) comparisons against non-shared deep transformers or RSSM-style baselines at matched parameter budgets; (2) whether increasing loop iterations improves long-horizon rollout quality; (3) whether train-time and test-time loop counts can differ, enabling test-time compute scaling; (4) ablations showing instability or degradation without spectral constraints; and (5) whether adaptive halting improves only efficiency or also final quality.

When reading the full results, the most informative numbers will be: parameter-performance Pareto curves, rollout metrics as a function of loop depth, and statistics showing how adaptive compute is distributed across environments or timesteps. Those are the results that determine whether the paper is merely parameter-efficient or whether it genuinely introduces a useful new compute axis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction for the problem framing, then go directly to the method section. The key material is the looped update rule, the state-retention parameterization, the spectral constraint, and the adaptive-computation mechanism. That is where the paper either stands or falls.

In the experiments, prioritize four kinds of figures and tables: (1) parameter-versus-performance tradeoffs; (2) performance as loop count increases; (3) long-horizon rollout degradation curves; and (4) stability ablations, especially with and without the spectral constraint. If the paper includes train-loop versus test-loop cross-evaluation, that deserves special attention because it speaks directly to test-time compute scaling.

Estimated reading time is 25–40 minutes. For readers interested in transfer to LLM pretraining, the main questions are whether the shared-depth recursion is learning an actual iterative computation rather than acting as regularization, and whether the same inner-depth idea could transfer to video token LMs, diffusion transformers, or any-order sequence models.

recommendation.zh: 将参数共享循环Transformer迁移至世界建模，迭代隐深度作为正交scaling轴的结论对test-time compute研究有参考，重点看scaling实验部分。
recommendation.en: Applies weight-shared looped Transformers to world modeling; the orthogonal iterative latent depth scaling axis is relevant for test-time compute work; focus on scaling experiment sections.

paper.title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
paper.abstract: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题，不是一般的视频生成提速，而是更具体的“单卡实时、原生流式、音视频联合、自回归长时生成”。作者关心的是社交视频场景：人物表情、口型、语音节奏、环境声和对话轮转需要同步出现，而且生成不能等整段视频都采样完再输出。传统双向视频 diffusion 模型在这里有两个根本障碍：一是时空 token 太大，采样步数多，算力和显存成本高；二是整段联合去噪导致天然不适合边生成边播放。已有流式视频生成方法虽然开始转向自回归或 chunk-wise 生成，但大多只重视觉、把音频当条件、长程漂移明显，且很多所谓实时并不能在单卡上成立。MaineCoon 试图把这些约束放到同一个系统里处理，目标是做一个可持续滚动生成的实时音视频社交世界模型原型。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“世界模型”从物理环境和游戏环境，推进到人类社交互动这一类高频内容分布，问题定义本身有信息量。第二，它体现了一种与离线高保真视频 diffusion 不同的建模取向：为了实时交互，模型必须优先考虑因果流式生成、状态复用、长时稳定性和跨模态同步，而不是只追求单段视频的静态质量。第三，从预训练视角看，这类工作会倒逼统一音视频 token 表示、流式训练目标、长程记忆和 rollout 稳定性设计。它不直接回答文本 LLM 的预训练问题，但对“统一多模态生成模型如何从离线生成走向在线交互”有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 从引言和可见全文内容看，作者的核心设计是把社交视频生成建成原生 streaming autoregressive audio-visual generation，而不是在 diffusion 框架上做局部补丁。技术路线大致包含几件事。其一，生成顺序是因果的，模型需要在历史上下文上逐步发射后续视频帧或短片段，并复用历史状态，这意味着它更接近语言模型式的 rollout，而不是整段双向建模。其二，音频不是外部条件，而是与视觉共同生成的目标，因此模型需要在语音内容、韵律、口型、面部运动和场景动态之间建立统一时序表示。其三，作者强调 long-horizon continuation 和单卡实时，说明系统层面大概率采用了缓存、局部上下文、分块生成或低步数采样一类机制，避免时空注意力随序列长度线性以上膨胀。其四，论文提出“social world model”这一定位，意味着生成模块只是更大系统中的 generative core，未来还会接 observation、memory、user-state simulation、planning 等模块。与传统视频 diffusion 相比，区别不在于画质小修小补，而在于训练目标和推理范式都转向在线交互；与已有 streaming video 方法相比，区别在于把音频和社交互动节奏放到中心位置，而不是只做视觉续写。
summary.experiments: 可见内容里还没有完整实验表和具体数字，因此不能编造参数量、训练数据规模或精确提升幅度。根据引言，作者声称的实验目标包括四项：一，原生流式音视频联合生成；二，语音与视觉运动同步；三，支持分钟级长时续写；四，在单张 GPU 上达到实时生成速度。阅读时应重点核对这些主张是否被严格量化：例如实时性的定义是 wall-clock 生成速度是否超过播放速度，还是只在低分辨率/短上下文下成立；单卡是消费级还是数据中心 GPU；长时稳定性是否通过自动指标和人工评测同时验证；音画同步是否有专门指标而不只是主观展示。如果正文给出了与现有 streaming video 或 audio-conditioned video 方法的对比，最关键的是看它是否在“实时 + 单卡 + 音视频联合 + 长时”这几个约束同时满足，而不是只在其中一项上占优。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读，先看 Introduction 里对问题空间的界定，尤其是为什么传统视频 diffusion 的双向去噪不适合实时交互。然后看方法总览图，确认模型的时间推进单位到底是 frame、chunk 还是离散 token，以及音频和视频是在同一主干里联合建模，还是一个模态主导另一个模态。接着重点看系统与推理部分：缓存怎么做，延迟怎么控制，长时漂移如何抑制。实验部分建议优先看三类图表：实时性曲线、长时 rollout 稳定性、音画同步与主观社交感知评测。预计 20-30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断它对预训练研究有没有更深启发，需要再细看训练目标、tokenization 和数据构成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not merely about faster video generation. It targets a stricter setting: single-GPU, real-time, native streaming, joint audio-video autoregressive generation over long horizons. The motivating domain is social video, where speech rhythm, lip motion, facial expression, ambient sound, and conversational pacing must stay synchronized while the model emits content continuously. Standard bidirectional video diffusion models are a poor fit for this setting for two structural reasons: they are expensive because they denoise large spatiotemporal token grids over many steps, and they are not naturally streamable because an entire clip is generated jointly before frames can be finalized. Prior streaming or autoregressive video generators improve latency, but many are vision-centric, treat audio only as conditioning, drift over long rollouts, or fail to achieve true real-time generation on a single GPU. MaineCoon is positioned as a first prototype for a social world model that addresses these constraints together.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is indirect but meaningful. First, it reframes world modeling around human social interaction rather than physical simulation or game environments, which is a useful shift in problem definition. Second, it represents a different modeling trade-off from offline high-fidelity video diffusion: once real-time interaction becomes the target, causal streaming, state reuse, long-horizon stability, and cross-modal synchronization become first-class design constraints. Third, from a pretraining perspective, this line of work pressures the field toward unified audio-video tokenization, streaming objectives, memory mechanisms, and stable autoregressive rollouts in multimodal settings. It is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to unified multimodal generative pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: From the visible full text, the central move is to build social video generation as native streaming autoregressive audio-visual generation rather than patching a standard diffusion pipeline. The design appears to have several components. First, generation is causal: the model emits future frames or chunks conditioned on historical context and reuses past states, making it closer to language-model-style rollout than full-clip bidirectional denoising. Second, audio is not just an external condition; it is part of the generated target, so the model must learn a shared temporal representation linking speech content, prosody, lip motion, facial dynamics, and scene evolution. Third, the emphasis on long-horizon continuation and single-GPU real-time inference suggests system-level choices such as caching, chunked context, local attention, or very low-step generation to avoid the scaling bottleneck of full spatiotemporal attention. Fourth, the paper introduces the broader notion of a social world model, where the generator is only the generative core and may later be paired with observation, memory, user-state simulation, and planning modules. Relative to standard video diffusion, the novelty is less about visual quality tuning and more about changing both the training target and inference paradigm toward online interaction. Relative to prior streaming video work, the difference is that audio and social pacing are treated as central rather than auxiliary.
summary_en.experiments: The visible text does not include the full experimental tables, so precise model size, data scale, and gains should not be inferred. Based on the introduction, the claimed evaluation targets are: native streaming joint audio-video generation, synchronization between speech and visual motion, long-horizon continuation at minute scale, and real-time generation on a single GPU. These claims need careful verification in the main paper. In particular, the important questions are whether real-time means wall-clock generation faster than playback, whether the single GPU is a datacenter or consumer device, whether long-horizon stability is measured quantitatively rather than shown only in demos, and whether audio-visual synchronization is evaluated with dedicated metrics instead of subjective examples alone. If comparisons are provided against prior streaming video or audio-conditioned video systems, the key point is whether MaineCoon satisfies the full constraint set simultaneously: real-time, single-GPU, joint audio-video generation, and long-horizon stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction, especially the argument for why bidirectional video diffusion is structurally mismatched to real-time interaction. Then inspect the method overview to determine the temporal emission unit: frame, chunk, or discrete token, and whether audio and video are modeled in a shared backbone or in a loosely coupled setup. After that, focus on the systems and inference sections: how caching works, how latency is controlled, and how rollout drift is mitigated. In experiments, prioritize three kinds of evidence: latency or throughput curves, long-horizon rollout stability, and synchronization or subjective social-interaction evaluations. Around 20-30 minutes should be enough to understand the main idea. A deeper read is only necessary if the paper contains concrete details on tokenization, training objectives, and data construction.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心“统一AR能不能吃下音视频并做到实时交互”，这篇该看；先别被47.5 FPS打动，先查清token率、分辨率和单GPU定义。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care whether unified autoregressive modeling can absorb audio-video and still support real-time interaction; do not be impressed by 47.5 FPS until you verify token rate, resolution, and what “single GPU” actually means.

paper.title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
paper.abstract: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式世界模型只能做导航、难以处理中途物体交互和事件记忆的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不在LLM本身，而在交互式生成世界模型的记忆设计与数据瓶颈刻画。对做统一序列建模、视频生成和action-conditioned pretraining的人有边缘启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出ActWorld，在chunk-autoregressive生成框架中加入支持中途对象交互的机制，并引入action-aware memory，试图保留导致状态转移的关键事件帧，而不是像现有方法那样做偏近期的历史压缩。作者同时强调需要带精确密集标签的人-物交互数据来弥补数据缺口。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，核心实验应围绕交互式视频/世界模型场景，比较导航型基线与支持对象交互后的生成一致性、可操作性和长程记忆保持。未见与语言建模、tokenizer、预训练loss或scaling直接相关的设置。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the limitation of interactive world models that support navigation but fail to handle mid-rollout object interactions and event-centric memory.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not in LLMs per se, but in how it frames memory and data bottlenecks for interactive generative world models. It has peripheral relevance for researchers interested in unified sequence modeling and action-conditioned pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActWorld extends chunk-autoregressive world generation with object interaction during rollout and introduces action-aware memory to preserve event-transition frames, instead of relying on recency-biased history compression. The paper also highlights the need for densely labeled human-object interaction data.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the abstract, the experiments likely compare navigation-only baselines against interaction-capable world models on controllability, consistency, and long-horizon memory retention. There is no direct evidence of contributions to language modeling objectives, tokenization, or scaling.

recommendation.zh: 不是LLM论文，但“事件帧比近期帧更该进记忆”这个判断值得借到长视频/多模态序列建模里；读问题设定和memory设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the claim that event-transition frames matter more than merely recent frames is worth borrowing for long-video and multimodal sequence modeling; read the problem framing and memory design only.

paper.title: OmniDrive: An LLM-Choreographed Multi-Agent World Model with Unified Latent Co-Compression for Multi-View Driving Video Generation
paper.abstract: Generative world models for autonomous driving face two unresolved tensions: heterogeneous control injection, where free-form language, HD-maps, trajectories, and camera poses reside in incompatible representational spaces, and post-hoc cross-view fusion, where per-camera latents fail to encode global 3-D geometry. We trace both to a single root cause: the absence of a shared symbolic interlingua aligning language, geometry, and pixels at the latent-token level. We present DRIVE-CHOREO, an LLM-c

summary.core_problem: 解决自动驾驶多视角视频生成中语言、地图、轨迹、相机位姿等控制信号异构，以及多相机 latent 后融合缺乏全局 3D 一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成和世界模型系统创新。它把 VLM/LLM agent、结构化中间表示和多视角视频 latent co-compression 结合起来，和统一 token 表示、跨模态控制注入有一定关系，但场景仍是驾驶视频生成。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DRIVE-CHOREO，将可控多视角视频生成重写为 latent choreography。系统使用三个 Qwen2.5-VL agent：Director 将用户意图解析为结构化 WorldScript，Cartographer 将其落到空间锚定 layout tokens，Auditor 用跨视角 critique 作为辅助监督。最终生成单一位置感知 token 序列，并通过 view-time permutation 与多视角视频共同压缩，以促使控制、几何和像素在 latent-token 层面对齐。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型参数、训练数据规模、对比方法或定量提升。可确认的是方法面向 multi-view driving video generation，强调语言、HD map、轨迹、相机姿态等控制信号和多视角视频 latent 的联合建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses controllable multi-view driving video generation, where heterogeneous controls and post-hoc cross-view fusion fail to provide a shared 3D-consistent latent structure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal generative world-model system. It is relevant to unified token representations and control injection, but the evidence is still from an autonomous-driving generation setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: DRIVE-CHOREO recasts multi-view video generation as latent choreography. Three Qwen2.5-VL agents act as a Director, Cartographer, and Auditor: they parse user intent into WorldScript, ground it into spatial layout tokens, and provide cross-view critiques as auxiliary supervision. The resulting position-aware token sequence is co-compressed with multi-view video through a view-time permutation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains. The described setup targets language-, map-, trajectory-, and camera-pose-controlled multi-view driving video generation.

recommendation.zh: 可看 latent-token 对齐和 view-time co-compression 设计；agent 编排像系统胶水，别把驾驶结果外推到通用世界模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-token alignment and view-time co-compression design; the agent choreography is mostly system glue and should not be over-generalized.

paper.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
paper.abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Cur

summary.core_problem: 现有世界模型无法同时满足Physical AI对多源异构数据原生学习、长时序持久状态保持、部署高效的三重核心需求
summary.importance: 范式创新+架构创新+数据方案贡献，首次提出面向Physical AI的原生世界模型全栈，覆盖预训练范式、数据课程与统一架构
summary.technical_approach: 1）提出原生预训练范式，搭配跨具身数据课程，按开放世界视频→人类行为数据→机器人交互数据的渐进路径组织训练；2）设计原生统一架构，采用混合线性时序注意力，用滑动窗口捕获局部动态、膨胀滑动窗口捕获中程依赖、门控线性注意力维持全局持久记忆
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与量化对比结果，仅提及完成形式化验证与相关评测体系构建

summary_en.core_problem: Existing world models cannot simultaneously meet three core requirements of Physical AI: native learning from heterogeneous multi-source data, persistent long-horizon state maintenance, and deployment efficiency
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation + architecture innovation + data pipeline contribution, first proposing a full native world model stack for Physical AI covering pretraining paradigm, data curriculum, and unified architecture
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Proposes a native pretraining paradigm with a cross-embodiment data curriculum that organizes training data progressively as open-world videos → human behavior data → robot interactions; 2) Designs a unified architecture with hybrid linear temporal attention, using sliding windows for local dynamics, dilated sliding windows for mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention for persistent global memory
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no specific model parameters, training data scale, or quantitative comparison results disclosed, only mentions formal verification and evaluation system construction

recommendation.zh: 跨具身渐进数据课程与混合时序注意力的组合设计改变了世界模型预训练数据组织的prior，应立刻在内部多模态预训练ablation中验证数据课程收益
recommendation.en: The combination of cross-embodiment progressive data curriculum and hybrid temporal attention shifts prior beliefs about world model pretraining data organization; validate curriculum gains in internal multimodal pretraining ablations immediately

paper.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for

summary.core_problem: 构建一个以自然语言为统一动作接口的具身智能视频世界模型，用于预测物理上合理的未来视觉轨迹。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的具身世界建模范式，通过语言条件下的视频生成，实现了跨机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人机迁移的统一建模，为策略训练增强、策略评估和下游控制提供了新途径。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 双流 MMDiT 架构：结合冻结的 Qwen2.5-VL 语义和视频 VAE 潜变量，通过层级联合注意力进行动作编码；2) 构建了包含 8.6M 视频-文本对（200M+ 帧）的具身世界知识（EWK）语料库，涵盖 20+ 种具身形态和 500+ 动作类别。
summary.experiments: 在机器人操作、自动驾驶等多个具身场景下进行了验证，但摘要未提供具体的定量结果。
summary.authors_note: 来自阿里 Qwen 团队的技术报告，展示了其在具身智能和多模态世界模型方向的最新进展。

summary_en.core_problem: Building a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence to predict physically grounded future visual trajectories using natural language as a unified action interface.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified embodied world modeling paradigm through language-conditioned video generation, achieving unified modeling across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer, providing new avenues for policy training augmentation, policy evaluation, and downstream control.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Double-Stream MMDiT architecture: couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention for action encoding; 2) Constructed the Embodied World Knowledge (EWK) corpus with 8.6M video-text pairs (200M+ frames) covering 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across multiple embodied scenarios such as robotic manipulation and autonomous driving, but the abstract does not provide specific quantitative results.
summary_en.authors_note: A technical report from the Alibaba Qwen team, showcasing their latest progress in embodied intelligence and multimodal world models.

recommendation.zh: 阿里 Qwen 团队的具身世界模型技术报告，关注其如何将语言作为统一接口来建模跨领域的视频生成，对多模态统一预训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Technical report on embodied world models from the Alibaba Qwen team. Worth noting how they use language as a unified interface for cross-domain video generation modeling, offering insights for multimodal unified pretraining.

paper.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
paper.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of proje

summary.core_problem: 构建一个支持可控长视野（long-horizon）生成的通用交互式视频世界模型，解决自回归生成中累积的风格和颜色漂移问题。
summary.importance: 提出了 DreamX-World 1.0，这是一个支持相机导航、区域重访和事件提示的交互式世界模型。其核心贡献在于将双向视频生成器转换为少步自回归世界模型的训练 recipe，以及处理长序列生成的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 数据引擎：结合 UE 渲染、游戏录像和真实视频（恢复相机几何）。2. 相机控制：提出 E-PRoPE，一种轻量级投影位置编码变体。3. 训练范式：使用因果强制（causal forcing）、DMD 风格蒸馏和 long-rollout 训练，将双向视频生成器转为自回归模型。4. 稳定性：通过在自生成的长视野上下文中训练，让模型暴露于自身生成的历史中，减少自回归块之间的风格/颜色漂移。
summary.experiments: 支持逼真、游戏和风格化领域的长视频生成，实现了相机控制和事件交互。
summary.authors_note: DreamX Team

summary_en.core_problem: Building a general-purpose interactive video world model for controllable long-horizon generation, addressing style and color drift accumulated in autoregressive generation.
summary_en.importance: Introduces DreamX-World 1.0, an interactive world model supporting camera navigation, region revisits, and promptable events. The core contribution lies in the training recipe that converts a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model and stabilizes long-sequence generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Data Engine: Combines UE rendering, gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. 2. Camera Control: Proposes E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding. 3. Training Paradigm: Converts a bidirectional video generator into an autoregressive model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. 4. Stability: Trains on self-generated long-horizon contexts to expose the model to its own generated history, reducing style/color drift across autoregressive chunks.
summary_en.experiments: Supports long video generation across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains, achieving camera control and event interaction.
summary_en.authors_note: DreamX Team

recommendation.zh: 关注其将双向生成器转为自回归模型的 long-rollout 训练技巧，对缓解长序列自回归生成的 error accumulation 有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Pay attention to its long-rollout training trick that converts a bidirectional generator to an AR model; useful for mitigating error accumulation in long-sequence AR generation.

paper.title: SIMMER: Benchmarking Latent Failures in LLM Executable Planning with a World Model
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners for autonomous agents in household environments. While existing benchmarks evaluate whether LLM-generated plans execute successfully, they overlook a critical type of failure: latent failures. Unlike immediate failures that trigger instant feedback at execution time and enable timely correction, latent failures do not immediately halt plan execution but silently compromise goal achievement. In severe cases, they cause irreversibl

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 作为可执行规划器时，现有 benchmark 只看计划是否立即失败，漏掉不会立刻中断执行但会破坏最终目标的 latent failures。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent planning 评测资产。它把“计划可执行”拆成即时前置条件失败和延迟显现的状态损害，对安全型 agent 评测有一定方法价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SIMMER，在厨房任务中构建人工校验的符号世界模型，包含 77 个动作、262 个唯一物体和约 46,800 种语义现实的交互；使用状态机 executor 按世界状态验证 LLM 生成计划，并检测即时前置条件错误与潜在失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出世界模型规模和数据来源：交互来自真实烹饪脚本；未提供完整被测模型列表、指标数值或相对 baseline 提升。评测重点是通过符号执行暴露传统成功率指标遗漏的 latent failures。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM executable planning failures that do not immediately stop execution but silently undermine the final goal.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-planning evaluation contribution. It separates immediate precondition failures from latent state corruption, which is useful for safety-oriented agent evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIMMER builds a human-curated symbolic kitchen world model with 77 actions, 262 objects, and roughly 46,800 semantically realistic interactions derived from real cooking scripts. A state-machine executor validates generated plans against world states and flags both immediate and latent failures.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the world-model scale and provenance, but not the full model list, quantitative results, or baseline deltas. The main experimental value is exposing failures missed by execution-success-only evaluation.

recommendation.zh: agent eval 可看 latent-failure 定义和 world-model schema；厨房域较窄，不必读实验表。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for the latent-failure definition and world-model schema; the kitchen scope is narrow, so the tables are optional.

paper.title: $μ_0$: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
paper.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present $μ_0$, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, $μ_0$ forecasts smooth 3

summary.core_problem: 用可扩展、与具体机器人形态无关的方式建模交互视频中的物理变化，而不是直接预测像素或依赖特定机器人动作标签。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把机器人世界模型的监督从 dense video reconstruction 转向稀疏 3D interaction traces。对 LLM 预训练研究员的间接价值是：它提供了一种把视频交互压缩成可语言对齐、可预测的中间表示的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 μ0，以显著交互点的平滑 3D 轨迹作为动作诱发变化的表示。TraceExtract 自动从多源视频中选择关键点、构建全局对齐轨迹，并把运动片段与层级语言 caption 关联；模型侧结合预训练视觉语言 backbone 与 trace 预测头进行预训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整参数量、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是跨视频来源提取 3D trace supervision，并验证 trace 预测相较像素预测或直接动作建模在机器人交互建模上的泛化性。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Jia-Bin Huang 和 Furong Huang；两位分别在视觉生成/视频理解和机器学习基础方法上有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to model action-induced physical change in interaction videos without dense pixel prediction or embodiment-specific action labels.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a representation shift for robotic world models: supervise prediction through sparse 3D interaction traces rather than full video reconstruction. For pretraining researchers, the relevant signal is the compression of embodied video into language-aligned, predictable intermediate state variables.
summary_en.technical_approach: μ0 predicts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions. TraceExtract automatically selects keypoints, builds globally aligned traces, and associates motion segments with hierarchical language captions; the model combines a pretrained vision-language backbone with trace forecasting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or numerical gains. The experiments appear to focus on extracting 3D trace supervision from diverse videos and testing whether trace prediction generalizes better than pixel-space or direct-action modeling for embodied interaction.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jia-Bin Huang and Furong Huang, both known for work in visual generative modeling, video understanding, and foundational machine learning methods.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读，但 trace 作为视频交互 tokenizer 的设定值得记下；看方法图和 TraceExtract 流程即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper to read deeply, but the trace-as-interaction-tokenizer idea is worth noting; inspect the method figure and TraceExtract pipeline.

paper.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
paper.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representa

summary.core_problem: 在机器人 world action model 中同时建模未来观测和可执行动作，但避免密集 4D 几何预测带来的慢速推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 embodied world model 的架构和训练设计。它不是 LLM 基座预训练核心论文，但 spatial register tokens、训练期几何读出、推理期移除分支的设计，对多模态世界模型和 action-conditioned transformer 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WAM4D，用轻量 spatial register tokens 作为训练期 future-depth readout，把预训练几何模型的 3D/4D 先验迁移到因果 video-action transformer 中；推理时移除 register 分支，以降低动作生成开销。论文还设计 causal mixture attention，用于 Mixture-of-Transformers，避免模型通过非因果几何分支偷看未来信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是比密集 4D 表示预测更快地生成可执行动作，并保持空间约束和遮挡接触几何信息。给定信息未包含模型参数量、训练数据规模、机器人任务集合、baseline 名单或数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Jian Tang；机构信息无法从给定摘要确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to model future observations and executable robot actions in a world action model while avoiding the inference cost of dense 4D geometry prediction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architecture and training design for embodied world models. It is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but the idea of training-time spatial register tokens and inference-time branch removal is relevant to multimodal world models and action-conditioned transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: WAM4D uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer priors from pretrained geometric models into a causal video-action transformer. The register branch is removed at inference for faster action generation. Causal mixture attention is introduced for the Mixture-of-Transformers setup to prevent non-causal shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames WAM4D as faster than dense 4D prediction while preserving spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry. The provided information does not include parameter count, training data scale, robot task suite, baselines, or numerical results.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jian Tang; affiliations are not confirmed from the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 technical design：训练期 register 蒸馏几何先验、推理期删分支，这个取舍对 embodied pretrain 有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the technical design: training-time registers distill geometric priors, then the branch is dropped at inference—a useful embodied-pretraining tradeoff.

paper.title: World Model Self-Distillation: Training World Models to Solve General Tasks
paper.abstract: Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability

summary.core_problem: 解决预训练视频生成世界模型依赖详细文本描述无法直接用于规划决策、监督微调数据成本高难以扩展的问题
summary.importance: 范式创新+方法创新，提出无需人工标注任务视频的可扩展框架，将视频扩散模型的生成能力转化为通用任务解决能力
summary.technical_approach: 提出自蒸馏结合强化学习的框架：1）用视觉-语言模型为无标注场景图像生成候选任务与分步解决方案；2）用解决方案条件预训练视频扩散模型（Demonstrator）生成执行视频；3）将Demonstrator的行为蒸馏到仅依赖图像和短任务提示的Executor模型，实现指令条件的任务求解
summary.experiments: 摘要截断未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与基线对比数值，核心贡献为可扩展的训练框架设计

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two limitations of pretrained video generator world models: reliance on detailed textual descriptions which blocks direct use for planning, and high cost of supervised fine-tuning data that is hard to scale
summary_en.importance: Paradigm + methodological innovation: proposes a scalable annotation-free framework to transfer generation capability of video diffusion models into general task-solving ability
summary_en.technical_approach: A self-distillation + reinforcement learning framework: 1) A VLM generates candidate tasks and step-by-step solutions for unlabeled scene images; 2) The solutions condition a pretrained video diffusion model (Demonstrator) to produce execution videos; 3) Distill Demonstrator's behavior into an Executor that only takes image and short task prompt for instruction-conditioned task solving
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated, no specific parameter scale, training data size or baseline comparison numbers provided; core contribution is the scalable training framework design

recommendation.zh: 视频世界模型的弱监督蒸馏思路可参考，仅看方法部分的框架设计即可，无直接可复用的LLM预训练结论
recommendation.en: Weakly-supervised distillation idea for video world models is worth referencing, only read the framework design in method section, no directly reusable conclusions for LLM pretraining

paper.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
paper.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model ev

summary.core_problem: WorldOlympiad 解决的是视频世界模型评测过于偏向画质、语义对齐和短期平滑性的问题。它把评测目标转向三个更接近“世界模型”要求的维度：物理规律是否可信，三维几何是否稳定，长程交互是否能按控制信号持续演化。
summary.importance: 这篇更适合作为评测资产泛读。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在多模态世界模型的能力拆解方式。它提醒一个关键点：视频生成模型如果要承担世界模型角色，常规视觉质量指标不足以反映建模质量。对做原生多模态预训练、视频 token 建模、AR+diffusion 联合建模的人，WorldOlympiad 提供了一组可操作的诊断维度，尤其是把物理、几何和交互控制分开评估，而不是用单一视频质量分数覆盖所有失败模式。
summary.technical_approach: WorldOlympiad 构建了 1,000 条高质量长视频，覆盖 robotics、gaming、real-world 三类场景。其中 robotics 来自 RoboCOIN，筛选 400 条双臂机器人操作视频，主要考察接触、抓取、状态变化和动作一致性；gaming 来自 GameGen-X，采样并切分为最长约 60 秒的视频片段，覆盖玩家导航、视角移动、战斗、技能释放和游戏状态变化；real-world 来自 LVD-2M，包含更开放的运动和相机动态。评测设计分为三条 track。physical track 使用物体分割和 MLLM-as-judge，检查力学、热现象、材料属性等可解释规则是否被遵守。geometry track 对生成视频做 3D 重建，文中提到使用 Gaussian splatting 来诊断跨帧几何一致性。interaction track 关注长程 chunk-by-chunk 生成中，模型是否能跟随控制信号，并保持状态连续。和 VBench、VBench++ 这类偏感知质量与时序平滑性的评测相比，它的差异在于评估对象不是“视频好不好看”，而是“生成过程是否能支撑可控、可持续的世界状态演化”。
summary.experiments: 实验部分 benchmark 了 8 个代表性长视频生成 pipeline，并在三类场景、三条能力轴上分析失效模式。给出的主要发现是：现有长视频模型在长上下文一致性、物理规则遵守、三维结构稳定性和交互控制上都有系统性短板。数据规模是 1,000 条长视频，组成是 400 条机器人视频、400 条游戏视频、200 条真实世界视频。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整结果表，具体模型名称、逐项分数和统计显著性无法确认；可确认的是评测协议强调长程生成和交互式 chunk 生成，而不是短视频单次生成。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构成和三条 track 的 metric 设计：physical track 如何把分割结果和 MLLM judge 结合，geometry track 如何用 3D 重建暴露跨帧结构漂移，interaction track 如何定义 chunk 间控制一致性。若关注视频世界模型预训练，可以重点看失败案例和指标定义，而不是只看 leaderboard 分数。最值得带走的是能力拆分方式：物理、几何、交互三类错误通常不会被 FVD、CLIP score 或普通视频质量指标稳定捕捉。

summary_en.core_problem: WorldOlympiad targets a gap in video world-model evaluation: most existing benchmarks measure visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal smoothness, but do not directly test physical plausibility, 3D consistency, and controllable long-horizon interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation resource rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from how it decomposes video world-model capability. For native multimodal pretraining, video-token modeling, and AR-diffusion hybrid systems, the benchmark makes a useful distinction between perceptual video quality and model reliability as a simulator. A model can produce visually plausible clips while still violating object permanence, geometry, physical dynamics, or user control.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark contains 1,000 curated long videos across three domains: 400 robotics videos from RoboCOIN, 400 gaming videos from GameGen-X, and 200 real-world videos from LVD-2M. The robotics subset emphasizes contact, manipulation, gripper motion, and action-consistent state changes. The gaming subset covers navigation, camera control, combat events, skills, and evolving game states, with long videos split into shorter chunks of up to about 60 seconds. The real-world subset adds open-domain motion and camera dynamics. The evaluation is organized into three tracks. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to check interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal behavior, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos, including with Gaussian splatting, to probe 3D consistency. The interaction track evaluates whether chunk-by-chunk generation follows control signals while preserving state continuity. Compared with VBench-style evaluation, the key difference is that the unit of evaluation is world-model behavior, not only video appearance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 8 representative long-video generation pipelines on the benchmark. The reported diagnostic finding is that current systems show systematic weaknesses in long-context consistency, physical reasoning, geometric stability, and interaction control. The confirmed dataset scale is 1,000 videos: 400 robotics, 400 gaming, and 200 real-world. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact per-model scores and ablation numbers cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction and the metric definitions for the three tracks. The most useful parts are the design choices behind physical-rule judging, 3D reconstruction-based geometry evaluation, and chunk-level interaction fidelity. For researchers working on video world models, the failure taxonomy is likely more informative than the aggregate ranking.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态世界模型预训练的研究员可重点看§3的评测维度设计，其余实验结果部分快速浏览即可。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal world model pretraining can focus on evaluation dimension design in §3, skim the rest of the experiment results.

paper.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for World Action Models (WAMs). However, existing approaches suffer from slow training convergence and limited converged accuracy, particularly at high frame rates, as the training supervision is confined to the current chunk without explicit signals about future dynamics; they also suffer from slow inference due to iterative video denoising. In this paper, we present Next Forcing, a multi-chunk prediction (MCP) framework for cau

summary.core_problem: Next Forcing 解决的是自回归视频世界模型中 teacher-forced next-chunk denoising 的短视监督问题：模型只预测当前 chunk，容易依赖相邻帧外观相似性，而不是学习更长程的动态规律；在高帧率视频中，这个问题更明显。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练目标设计有直接启发。它把 LLM 中 multi-token prediction 的思想迁移到连续视频 latent 和 flow/diffusion 生成过程，用多未来 chunk 监督强化模型对时间动力学的学习。贡献不只是视频领域的指标提升，更重要的是提出了一种可复用的训练信号设计：当相邻 token、frame 或 chunk 的局部预测太容易时，应增加更远未来的辅助预测目标，让梯度更直接地约束表示层中的动态信息。这个思路对高帧率视频预训练、世界模型、动作条件生成，以及统一多模态 LM 的长程建模都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基础设定是因果视频世界模型，用 flow matching 在视频 latent 空间做 chunk 级生成。常规 teacher forcing 用真实历史 chunk 作为条件，只要求模型去噪当前 chunk。作者指出这会形成 appearance shortcut：相邻 chunk 视觉差异很小，模型可以通过近似复制历史外观来降低 loss，而不需要充分建模物体运动、交互状态和未来动力学。Next Forcing 的核心是 multi-chunk prediction，给主模型添加轻量辅助 MCP 模块，同时预测多个未来 chunk，例如 next 1、next 2、next 3。辅助模块之间形成因果链，使更远未来的预测依赖较近未来的中间预测，而不是各自孤立地从同一上下文回归目标。为了让多步监督真正作用到主干表示，MCP 模块融合主模型多个中间层特征，而不是只接最后一层。作者还给 MCP 模块使用更高的 timestep shift，使辅助预测面对更强噪声或更困难的去噪状态，从而迫使它们更多依赖主模型学到的动态表示。推理时，这些 MCP 模块可以保留，用于并行预测后续 chunk，从训练辅助头变成推理加速组件。和 teacher forcing、self forcing、diffusion forcing 的区别在于，Next Forcing 不主要改变上下文构造或噪声调度，而是改变模型被要求预测的目标范围。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖机器人世界模型、物理理解和通用视频预训练。RoboTwin 上，Next Forcing 达到 Clean/Random 94.1%/93.5%。在 50 fps 设置下，训练收敛速度提升 2.3 倍，并且最终精度更高。推理阶段保留 MCP 模块后，可获得约 2 倍生成加速。PhyWorld 上报告了明显提升，说明多未来 chunk 监督对物理规律理解有帮助。作者还在 350 万条内部视频 clip 的通用视频预训练上验证，FVD 降低超过 50%，这说明改进不只来自机器人数据或特定任务结构。消融重点包括 timestep shift、多层特征融合和因果 MCP chain：这些组件共同决定多 chunk 预测能否从离散语言 token 场景有效迁移到连续视频 latent 场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 myopic supervision 和 appearance shortcut 的定义，再看方法部分的 MCP 结构图和训练目标。实验部分重点看 Figure 1 的 50 fps 收敛曲线，以及 Section 5 的消融实验，尤其是 timestep shift、多层 feature fusion、causal MCP chain 三个设计的单独贡献。若关注 LLM 预训练，可把它当作 multi-token prediction 在非文本生成中的一次具体改造来读：难点不在“多预测几个未来步”这个表面形式，而在连续 latent、迭代去噪和长程动态之间如何传递有效梯度。

summary_en.core_problem: Next Forcing addresses the myopic supervision problem in autoregressive video world models. Standard teacher-forced next-chunk denoising only supervises the current chunk, so the model can exploit visual similarity between adjacent chunks instead of learning longer-range dynamics. This shortcut becomes especially harmful at high frame rates.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to pretraining objective design. It adapts the intuition behind multi-token prediction in language models to continuous video latents and flow/diffusion-style generation. The broader lesson is that when local prediction is too easy, auxiliary prediction of farther future states can provide a stronger training signal for dynamics. This is useful for high-frame-rate video pretraining, action-conditioned world models, and unified multimodal models where temporal structure is not well captured by a purely local loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: The base model is a causal video world model trained with flow matching over video chunks. In the standard setup, the model denoises the current chunk conditioned on clean past chunks. Next Forcing augments this setup with lightweight multi-chunk prediction modules that predict multiple future chunks, such as next 1, next 2, and next 3. These modules form a causal prediction chain, so farther-horizon prediction is not just an independent auxiliary head attached to the same representation. To make the auxiliary losses affect the main model more directly, the MCP modules fuse intermediate features from multiple main-model layers rather than using only the final layer. The paper also applies a larger timestep shift to the MCP modules, making their denoising task harder and increasing their reliance on the main model’s learned temporal representation. At inference time, the auxiliary modules can be kept to predict future chunks in parallel with the current generation process, turning the training auxiliary path into an acceleration mechanism. The method differs from teacher forcing, self forcing, and diffusion forcing because it changes what the model is asked to predict, rather than only changing the context or the noise schedule.
summary_en.experiments: On RoboTwin, Next Forcing reports 94.1% on the Clean split and 93.5% on the Random split. At 50 fps, it reaches 2.3x faster convergence and a higher converged accuracy than standard next-chunk training. Keeping the MCP modules during inference gives about 2x generation acceleration. The method also improves performance on PhyWorld, indicating better physical-dynamics modeling. On general video pretraining with 3.5M in-house video clips, it reduces FVD by more than 50%, suggesting that the benefit is not limited to robot-specific data. The most informative ablations are on timestep shift, multi-layer feature fusion, and the causal MCP chain, which are the components that make multi-chunk prediction work for continuous video latents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-close read in about 35–45 minutes. Start with the discussion of myopic supervision and appearance shortcuts in the introduction. Then read the MCP architecture and objective carefully. In the experiments, prioritize the 50 fps convergence curve in Figure 1 and the ablations in Section 5. For LLM pretraining researchers, the useful angle is not the video application alone, but how a multi-token-prediction-style objective is modified for continuous latents, iterative denoising, and long-horizon temporal dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 只看训练目标设计即可；视频结果未给足细节，但多步未来监督可作为 AR 预训练的弱类比。
recommendation.en: Read the objective, not the video metrics; the multi-horizon supervision is a useful weak analogue for AR pretraining.

paper.title: What Makes Video World Model Latents Action-Relevant: Prediction over Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used to provide predictive visual representations, yet it remains unclear which pretraining signals induce action-relevant structure in their latent spaces. We study this question through a unified probe-based evaluation across diverse encoder families, including image-only self-supervision, video pretraining with and without latent prediction, reconstruction-based autoencoders, diffusion models, and shortcut-forcing dynamics models. Using a common inverse-dyn

summary.core_problem: 视频世界模型的预训练信号如何塑造隐空间的动作相关性结构尚不明确，领域缺乏对不同预训练范式的统一控制变量对比。
summary.importance: 原理分析贡献，首次通过统一探针框架系统对比多类预训练目标对视频表征动作相关性的影响，修正了领域对表征质量的固有认知。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建基于逆动力学探针的统一评估框架，覆盖图像自监督、带/不带隐态预测的视频预训练、重建型自编码器、扩散模型、捷径强制动力学模型等多类编码器范式。
summary.experiments: 对比V-JEPA、VideoMAE等主流模型，发现时间维度的视频预训练是动作相关性的核心驱动因素；高像素重建质量的模型可能动作恢复能力接近0，视频预训练的自监督编码器取得视觉保真与动作预测的最优帕累托平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: How pretraining signals shape action-relevant structure in video world model latent spaces remains unclear, and the field lacks controlled unified comparisons across different pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis contribution, the first work to systematically compare the impact of various pretraining objectives on action relevance of video representations via a unified probe framework, correcting prevailing assumptions about representation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a unified evaluation framework based on inverse dynamics probing, covering image self-supervision, video pretraining with/without latent prediction, reconstruction-based autoencoders, diffusion models, and shortcut-forcing dynamics models.
summary_en.experiments: Comparison of mainstream models including V-JEPA and VideoMAE shows temporal video pretraining is the core driver of action relevance; models with high pixel reconstruction quality may have near-zero action recoverability, and video-pretrained self-supervised encoders achieve the best Pareto trade-off between visual fidelity and action prediction.

recommendation.zh: 视频表征预训练目标的对比结论可作为多模态预训练目标选型的弱参考，仅读摘要和核心结论即可。
recommendation.en: Findings on video representation pretraining objectives can serve as weak reference for multimodal pretraining target selection, read abstract and core conclusions only.

paper.title: DisCo: World Models with Discrete Camera Motion Control
paper.abstract: Controllable video world models target interactive world exploration, where models must faithfully execute explicit action commands while preserving visual quality and temporal coherence. However, most existing approaches rely on continuous camera trajectories as action conditions, which often lead to unreliable action following, especially under complex motion sequences. In this work, we identify action representation entanglement as a key bottleneck in controllable video generation, and show t

summary.core_problem: 现有可控视频世界模型采用连续相机轨迹作为动作条件，存在动作表示纠缠问题，导致复杂运动序列下的动作跟随可靠性差。
summary.importance: 方法创新+Benchmark贡献，首次提出离散相机动作原语表示解耦动作特征，同时发布专门的可控视频世界模型评测基准DisCoBench。
summary.technical_approach: 将相机运动编码为一组紧凑的离散动作原语，提升不同动作模式的特征可分性，基于该表示构建可控视频世界模型DisCo。
summary.experiments: 在DisCoBench的短期、长程、高动态探索场景下，DisCo的动作跟随准确率和生成质量显著优于基于连续动作表示的基线方法。
summary.authors_note: Cohere团队产出，该团队长期从事大语言模型与多模态建模研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing controllable video world models use continuous camera trajectories as action conditions, which suffer from action representation entanglement, leading to poor action following reliability under complex motion sequences.
summary_en.importance: Methodological + benchmark contribution, first proposes discrete camera motion primitives to disentangle action features, and releases DisCoBench, a dedicated benchmark for controllable video world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Encode camera motions into a compact set of discrete action primitives to improve feature separability across different motion patterns, and build the controllable video world model DisCo based on this representation.
summary_en.experiments: On DisCoBench's short-term, long-horizon, and highly dynamic exploration scenarios, DisCo significantly outperforms continuous action representation baselines in action following accuracy and generation quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Produced by Cohere, a team with long-term research on large language models and multimodal modeling.

recommendation.zh: 离散动作原语解耦表示的思路对统一多模态离散建模很有启发，重点看§3的离散化设计和DisCoBench构造。
recommendation.en: The discrete action primitive disentanglement idea is insightful for unified multimodal discrete modeling; focus on §3 discretization design and DisCoBench construction.

paper.title: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model
paper.abstract: Video world models have made rapid progress in generating controllable visual experiences, but most of them still simulate the world from a single observer. Extending such models to multiple agents raises a central challenge: if each agent's future state is generated independently, overlapping views may instantiate different versions of the same scene, leading to inconsistent objects, layouts, and appearances across agents. Conventional camera conditioning controls individual trajectories, but i

summary.core_problem: 如何生成多智能体视角下几何一致、相机可控的视频？
summary.importance: 提出了一种多智能体视频世界模型，解决了多视角生成中场景几何不一致的问题，对具身智能和多视角视频生成有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将多智能体生成构建为联合几何感知的去噪过程。在一个全注意力序列中处理所有智能体的视频，使用多智能体 RoPE 区分智能体身份并保持时间坐标同步，注入相对相机姿态作为几何条件。
summary.experiments: 在多智能体视频生成任务上进行了实验，验证了跨视角一致性和相机控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to generate geometry-consistent and camera-controllable videos from multi-agent perspectives?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a multi-agent video world model that addresses the issue of scene geometry inconsistency in multi-view generation, offering reference value for embodied AI and multi-view video generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates multi-agent generation as a joint geometry-aware denoising process. Processes all agent videos within a full-attention sequence, uses multi-agent RoPE to distinguish identities while preserving temporal coordinates, and injects relative camera poses as geometric conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted experiments on multi-agent video generation tasks, validating cross-view consistency and camera control capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 多视角视频生成工作，对纯 LLM 预训练启发有限，可作为多模态世界模型构建的参考。
recommendation.en: Multi-view video generation work; limited inspiration for pure LLM pretraining, but serves as a reference for multimodal world model construction.

paper.title: Bridging the Agent-World Gap: Text World Models for LLM-based Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used in interactive textual environments, from web navigation and code editing to tool use and long-horizon dialogue. Yet many remain largely reactive, mapping observations to actions without an explicit model of how these environments are structured and evolve. This motivates text world models (TWMs): transition models over textual states that, given a state and a candidate action, predict the resulting webpage, terminal output, API respo

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 在文本交互环境中大多是反应式的，缺乏对环境结构和演化的显式建模，无法支持规划、高效学习和原则性评估。
summary.importance: 首次系统提出文本世界模型（TWM）的形式化框架，将其作为连接 Agent 与环境的桥梁，属于综述与框架性贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕形式化框架和 Agent 生命周期组织：（1）基础：定义 TWM 并按状态表示和领域分类；（2）构建：LLM-as-WM 和 Code-as-WM 两种范式；（3）应用：如何支持规划、学习和评估。
summary.experiments: 无独立实验，是系统性综述。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based agents in interactive textual environments remain largely reactive, lacking explicit models of how environments are structured and evolve, hindering planning, efficient learning, and principled evaluation.
summary_en.importance: First systematic formalization of Text World Models (TWM) as a bridge between agents and environments; a framework and survey contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Organized around a formal framework and the agent lifecycle: (1) Foundations — define TWM, characterize by state representation and grounding domain; (2) Construction — taxonomize LLM-as-WM and Code-as-WM paradigms; (3) Application — support planning, learning, and evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; a systematic survey.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 世界模型方向的文献地图备查，不读正文；目前该方向尚未形成对 pretrain 的反哺信号。
recommendation.en: Use as a literature map for agent world models; skip the full text — the direction hasn't yet produced actionable signals for pretraining.

paper.title: Thinking with Imagination: Agentic Visual Spatial Reasoning with World Simulators
paper.abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning capabilities, their spatial reasoning abilities remain largely constrained to the observed images and text-oriented chain-of-thought. They often struggle to infer unobserved layouts, maintain cross-view consistency, and reason from alternative viewpoints when only limited egocentric observations are available. In this work, we study this problem as thinking with imagination, where a VLM actively acquires imagined visual evide

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 在有限视角输入下难以进行空间推理、跨视角一致性推断和未观测布局想象的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 agentic VLM 方法：把“推理时调用世界模拟器生成想象证据”做成闭环。对基座预训练本身不是直接推进，但对多模态模型是否需要内生世界模型、以及 test-time compute 如何分配，有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Astra，将一个经 RL 训练的 VLM 策略 Astra-VL 与一个 Bagel-based 世界模拟器 Astra-WM 耦合。推理时，模型根据上下文图像和自然语言相机运动生成新视角观察，再把这些 imagined evidence 回流给 VLM 做空间判断。为提高想象证据可靠性，Astra-WM 还做了 view consistency tuning，以改善姿态与内容一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数量和完整基线。实验核心应是空间推理任务上，相比纯文本 CoT 或仅观察输入的 VLM，加入世界模拟器后在跨视角、布局推断和替代视角 reasoning 上取得提升。由于 setup 依赖专门 world simulator，结论更像系统组合收益，而非纯模型能力结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inability of VLMs to perform spatial reasoning, cross-view consistency, and unseen-layout inference when only limited egocentric observations are available.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agentic VLM paper: it closes the loop by letting the model query a world simulator for imagined evidence during reasoning. It does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to questions around internal world models and test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Astra couples an RL-trained VLM policy, Astra-VL, with a Bagel-based world simulator, Astra-WM. During reasoning, the model issues action-conditioned camera motions to generate novel-view observations, which are then fed back as imagined evidence. Astra-WM is further improved with view-consistency tuning to better preserve pose and content consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or full baselines. The key empirical claim is likely that adding a world simulator improves spatial reasoning over pure text CoT or observation-only VLMs on cross-view and layout inference tasks. Because the setup depends on a specialized simulator, the gains are better interpreted as system-level benefits than as pure model capability gains.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线，但它把“推理时外接世界模型”做得很具体；只看 simulator 接口设计和 ablation，别把收益误读成基座能力提升。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it makes the 'reason with an external world model' idea concrete; read the simulator interface and ablations, not the headline gains.

paper.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
paper.abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the \emph{world modeling interface} to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the \emph{language reasoning} capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA li

summary.core_problem: 如何把世界建模（预测未来状态）、语言推理（分解子任务）与动作生成统一到一个具身基础模型里，支持长时程任务。
summary.importance: 属于具身多模态统一建模路线：把“next-state world model”和“VLA 的语言规划”揉到同一 AR Transformer 里；对统一 tokenization/多头监督/专家模块接口有参考，但更偏机器人系统而非通用 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WLA：输入文本指令、图像与机器人状态；联合预测文本子任务、子目标图像与机器人动作。核心是 AR Transformer（对比一些 WAM 用双向 diffusion Transformer）。用 World Expert 提供世界建模监督（物理动态），并将其作为表征帮助 Action Expert 学习状态-动作相关；还引入 meta-queries 机制（摘要未展开）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模（egocentric videos 量级）、机器人平台、任务集与对比基线的具体指标；需要看正文确认：是否端到端训练、World Expert/Action Expert 的训练方式与消融、以及与 diffusion-based WAM/VLA 的公平对照。

summary_en.core_problem: How to unify world modeling (next-state prediction), language reasoning (subtask decomposition), and action synthesis in one embodied foundation model for long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: An embodied multimodal unification attempt: combining next-state world modeling and VLA-style language planning within an AR Transformer. Useful for thinking about unified token spaces and multi-head supervision, but it’s more robotics-system flavored than general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: WLA takes text instructions, images, and robot states, and jointly predicts textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions. Uses an AR Transformer backbone (vs bidirectional diffusion Transformers in some WAMs). A World Expert provides supervision for physical dynamics, which is leveraged to help an Action Expert model state–action correlation; meta-queries are mentioned but not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: No concrete dataset scale, robot platforms, tasks, or numbers in the abstract. Verify in the paper: end-to-end training details, World/Action Expert ablations, and fair comparisons to diffusion-based WAM/VLA baselines.

recommendation.zh: 更像具身系统整合而非预训练范式突破；只看它怎么把 world-model loss 接到 AR backbone、以及 World/Action expert 的接口与消融，别在任务成绩上浪费时间。
recommendation.en: More system integration than a pretraining paradigm shift; focus on how the world-model loss is wired into an AR backbone and the World/Action expert interfaces/ablations, not the task scores.

paper.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
paper.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosm

summary.core_problem: Cosmos 3 试图解决一个统一建模问题：如何让同一类基座模型同时处理和生成语言、图像、视频、音频与动作序列，并服务于 embodied agent 和物理世界建模。它不是单独做 VLM、视频生成器、语音模型或机器人策略模型，而是把这些能力放进一个 omnimodal world model 训练框架中。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在三个方面。第一，它把多模态理解、生成和动作建模放在同一个 token/sequence 视角下，延续了 Chameleon、Transfusion、Show-o 一类统一建模路线，但进一步加入视频、音频和 action。第二，它明确区分 reasoner 与 generator 的数据、训练和服务路径，说明统一模型并不等于所有模态共用完全相同的训练目标和算子；在工程上需要为不同输出形态保留差异化结构。第三，报告包含较完整的数据管线、训练基础设施、video tokenizer、attention 实现、分布式训练、checkpoint、serving 和 benchmark infra 描述，这些内容对真实大规模多模态预训练比单个 benchmark 分数更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 架构核心是 mixture-of-transformers。模型支持语言、图像、视频、音频和动作的编码，并通过灵活的 token arrangement 描述不同输入输出配置。生成模式不是固定的 text-to-X，而是面向多种条件生成与世界状态预测。MoT 采用 dual-tower layer structure 和 dual-stream joint attention：这种设计保留不同模态或不同功能流的专用参数，同时通过联合注意力完成跨模态信息交互。位置编码部分使用 multimodal position embedding，并包含 position index allocation 与 absolute temporal modulation，用来处理图像空间位置、视频时间轴、音频时间结构和动作序列之间的坐标差异。训练上分成 reasoner training 和 generator training。reasoner 侧包括预训练和 SFT，偏理解、推理和指令跟随；generator 侧包括预训练、mid-training，以及 text-to-image、image-to-video、robot policy 等 post-training。数据部分也按 reasoner data 与 generator data 拆开，后者进一步覆盖图像/视频、音频和动作。工程部分强调大规模数据处理、embedding 存储与语义检索、数据可视化检查、训练 dataloader、attention kernel、分布式训练、选择性 activation checkpointing、torch compile、video tokenizer、checkpointing，以及面向 reasoner 和 generator 的 serving 框架。
summary.experiments: 结果部分按 reasoner evaluation 与 generator evaluation 组织，后者覆盖图像生成、视频生成等任务。摘要称 post-trained Cosmos 3 在开源 text-to-image 和 image-to-video 排名中表现领先，并在理解与生成任务上覆盖较多评测维度。由于提供内容主要是目录和高层描述，无法可靠抽取具体模型规模、数据 token 数、训练 compute、分辨率、视频帧数、batch size、损失配比或每个 benchmark 的分数。更值得关注的是实验设计的覆盖面：同一模型家族同时评估 VLM 式理解、图像生成、视频生成、音频和动作相关能力，这能检验统一训练是否只是共享外壳，还是在模态之间形成可复用表示。若正文包含消融，优先看 MoT 相比单塔 Transformer、dual-stream joint attention、multimodal position embedding、absolute temporal modulation、video tokenizer 和不同训练阶段的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读第 2、3、4、5 章，结果章节可带着具体问题看。第 2 章是核心：重点看 encoders、token arrangement、generation mode、MoT、dual-stream joint attention 和 multimodal position embedding。第 3 章关注数据配比和数据质量控制，尤其是 reasoner data 与 generator data 为什么分开，以及图像/视频、音频、action 数据如何进入同一训练体系。第 4 章看训练阶段划分：pre-training、mid-training、post-training 的目标函数和数据分布是否变化，以及 reasoner 与 generator 是否共享参数或共享表示。第 5 章对做大规模训练的人很有用，尤其是 dataloader、attention、checkpointing、video tokenizer 和吞吐统计。预计泛读 1 小时可以掌握框架，精读架构和训练细节需要 3 小时以上。

summary_en.core_problem: Cosmos 3 addresses unified world-model pretraining across language, image, video, audio, and action sequences. The goal is not to build separate VLMs, video generators, audio models, and robot-policy models, but to place these modalities under a single omnimodal sequence-modeling framework for Physical AI.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to foundation-model pretraining because it treats multimodal generation, multimodal understanding, and action modeling as one modeling problem. It extends the line of unified multimodal models such as Chameleon, Transfusion, and Show-o toward video, audio, and action. A useful design choice is the separation between reasoner and generator pipelines: a unified model family still needs different data mixtures, objectives, training stages, and serving paths for different output types. The infrastructure details are also important. Large-scale omnimodal pretraining is often limited less by the high-level architecture than by data processing, tokenization, throughput, checkpointing, and serving constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The architecture is built around a mixture-of-transformers design. Cosmos 3 includes encoders for image/video, audio, and action, and uses flexible token arrangements to support many input-output configurations. Its generation mode is not restricted to text-to-image or text-to-video; it is intended to cover conditional generation, simulation, and action-related prediction. The mixture-of-transformers block uses a dual-tower layer structure and dual-stream joint attention.
