This keeps some modality- or function-specific parameters while still allowing cross-modal information exchange through attention. The positional system uses multimodal position embeddings, with explicit position-index allocation and absolute temporal modulation to handle spatial image grids, video time, audio time, and action sequences. Training is split into reasoner training and generator training. The reasoner side includes pretraining and supervised fine-tuning; the generator side includes pretraining, mid-training, text-to-image post-training, image-to-video post-training, and robot-policy post-training. The report also describes data infrastructure, semantic retrieval over embeddings, dataset inspection tools, dataloading, attention implementation, distributed training, selective activation checkpointing, torch compile for Transformer blocks, video tokenizer infrastructure, checkpointing, and separate serving paths for reasoner and generator models.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is organized into reasoner evaluation and generator evaluation, with image and video generation called out explicitly. The abstract reports strong open-source rankings for post-trained text-to-image and image-to-video models, and broad coverage across understanding and generation tasks. The supplied content does not expose reliable numerical details such as parameter counts, training-token counts, compute budget, resolution, frame length, batch size, loss weights, or benchmark scores. The most important experimental question is whether the unified family transfers useful representation across modalities, rather than merely combining several task-specific systems behind one interface. If the full results include ablations, the highest-value ones are likely to be mixture-of-transformers versus a single shared Transformer, dual-stream joint attention, multimodal position embeddings, absolute temporal modulation, video tokenizer choices, and the separate effects of pretraining, mid-training, and post-training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the architecture chapter. The key items are encoders, token arrangement, generation mode, mixture-of-transformers, dual-stream joint attention, and multimodal positional encoding. Then read the data chapter with attention to why reasoner data and generator data are separated, and how image/video, audio, and action data are cleaned, represented, and mixed. The training chapter is central for pretraining researchers: check how objectives and distributions change from pretraining to mid-training and post-training, and whether the reasoner and generator share parameters or only share a modeling interface. The infrastructure chapter is worth reading for practical lessons on large-scale multimodal training, especially dataloading, attention kernels, checkpointing, video tokenization, and throughput. A one-hour skim should capture the system design; a careful read of architecture and training will take several hours.

recommendation.zh: 统一多模态世界模型的范式级工作，mixture-of-transformers架构融合五种模态的处理与生成值得深入研究，对pretrain研究员理解统一建模范式有直接启发，应重点读架构设计章节
recommendation.en: Paradigm-level unified multimodal world model; mixture-of-transformers architecture spanning five modalities is directly insightful for pretrain researchers studying unified modeling paradigms — focus on architecture section.

paper.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
paper.abstract: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physic

summary.core_problem: 从单目视频数据扩展多智能体视频世界模型到开放域环境，面临数据稀缺和世界状态对齐两个核心挑战
summary.importance: 首次提出从单视角视频直接扩展多智能体视频世界模型的框架，属于多模态生成领域的方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 引入Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU)将单目镜头分解为相机自运动和可见目标空间轨迹，自然提取同步的多智能体世界状态
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体参数量、数据集规模和SOTA对比数据
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学、浙江大学、南洋理工大学合作，Dacheng Tao为资深作者

summary_en.core_problem: Scaling multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments from single-view video data, facing data scarcity and world state alignment challenges
summary_en.importance: First framework for scaling multi-agent video world models directly from single-view videos; methodological innovation in multimodal generation
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to decompose monocular footage into camera ego-motion and subject spatial trajectories, naturally extracting synchronized multi-agent world states
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific model sizes, dataset scales, or SOTA comparison numbers
summary_en.authors_note: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Zhejiang University, Nanyang Technological University; Dacheng Tao as senior author

recommendation.zh: 视频世界模型扩展思路有一定新意，但摘要信息量不足，且与LLM pretrain无直接关联，作为literature备查
recommendation.en: Video world model scaling idea has some novelty but abstract lacks detail; no direct relevance to LLM pretrain — keep as literature reference only.

paper.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
paper.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and

summary.core_problem: 自动驾驶闭环仿真中，传统重建式神经模拟器受限于初始采集数据，无法泛化到高度动态或全新场景。
summary.importance: 系统创新：NVIDIA提出基于Cosmos扩散模型的生成式世界模型OmniDreams，用于自动驾驶实时闭环仿真。大规模训练(21k小时驾驶数据)。
summary.technical_approach: 从Cosmos扩散模型进行中期和后期训练(mid- and post-training)，自回归生成动作条件视频。结合世界模型，实时生成。
summary.experiments: 在21k小时驾驶场景数据上训练，能合成传统模拟器难以捕捉的复杂未观测现象(如极端天气、异常驾驶行为)。摘要被截断。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA。包含Amlan Kar, Despoina Paschalidou等知名研究员。Cosmos是NVIDIA的基础扩散模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Reconstruction-based neural simulators for autonomous driving are fundamentally constrained by initial captured data and fail to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes in closed-loop simulation.
summary_en.importance: System innovation: NVIDIA proposes OmniDreams, a generative world model built on Cosmos diffusion model for real-time closed-loop AV simulation. Large-scale training (21k hours of driving data).
summary_en.technical_approach: Mid- and post-training from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. Leverages rich visual priors of Cosmos foundation model.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on 21k hours of driving scenarios. Synthesizes complex unobserved phenomena hard for traditional simulators (extreme weather, anomalous driving behaviors). Abstract is truncated.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA. Includes notable researchers such as Amlan Kar, Despoina Paschalidou. Cosmos is NVIDIA's foundation diffusion model.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA在世界模型+自动驾驶仿真方向的工程性工作。对LLM基座研究参考价值有限，作为行业动态了解即可。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA engineering work on world models for AV simulation. Limited reference value for LLM foundation research; useful as industry context.

paper.title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models
paper.abstract: Text-agent environments are typically modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), assuming that the simulator's latent state and transition dynamics are hidden from the agent. Yet little work has examined whether executable code can be induced to serve as a world model for prediction and planning under partial observability. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided

summary.core_problem: 解决文本环境 agent 在部分可观测条件下如何构造可执行、可修补的世界模型，用于预测和规划，而不是依赖黑盒 next-observation 预测器。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏 agent/world model 方法，而非 LLM 基座训练。价值在于提出一种可执行代码世界模型的思路：世界模型不是神经网络隐状态，而是可检查、可回放、可局部修补的 Python 程序。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PatchWorld，用 gradient-free 的 counterexample-guided code repair，把离线轨迹归纳成可执行 Python 世界模型。模型维护符号化 belief state，并通过动作更新规则进行状态转移；当预测与环境反馈冲突时，用反例驱动的局部程序修补来迭代改进。规划时可直接在代码世界模型上做 one-step lookahead，而不需要在预测模块内部调用 LLM。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个 AgentGym 环境上评测，PatchWorld-Simple 在代码式规划方法中取得最高 planning score，live one-step lookahead 的宏平均成功率达到 76.4%。摘要未给出与神经 world model 或纯 LLM planner 的完整对比细节，也未体现与预训练相关的训练规模信息。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong Baptist University、Beijing Institute of Technology、SUSTech、Wayne State University、University of Edinburgh 等。未见特别明确的顶级基座模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to build executable and patchable world models for text agents under partial observability, instead of relying on black-box next-observation predictors.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an agent/world-model contribution than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its main value is the idea that a world model can be represented as executable code that is inspectable, replayable, and locally repairable.
summary_en.technical_approach: PatchWorld is a gradient-free framework that induces executable Python world models from offline trajectories via counterexample-guided code repair. It maintains symbolic belief-state programs with action-conditioned updates, and iteratively patches the program when predictions conflict with environment feedback. Planning is then performed through lookahead on the induced code model, without LLM calls inside the prediction module.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on seven AgentGym environments. PatchWorld-Simple reportedly achieves the best code-based planning score among compared methods, reaching 76.4% macro success in live one-step lookahead. The abstract does not provide enough detail on comparisons against neural world models or direct relevance to pretraining-scale setups.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Hong Kong Baptist University, Beijing Institute of Technology, SUSTech, Wayne State University, and the University of Edinburgh. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab is evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，知道有这条“程序化世界模型”路线即可；若你做 agent，只看方法图和 counterexample repair 机制，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining; just note the executable-world-model angle. If you work on agents, the method diagram and counterexample-repair loop are enough.

institutions: Southern University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Light Interaction: Training-Free Inference Acceleration for Interactive Video World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive video world models generate video chunk by chunk in response to user-controlled camera movements, enabling applications such as real-time game simulation, virtual scene navigation, and embodied AI training. However, scaling to long interactive trajectories is prohibitively expensive due to growing context memory, quadratic attention complexity, and repeated denoising steps. We present Light Interaction, a training-free inference acceleration framework for interactive video world mode

summary.core_problem: 解决交互式视频 world model 在长轨迹生成中因上下文增长、注意力二次复杂度和重复去噪导致的推理过慢问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，不是预训练方法论文；但它对长上下文生成系统里的自适应计算、缓存复用和稀疏注意力有一些可迁移的系统直觉。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练无关的加速框架 Light Interaction。核心包括三部分：按轨迹状态自适应管理上下文；在相机回访熟悉区域时复用早期去噪输出；结合软硬件协同的 3D block sparse attention 与融合 kernel，降低长轨迹交互生成成本。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调这是 interactive video world models 的 inference-only acceleration，目标场景是实时游戏模拟、场景导航和 embodied AI 训练。未给出具体模型、加速倍数和质量损失，需要看系统表和 latency-quality tradeoff。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses slow inference in interactive video world models caused by growing context, quadratic attention, and repeated denoising over long trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it offers transferable systems intuition on adaptive compute, cache reuse, and sparse attention for long-context generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Light Interaction, a training-free acceleration framework. It combines adaptive context management, denoising-cache reuse when revisiting familiar regions, and hardware-software co-designed 3D block sparse attention with fused kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames it as inference-only acceleration for interactive video world models in real-time simulation and navigation settings. It does not provide exact speedups, quality tradeoffs, or model details, so the systems tables are the main thing to inspect.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练关系不大，但如果你关心长上下文生成系统，只看缓存复用和自适应上下文两点，别花时间读完整方法。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to LLM pretraining, but if you care about long-context generative systems, only inspect the cache-reuse and adaptive-context ideas; the rest is mostly systems detail.

paper.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
paper.abstract: As video diffusion models (VDMs) advance toward world models, a key question arises: do they truly understand causality, or merely overfit to statistical temporal patterns? Existing benchmarks mostly rely on synthetic data, limiting real-world generalization due to the sim-to-real gap. We present YoCausal, a two-level benchmark inspired by the Violation of Expectation (VoE) paradigm from cognitive science. By temporally reversing real-world videos at zero cost as natural counterfactual samples,

summary.core_problem: 评估视频生成模型是否具备因果理解，而不是只学到时间顺序上的统计相关性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频生成世界模型评测。YoCausal 用真实视频的时间反转构造自然反事实样本，避免纯合成 benchmark 的 sim-to-real 缺口，并区分“感知时间箭头”和“理解因果”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法受认知科学中的 Violation of Expectation 范式启发，设计两级评估。Level 1 用 Reverse Surprise Index 通过 denoising loss 衡量模型对时间箭头的敏感性；Level 2 用 VLM 将数据分成 causal 和 non-causal 子集，再用 Causality Cognition Index 分离因果认知与普通时间偏置。
summary.experiments: 论文评估 13 个视频扩散模型。核心发现是：模型能感知时间箭头并不意味着能理解因果；部分模型的时间方向敏感性可能来自非因果的时序统计偏置。摘要未列出具体模型规模、训练数据和完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether video generation models understand causality or merely fit statistical temporal patterns.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a world-model-oriented benchmark for video generation. YoCausal uses temporally reversed real-world videos as natural counterfactuals, reducing the sim-to-real gap of synthetic-only evaluation and separating arrow-of-time perception from causal cognition.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by the Violation of Expectation paradigm, the benchmark has two levels. Level 1 defines the Reverse Surprise Index based on denoising loss to measure arrow-of-time sensitivity. Level 2 uses a VLM to stratify data into causal and non-causal subsets, then defines the Causality Cognition Index to separate causal reasoning from temporal bias.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate 13 state-of-the-art video diffusion models. The main finding is that perceiving the arrow of time does not imply causal understanding; some temporal sensitivity can be explained by non-causal temporal bias. The abstract does not provide model scales, training data, or full numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 读 RSI/CCI 定义和 causal/non-causal 分层；这类反事实评测比看视频质量分更接近世界模型问题。
recommendation.en: Read the RSI/CCI definitions and the causal versus non-causal split; this counterfactual setup is more informative for world-model claims than video-quality scores.

paper.title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation
paper.abstract: Interactive world models are advancing rapidly, yet existing benchmarks cover only part of the required competencies, leaving no unified standard for systematic evaluation. To fill this gap, we introduce WBench, a comprehensive multi-turn benchmark for interactive world model evaluation along five dimensions, namely video quality, setting adherence, interaction adherence, consistency, and physics compliance. WBench contains 289 test cases and 1,058 interaction turns, where each case specifies a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是交互式视频世界模型缺少统一、多轮、可诊断评测的问题。现有评测通常只覆盖视频质量、导航控制、记忆一致性或特定场景的一部分能力，难以判断模型失败来自渲染、初始化、交互执行、跨轮状态保持，还是物理演化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在训练方法，而在评测信号。交互式世界模型正在向视频生成、具身控制和开放世界模拟靠近，训练目标会越来越依赖可控生成、长程一致性和物理约束。WBench 把这些能力拆成五个维度，有助于把“视频看起来好”与“世界状态可被连续操控”区分开。对做 native multimodal pretrain 或 video world model 的研究员，最有用的是它给出了多轮控制失败的诊断框架。
summary.technical_approach: WBench 将每个样例拆成 World Setting 和 Interaction sequence。World Setting 包含场景、风格、视角和主体，用来定义初始世界状态；Interaction sequence 则覆盖连续多轮用户控制。交互类型包括导航、主体动作、事件编辑和视角切换。导航被统一成三种等价接口：文本、相机位姿和离散动作，这让不同控制范式的模型可以在同一子集上比较。评测维度对应五类能力：video quality、setting adherence、interaction adherence、consistency、physics compliance。自动评测由 22 个子指标组成，结合专用视觉模型和 VLM 评判。相比只看单轮 prompt-following 的视频基准，它的关键区别是把世界初始化和后续动作分离，并显式考察跨轮记忆与状态保持。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 289 个测试样例和 1,058 个交互轮次。初始帧来自 Nano Banana 2、GPT-Image-1.5、网页收集和人工拍摄，并经过人工质检。论文评测了 20 个模型：所有模型在 158 个导航样例的共享子集上比较，文本提示的 I2V 模型还在完整 289 个样例上评测。主要发现包括：没有模型在五个维度上同时占优；导航能力与其他维度相对独立；相机控制和视角一致性是两种不同能力；物理正确性与渲染质量的相关性强于与控制能力的相关性；难度受视角、场景类型和主体类别影响；四类交互在多轮过程中退化速度不同，其中导航最脆弱。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看数据构造和评测协议，而不是模型排名。Introduction 的五角色类比可以快速理解评测维度；WBenchDataset 部分值得看 World Setting 与 Interaction 的解耦方式；实验分析里建议关注多轮退化、导航与其他能力的相关性、相机控制与视角一致性的区分。若关心 video world model 预训练，可以进一步看 22 个自动子指标如何映射到训练时可用的诊断信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of a unified, multi-turn, diagnostic benchmark for interactive video world models. Existing evaluations usually test only visual quality, navigation, memory, or a narrow task setting, making it hard to localize failures across rendering, world initialization, interaction following, state consistency, and physics.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly evaluative rather than algorithmic. As video world models move toward controllable generation, embodied simulation, and open-ended environments, training progress will depend on signals beyond frame realism. WBench separates visual fidelity from controllability and persistent world state, which is useful for researchers working on native multimodal pretraining or video-based world modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each case is decomposed into a World Setting and an Interaction sequence. The World Setting specifies scene, style, perspective, and subject, while the Interaction sequence defines multi-turn user controls. The benchmark covers four interaction types: navigation, subject action, event editing, and perspective switching. Navigation is represented through aligned text, camera-pose, and discrete-action interfaces, allowing models with different control APIs to be compared on a shared subset. Evaluation is organized around five dimensions: video quality, setting adherence, interaction adherence, consistency, and physics compliance, measured with 22 automatic sub-metrics using specialist vision models and VLM-based judges. The main design choice is to separate what the world is from what the user asks it to do, which makes failures easier to diagnose than in single-prompt video generation benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: WBench contains 289 test cases and 1,058 interaction turns. Initial frames are generated with Nano Banana 2 and GPT-Image-1.5, supplemented by web-collected and manually captured images, followed by manual quality control. The paper evaluates 20 models. All models are compared on a shared navigation subset of 158 cases, while text-prompted image-to-video models are also evaluated on the full benchmark. The main empirical findings are that no model dominates all five dimensions; navigation is largely independent of the other abilities; camera control and perspective consistency are distinct; physics compliance correlates more with rendering quality than with control; difficulty varies by perspective, scene type, and subject; and multi-turn degradation is uneven across interaction types, with navigation being especially fragile.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the dataset design and evaluation protocol rather than the leaderboard. The introduction gives a useful five-role decomposition of world-model capability. The dataset section is the most relevant part for understanding how world settings and interactions are decoupled. The experiment analysis is worth reading for the findings on multi-turn degradation, navigation independence, and the separation between camera control and perspective consistency. For video world-model pretraining, the 22 sub-metrics are the most useful part to inspect as potential diagnostic training signals.

recommendation.zh: 做世界模型或视频生成预训练的人可读评测设计；重点看控制接口统一和物理合规指标，别只看总分。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for world-model pretraining: read the control-interface normalization and physics metrics, not just the aggregate score.

paper.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
paper.abstract: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three system

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图让 agent 的长程推理不再完全依赖无结构 chain-of-thought，而是显式区分执行、模拟规划和是否规划的自我调控。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，主要启发在训练数据格式和推理计算控制。它说明 agent trace 不一定只是一长串自由文本 reasoning，也可以拆成“何时规划、规划多远、预测什么状态、何时直接行动”等结构化监督信号。这个方向可能影响后续 agent 预训练或 mid-training 的 trace schema 设计。
summary.technical_approach: SR2AM 把 agent 推理拆成三个系统：System I 负责反应式执行和自由推理；System II 负责 simulative planning，即提出候选动作并预测未来状态；System III 是 configurator，决定当前是否需要新规划、继续已有规划，还是直接行动。实现上仍使用 LLM 作为世界模型，在 chain-of-thought 内插入结构化的配置与规划阶段。作者给出两个版本：v0.1 从多模块 prompting 系统记录决策来构造训练信号；v1.0 从预训练 reasoning LLM 的轨迹中重建结构化计划，以提高可扩展性。训练流程是监督学习后接 RL。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖数学、科学、表格分析和网页信息查找等交互式推理任务。SR2AM-v0.1-8B 的 Pass@1 与 120B–355B 级别系统接近；SR2AM-v1.0-30B 与 685B–1T 级别 agentic LLM 接近。v1.0-30B 相比相近规模 agentic LLM 节省 25.8%–95.3% reasoning tokens。分析显示，RL 后平均 planning horizon 增加 22.8%，planning frequency 只增加 2.0 个百分点，说明模型更倾向于在少数需要规划的位置规划得更远，而不是简单增加规划次数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看三系统形式化定义，确认 configurator、planner、executor 的边界。再看 v0.1 和 v1.0 的数据构造方式，尤其是如何从普通 reasoning trace 重建结构化计划。实验部分重点看 token 节省和 planning horizon/frequency 的分析。对基座研究员来说，不必细读具体 agent benchmark 细节，重点是 trace 结构和 RL 后计算分配行为的变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient long-horizon agent reasoning caused by unstructured chain-of-thought. It proposes to separate execution, simulation-based planning, and self-regulation over when and how deeply to plan.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to base-model pretraining is indirect. The useful signal is about trace design and compute control: agent training traces can expose decisions such as whether to plan, how far to plan, what future states to predict, and when to act directly. Such schemas may become useful for agent-oriented pretraining, mid-training, or RL data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SR2AM decomposes reasoning into three components. System I performs reactive execution and free-form reasoning. System II performs simulative planning by proposing actions and predicting future belief states, using the LLM itself as the world model. System III is a configurator that decides whether to create a new plan, continue an existing plan, or act without planning. The authors instantiate this in two ways. v0.1 records decisions from a multi-module prompted system to demonstrate feasibility. v1.0 reconstructs structured plans from pretrained reasoning LLM traces for better scalability. Both versions are trained with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers interactive reasoning in math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking. SR2AM-v0.1-8B achieves Pass@1 competitive with systems in the 120B–355B range. SR2AM-v1.0-30B is reported as competitive with 685B–1T agentic LLMs. The 30B model uses 25.8%–95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than competitive agentic LLMs of similar scale. After RL, average planning horizon increases by 22.8%, while planning frequency grows by only 2.0 percentage points, suggesting that the model learns to plan further ahead at selected moments rather than planning more often everywhere.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the formal definition of the three systems to understand the boundaries between configurator, planner, and executor. Then read the v0.1 and v1.0 data construction pipelines, especially how structured plans are reconstructed from ordinary reasoning traces. In the experiments, focus on reasoning-token savings and the analysis of planning horizon versus planning frequency. The benchmark-specific details are less important for pretraining researchers than the trace schema and the post-RL shift in computation allocation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 planner 调用率与 token-cost 曲线；如果没有干净消融，它就是又一个三系统 agent 叙事。
recommendation.en: Skim the planner-invocation and token-cost curves; without clean ablations, this is just another three-system agent story.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视频扩散世界模型在长时 rollout 中，KV-cache 线性增长导致无法同时保持实时性和世界一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率与长时记忆管理问题。虽然对象是视频世界模型，不是文本LLM，但其中的 cache 检索与压缩思路对长上下文推理、外部记忆和 KV 管理有可迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WorldKV，包含两部分：World Retrieval 将被驱逐的 KV chunk 存入 GPU/CPU，并根据相机/动作对应关系选择性取回插回原生 attention window；World Compression 则基于 key-key similarity 相对 anchor frame 剪除冗余 token，把每个 chunk 的存储压到约一半。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示在 Matrix-Game-2.0 等环境上验证，目标是在固定预算下保留更长历史并维持世界一致性，同时满足实时约束；但这是视频扩散推理系统实验，不是语言模型标准长上下文基准。
summary.authors_note: 作者中 Sangdoo Yun 在高效模型与视觉生成方向有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the inability of autoregressive video diffusion world models to maintain both real-time throughput and persistent world consistency as KV-cache grows linearly with rollout length.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and long-horizon memory-management paper. The target is video world models rather than text LLMs, but the cache retrieval and compression ideas are transferable to long-context inference and external memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV has two parts: World Retrieval stores evicted KV chunks in GPU/CPU memory and selectively retrieves scene-relevant chunks using camera/action correspondence, while World Compression prunes redundant tokens within each chunk via key-key similarity to an anchor frame, roughly halving storage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on environments such as Matrix-Game-2.0, aiming to preserve longer history under a fixed memory budget while maintaining world consistency and real-time constraints. The setup is a video diffusion inference system rather than a standard language long-context benchmark.
summary_en.authors_note: Sangdoo Yun is a recognizable researcher in efficient models and vision generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本LLM，但‘驱逐后可检索KV’这个思路值得借到长上下文 serving；看 retrieval 条件和压缩准则就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a text LLM paper, but the retrievable-evicted-KV idea is worth borrowing for long-context serving; read the retrieval trigger and compression rule, then move on.

paper.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
paper.abstract: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three system

summary.core_problem: 如何在长时程交互式任务中，让 agentic LLM 的“规划/模拟”推理变得可控且更省 token：既避免把所有 deliberation 都塞进无结构的 chain-of-thought（训练/推理 token 成本高且收益不稳定），又能在需要时进行更深的前瞻规划，并且能学习到何时规划、规划多深。
summary.importance:
这是一篇 agent 推理结构与训练（SFT+RL）的工作，不属于预训练方法/数据/优化主线。对基座预训练研究的启发点主要在两处：
- 训练信号与计算预算的“结构化”：把规划显式化后，token 预算、规划频率、规划深度变成可度量、可正则、可用 RL 优化的对象，间接提示了后续若做 reasoning-aware pretrain / RL-pretrain 时，如何定义更干净的中间变量与约束。
- 以 LLM 充当 world model 的 simulative planning：把“预测后继状态/后果”作为统一规划机制，可能与未来的 latent reasoning / world-model-style 预训练目标形成接口，但本文本身更偏 post-train/agent 侧。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 SR2AM，把 agent 的 deliberation 拆成三套交互系统并在同一 LLM 推理轨迹中显式分段：
- System I（reactive execution）：自由形式的细粒度推理与直接行动。
- System II（simulative reasoning / planner）：在需要时生成显式计划，计划由“候选动作 + 预测的未来状态/后果”组成；这里的 world model 由 LLM 自己承担。
- System III（self-regulation / configurator）：每一步先判断是否需要规划、是新建计划还是沿用计划、或直接行动，并决定规划深度/方式。
实现上给出两个版本：v0.1 通过多模块 prompt 系统记录决策来构造训练信号；v1.0 从预训练 reasoning LLM 的轨迹中重建结构化计划以提升可扩展性。训练流程为监督学习后接 RL，用任务成功与效率相关信号推动“更合适的规划”。
summary.experiments:
作者报告在数学、科学、表格分析、网页信息检索等交互式推理评测上：
- SR2AM-v0.1-8B 与 SR2AM-v1.0-30B 的 Pass@1 与更大规模系统（文中提到 120–355B、以及 685B–1T 量级）具有竞争力。
- SR2AM-v1.0-30B 相比同尺度的 agentic LLM，推理 token 消耗减少 25.8–95.3%。
- 分析显示 RL 使平均规划视野（planning horizon）提升 22.8%，而规划触发频率仅增加约 2.0 个百分点，暗示模型学到“规划更远”而不是“更频繁规划”。
由于你给的全文片段未包含更细的表格与设置细节（具体基线、每个 benchmark 的绝对分数、奖励设计等），这里无法补齐更精确的逐项数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看形式化章节里对 System I/II/III 的定义，以及 planner 输出的结构（动作-状态预测对）；这是它区别于普通 CoT/ToT 的关键。
- 重点看 v0.1 与 v1.0 的数据构造差异：一个来自多模块 prompt 记录，一个来自 reasoning trace 重建；这决定了可扩展性与噪声形态。
- 看 RL 部分：奖励里如何同时约束任务成功与 token/规划成本；以及训练后“规划频率 vs 规划深度”的变化分析。
- 结果部分优先看 token-accuracy tradeoff 曲线，而不是单点 Pass@1。
如果只想抓主旨：读 Introduction + 方法总览图 + 训练与分析小节即可。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make long-horizon agentic reasoning more compute/token-efficient by explicitly controlling planning: instead of relying on unstructured chain-of-thought where planning is expected to emerge implicitly (often with high token cost and inconsistent gains), the agent should learn when to plan, how deeply to plan, and how to represent plans in an analyzable form.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/post-training (SFT+RL) paper rather than a pretraining recipe contribution. For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the main takeaways are: (1) structuring intermediate reasoning variables (planning frequency, horizon, plan format) makes compute budgets measurable and optimizable, which is relevant if one later designs reasoning-aware pretraining or RL-pretraining objectives; (2) treating the LLM as a world model for simulative planning suggests an interface to future world-model-style or latent-reasoning pretraining, though this work itself operates at the agent layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SR2AM decomposes deliberation into three interacting subsystems embedded as explicit stages within an LLM’s reasoning trace:
- System I (reactive execution): free-form reasoning and direct action.
- System II (simulative planner): when invoked, produces explicit plans consisting of proposed actions and predicted future states/consequences; the LLM itself serves as the world model.
- System III (self-regulation/configurator): decides at each step whether to plan, whether to create a new plan or continue an existing one, or act directly; it also modulates planning depth.
Two instantiations are explored: v0.1 derives supervision by recording decisions from a multi-module prompted system; v1.0 reconstructs structured plans from pretrained reasoning-LLM traces for scalability. Training is supervised learning followed by RL to optimize task success under efficiency considerations.
summary_en.experiments:
On interactive reasoning tasks spanning math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking, the authors report:
- SR2AM-v0.1-8B and SR2AM-v1.0-30B achieve Pass@1 competitive with much larger agentic systems (cited ranges include 120–355B and 685B–1T).
- SR2AM-v1.0-30B uses 25.8–95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than competitive agentic LLMs of similar scale.
- RL increases average planning horizon by 22.8% while planning frequency rises by only ~2.0 percentage points, suggesting the policy learns to plan further ahead rather than plan more often.
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed benchmark tables, baseline definitions, or reward specifications, so per-task absolute numbers cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Read the formalization of Systems I/II/III and the exact structure of the planner output (action + predicted next-state sequences).
- Compare v0.1 vs v1.0 data construction: prompted multi-module logging vs trace-based plan reconstruction; this drives scalability and noise.
- Inspect the RL section: how rewards trade off success vs token/planning cost, and the analysis of frequency vs horizon shifts.
- In results, prioritize accuracy–token tradeoff curves over single Pass@1 points.
For a quick grasp: Introduction + method overview figure + training/analysis sections are sufficient.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 token-accuracy 曲线；若 configurator 信号干净，这比继续拉长 CoT 更像可训练的规划接口。
recommendation.en: Read the method and token-accuracy curves; if the configurator signal is clean, this is a more trainable planning interface than just lengthening CoT.

paper.title: PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation
paper.abstract: World simulators can provide safe and scalable environments for training Physical AI systems before real-world deployment. Large video generation models are emerging as a promising basis for such simulators because they can generate diverse and realistic visual futures. However, using them as world simulators requires physically faithful video continuations, namely, generated videos that preserve the physical state implied by the conditioning input, and evolve in ways consistent with basic physi

summary.core_problem: 现有视频生成模型作为物理AI训练的世界模拟器时，生成内容物理保真度低，无法保留输入隐含的物理状态，不符合基础物理规则
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将DPO偏好对齐用于视频生成的物理约束优化，提升生成视频的物理一致性
summary.technical_approach: 采用两阶段后训练：第一阶段用流匹配微调提升视频帧间视觉属性稳定性和运动连贯性，第二阶段基于物理偏好数据做DPO对齐生成动态与物理规则
summary.experiments: 在物理保真视频续写任务上测试，生成内容的物理一致性优于基线视频生成模型
summary.authors_note: 东北大学、佐治亚大学等机构研究团队，无公开知名相关领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: When existing video generation models act as world simulators for physical AI training, generated content has low physical fidelity, cannot preserve physical states implied by inputs, and violates basic physical principles
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, first apply DPO preference alignment to physical constraint optimization for video generation, improving physical consistency of generated videos
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopt two-stage post-training: first stage uses flow matching fine-tuning to improve inter-frame visual attribute stability and motion coherence, second stage aligns generated dynamics with physical principles via DPO on physics preference data
summary_en.experiments: Tested on physically faithful video continuation tasks, generated content outperforms baseline video generation models in physical consistency
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from Northeastern University, University of Georgia, etc., no well-known authors in related fields publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 物理对齐视频生成的增量工作，做视频世界模型研究可参考其DPO对齐思路，无需精读
recommendation.en: Incremental work on physically aligned video generation, DPO alignment idea is referable for video world model research, no need for intensive reading

paper.title: ReactiveGWM: Steering NPC in Reactive Game World Models
paper.abstract: Current game world models simulate environments from a subjective, player-centric perspective. However, by treating the Non-Player Character (NPC) merely as background pixels, these models cannot capture interactions between the player and NPC. In that sense, they act as passive video renderers rather than real simulation engines, lacking the physical understanding needed to model action-induced NPC reactivities. We introduce ReactiveGWM, a reactive game world model that synthesizes dynamic inte

summary.core_problem: 现有游戏世界模型多从玩家视角生成视频，把 NPC 当作背景像素，难以建模玩家动作引发的 NPC 反应。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是交互式视频世界模型的方法改进。它把世界模型从被动渲染推进到带条件反应的生成模拟，但主要价值仍在游戏视频生成和可控生成，不直接推进 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: ReactiveGWM 显式拆分玩家控制和 NPC 行为：玩家动作通过轻量 additive bias 注入 diffusion backbone，高层 NPC 响应策略通过 cross-attention 模块接入。论文强调这些模块学习游戏无关的交互逻辑，从而支持零样本策略迁移。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在动态玩家-NPC 交互合成和零样本策略迁移上验证方法，但未给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 benchmark 或数值提升。需要读正文确认 setup 是否覆盖不同游戏、不同 NPC 策略和长时序一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore、The Hong Kong Polytechnic University、HKUST Guangzhou、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、HKUST；未从给定信息确认知名基座模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Most game world models render player-centric videos and treat NPCs as background pixels, so they fail to model NPC reactions induced by player actions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level improvement for interactive video world models. It moves game generation from passive rendering toward conditional reactive simulation, but its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReactiveGWM separates player controls from NPC behavior. Player actions are injected into the diffusion backbone through a lightweight additive bias, while high-level NPC responses such as offense, control, and defense are grounded through cross-attention modules. The paper claims these modules learn game-agnostic interaction logic for zero-shot strategy transfer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on dynamic player-NPC interaction synthesis and zero-shot strategy transfer, but does not provide model size, training data scale, benchmark names, or numerical gains. The main thing to verify in the paper is whether the evaluation really stresses cross-game transfer and long-horizon consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with National University of Singapore, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, HKUST Guangzhou, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, and HKUST. No clearly identifiable major foundation-model lab background is available from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 可作为交互式世界模型备查；预训练侧只需看架构图，重点判断“解耦控制/反应”是否真能跨环境迁移。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference on interactive world models; for pretraining work, only inspect the architecture and whether control/reaction disentanglement truly transfers.

paper.title: PanoWorld: Geometry-Consistent Panoramic Video World Modeling
paper.abstract: We present PanoWorld, a panoramic video world model that generates geometry-consistent 360$\degree$ video from a single image and a caption. Existing panoramic video methods optimize primarily for visual realism and do not explicitly constrain the underlying 3D scene state, producing outputs that appear plausible yet exhibit inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible motion across the spherical surface. We address this gap by framing panoramic video generation as a geometry- and

summary.core_problem: 从单张图像和文本描述生成几何一致的 360 度全景视频，减少深度、对应关系和球面运动的不一致。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态视频生成和世界模型方法。它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对视频生成模型如何加入显式几何约束有参考意义，尤其是把视觉合成从像素真实感推进到潜在 3D 状态一致性。
summary.technical_approach: PanoWorld 基于预训练的透视视频 world model，加入两个轻量正则：用伪全景深度监督的 depth consistency loss，以及监督跟踪点在 3D world-frame 中跨时间位置的 trajectory consistency loss。同时对 conditioning 和位置编码做球面几何适配，并提出 PanoGeo 评测资源。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向单图加 caption 的全景视频生成，并评估几何一致性、深度一致性和运动轨迹一致性；未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Northeastern University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper generates geometry-consistent 360-degree panoramic video from a single image and a caption, reducing inconsistent depth, broken correspondences, and implausible spherical motion.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal video generation and world-modeling contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to how video generative models can be constrained by explicit geometry rather than optimized only for visual plausibility.
summary_en.technical_approach: PanoWorld builds on a pretrained perspective video world model and adds two lightweight regularizers: a depth consistency loss using pseudo panoramic depth, and a trajectory consistency loss supervising tracked points in 3D world-frame coordinates over time. It also adapts conditioning and positional encoding to spherical geometry and introduces the PanoGeo evaluation resource.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes evaluation for single-image-plus-caption panoramic video generation, focusing on geometric consistency, depth consistency, and trajectory consistency. It does not include model size, training data scale, baseline names, or exact numerical improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Northeastern University.

recommendation.zh: 知道思路即可；显式几何正则对视频 world model 有参考，但不是通用预训练范式。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing, not deep reading; explicit geometry regularization is useful for video world models but not a general pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
paper.abstract: Whether navigating a building, operating a robot, or playing a game, an agent that acts effectively in an environment must first learn an internal model of how that environment works. Partially-observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) provide a flexible modeling class for such internal world models, but learning them from observation-action trajectories alone is challenging and typically requires extensive environment interaction. We ask whether language-model priors can reduce costly inter

summary.core_problem: 现有基于LLM先验的世界模型学习方法（如WorldCoder、POMDP Coder）均依赖完全可观测假设或事后真实状态访问（post-hoc full observability），无法应用于遮挡环境、不完全信息博弈等严格POMDP场景。论文研究仅从观测-动作-奖励轨迹出发，能否利用LLM先验诱导出可执行的POMDP世界模型，而无需访问真实隐状态。
summary.importance: 首次证明LLM先验足以在严格POMDP设置（无真实隐状态监督）下诱导结构化世界模型。这扩展了LLM在具身智能和强化学习中的适用边界——从完全可观测任务推进到部分可观测任务，为减少环境交互成本提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Pinductor（POMDP-inductor）方法，分为两个核心阶段：(1) LLM提议阶段：让LLM根据少量观测-动作-奖励轨迹编写POMDP各组件（转移函数、观测函数、奖励函数、初始状态分布）的候选程序；(2) 迭代精炼阶段：使用基于信念的似然得分（belief-based likelihood score）来评分和优化候选模型。具体通过距离核函数将观测预测转化为软似然，并在模型自身滤波动力学诱导的信念分布下计算期望似然。该目标仅依赖观测和自诱导信念，无需特权状态信息。
summary.experiments: 在5个不同复杂度的MiniGrid POMDP环境上评估。关键结果：(1) Pinductor在使用严格更少信息（无真实状态）的情况下，与使用特权状态的LLM基线（POMDP Coder）达到相当的样本效率和奖励性能；(2) 大幅优于传统表格POMDP基线（后者在少量轨迹下难以学习）；(3) 消融实验表明性能随LLM能力提升而提高，且当环境语义信息被隐藏时性能下降，确认了方法对LLM和文本信息的强依赖性；(4) 诱导的信念状态在规划过程中逐渐收敛到真实隐状态。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第1章引言中的问题界定（为什么无监督POMDP诱导是未解决问题）、第3章方法中的信念似然评分机制（第3.2节 kernel-based likelihood objective）、第4章实验中的基准对比数据。阅读时间约30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的全文片段中明确给出。作者信息未提供。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based world model induction methods (WorldCoder, POMDP Coder) rely on full observability or post-hoc ground-truth state access, making them inapplicable to strictly partially-observable settings (occluded environments, imperfect-information games). This paper investigates whether LLM priors can induce executable POMDP world models from observation-action-reward trajectories alone, without any ground-truth latent state supervision.
summary_en.importance: First demonstration that LLM priors suffice for structured world model induction in the strict POMDP setting without privileged state supervision. This extends the applicability of LLM priors in embodied AI and reinforcement learning from fully observable to partially observable tasks, providing a path toward reducing expensive environment interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pinductor (POMDP-inductor) operates in two core phases: (1) LLM proposal: an LLM writes candidate programs for POMDP components (transition, observation, reward, initial-state distributions) given a few observation-action-reward trajectories; (2) Iterative refinement: a belief-based likelihood score optimizes candidate models. Observation predictions are converted to soft likelihoods via a distance kernel, and candidates are scored under the expected likelihood of the belief distributions induced by their own filtering dynamics. This objective requires only observations and self-induced beliefs, no privileged state information.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 5 MiniGrid POMDP environments of varying complexity. Key results: (1) Pinductor matches the sample efficiency and reward performance of a privileged-state LLM baseline (POMDP Coder) despite using strictly less information; (2) Substantially outperforms classical tabular POMDP baselines which struggle with few trajectories; (3) Ablations show performance scales with LLM capability and degrades when semantic information is withheld, confirming strong dependence on LLM and textual cues; (4) Induced belief states converge toward the true latent state during planning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 1 for problem framing (why unsupervised POMDP induction is an open question), Section 3.2 for the kernel-based belief likelihood scoring mechanism, and Section 4 for benchmark comparison data. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided text excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和实验设置即可；它给 agent world model 一个较干净的 LM-prior 测试床，但别外推到开放环境。
recommendation.en: Read the method and setup; it is a fairly clean testbed for LM priors in agent world models, but do not extrapolate it to open-ended environments.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models
paper.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models via reinforcement learning (RL) in learned world models has emerged as an effective strategy to adapt to new tasks without costly real-world interactions. However, while using imagined trajectories reduces the sample complexity of policy training, existing methods still heavily rely on task-specific data to fine-tune both the world and reward models, fundamentally limiting their scalability to unseen tasks. To overcome this, we argue that world a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的机器人策略优化，而是一个更具体、也更卡脖子的问题：如何在目标任务完全未参与世界模型训练的前提下，用冻结的 world model 和冻结的 reward source，对新任务做高数据效率的 VLA 后训练。现有基于 imagined rollout 的 VLA-RL 方法虽然减少了真实交互，但 world model 往往仍要用目标任务数据重训或微调，reward 也常依赖任务专用分类器、参考轨迹或人工设计信号，所以一旦任务变了，整套流程都要重新收集数据。RAW-Dream 把这个依赖拆开：world model 只学任务无关的物理动态，reward 由通用 VLM 对 imagined video + instruction 做零样本判定，目标任务只需要少量 demonstration 把 policy 对齐到任务语义，再在梦境里做 RL。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它提出了一个新的 backbone，而在于它把“可复用的 task-agnostic simulator”明确成了一个预训练对象，并给出了一条比 task-specific world-model RL 更干净的扩展路线。这里有三个层面的价值。第一，它把 world model 的训练目标从“服务某个任务”改成“覆盖 embodiment 的物理先验”，这和基座模型预训练里追求 transferable prior 的思路是一致的。第二，它把 reward 从任务内监督中解耦出来，改用冻结 VLM 做 zero-shot success judgment，这相当于把通用视觉语义能力接到了 RL 后训练接口上。第三，它说明在 VLA 场景里，预训练和后训练的边界可以重新划分：world model 与 reward 准备一次，后续只适配 policy。这个范式如果成立，影响的是数据预算结构，而不只是单点指标提升。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model。作者基于 WAN 2.1 搭建动作条件视频生成器，但训练数据严格来自 broad-coverage、与下游任务无关的交互数据，例如 play data 或 benchmark 中不含目标任务的任务集合。关键点不是模型结构新，而是训练约束新：world model 不允许看 target-task rollout，因此它必须靠更广覆盖的行为分布去学可迁移的物理动力学，而不是记住任务模板。

第二块是 zero-shot reward。作者不训练任务专用 reward model，而是把 imagined rollout 视频和文本指令交给冻结的 Qwen3-VL，由其直接判断任务是否成功，输出二值奖励。这样 reward source 也不再依赖目标任务标注器。这里的取舍很清楚：牺牲一部分 reward 精细度，换取跨任务可复用性和零额外标注。

第三块是在 world model 内做 policy optimization。策略采用 OpenVLA-OFT，先用极少量 demonstration 做 SFT，把策略锚定到新任务语义；然后在冻结 world model 中用 GRPO 做 RL。由于 imagined rollout 在未见任务上更容易出现 hallucinated success，作者加了 dual-noise verification：对同一初始条件，用不同 diffusion noise 生成多条 rollout，只有当 VLM reward 在不同噪声下保持一致时，才把该奖励视为可信。这一步不是简单 ensemble，而是专门针对生成式 world model 的 reward hacking 问题：如果成功只在某个噪声样本里出现，往往说明是模型幻觉而非稳定可实现的轨迹。

从方法定位看，RAW-Dream 的创新不在单个组件，而在组合方式和约束设计。它没有重新发明 VLA、VLM 或 video diffusion WM，而是把三者放进一个严格 task-agnostic 的后训练闭环里，并补上了 hallucination-aware reward verification 这个必要环节。
summary.experiments:
实验分成仿真和真实机器人两部分。仿真上，作者在 LIBERO 上训练 world model 时只使用 LIBERO-90 数据，并把 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 四个 held-out task suites 作为 world-model 训练时完全未见的下游任务。这个设定比常见的 imagined RL 更严格，因为不是同任务低样本，而是 world model 对目标任务零暴露。结果上，RAW-Dream 相比 1-shot SFT baseline 带来 +8.9% 的提升，并且优于需要 50× 更多真实世界数据的 online RL。这个对比很关键，它说明 task-agnostic WM + zero-shot reward 并不是只在“省数据但性能差一些”的角落里成立，而是在数据效率上有明显优势。

真实机器人上，world model 只用多样、未清洗的 play data 预训练，不看目标任务数据。每个新任务从 3-shot SFT 起步，再进入 imagined RL。最终成功率相对 3-shot SFT baseline 有 +21.7% 的绝对提升。对机器人场景来说，这个幅度已经足以说明 dream-based RL 不是纯粹的模拟器内自娱自乐，而是能把少量 demonstration 放大成可观的真实收益。

从文中叙述看，值得注意的消融主要有三类：一是验证 task-agnostic WM 相比 target-task-specific 方案在 unseen-task setting 下的适配能力；二是验证 VLM zero-shot reward 的可用性；三是 dual-noise verification 对抑制 hallucinated success 和 false-positive reward hacking 的作用。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整表格数字，但论文主结论依赖的不是单一主表，而是这三类消融共同支撑：world model 要足够通用，reward 要足够稳，RL 才能在未见任务上真正工作。
summary.reading_guide:
精读时先抓三处。第一是 Introduction 里对问题设定的限定：不是一般的 world-model RL，而是“target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in WMs”。这句话决定了整篇工作的评价标准。第二是 Method 里 world model、zero-shot VLM reward、GRPO、dual-noise verification 之间的接口设计，尤其要看 reward 是如何从 imagined video 中提取、如何做一致性过滤，以及 policy 更新时哪些模块冻结、哪些模块可训练。第三是实验部分关于 LIBERO held-out suites 和 real-robot play-data 预训练的设定，这些设定决定了结果是否真的说明了 transferable physical prior，而不是数据泄漏。

如果时间有限，优先看：任务设定图、整体 pipeline 图、LIBERO 主结果表、dual-noise verification 消融、真实机器人结果。若要深挖，建议重点想两个问题：一，task-agnostic world model 的能力边界到底由数据覆盖决定，还是由生成模型 fidelity 决定；二，VLM reward 在 imagined video 上的误判会不会形成系统性偏差，dual-noise 只是降噪还是已经足够构成可靠的 reward filter。阅读时间大约 45–70 分钟，若连附录中的实现细节和失败案例一起看，可能需要更久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific bottleneck in world-model-based VLA post-training: how to improve a policy on new tasks when the world model has never seen target-task rollouts and the reward source is also task-agnostic. Prior imagined-RL pipelines reduce real-world interaction cost, but they still depend on target-task data to train or adapt the world model, and often require task-specific reward classifiers or reference trajectories. That makes them hard to scale to unseen tasks. RAW-Dream reframes the setup: pretrain a reusable action-conditioned world model on broad interaction data, use a frozen VLM as a zero-shot reward judge over imagined videos plus instructions, and adapt only the policy with a small amount of demonstrations followed by RL inside the frozen simulator.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new backbone but a cleaner decomposition of what should be pretrained once versus adapted per task. The world model is treated as a reusable physical prior rather than a task-bound simulator, and the reward is outsourced to a general VLM instead of a task-specific learned head. For pretraining-oriented readers, this matters because it shifts the scaling question from 'how much target-task data do I need to build a simulator' to 'how broad and transferable can my embodiment-level physical prior become.' It also gives a concrete pretrain-to-posttrain interface: prepare a task-agnostic simulator and reward mechanism once, then spend downstream data only on policy anchoring. That is a meaningful change in data allocation, not just a small algorithmic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three core pieces. First, a task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model. The implementation is built on WAN 2.1, but the important design choice is the training constraint: the world model is trained only on broad, target-task-independent interaction data such as play data or non-overlapping benchmark tasks. The goal is to learn transferable physical dynamics rather than task templates.

Second, zero-shot reward from a frozen VLM. Instead of training a reward model for each task, the method feeds imagined rollout videos and the language instruction into Qwen3-VL and asks for binary success judgments. This removes the need for task-specific reward supervision. The trade-off is clear: less reward shaping and less task specialization, in exchange for much better reuse across tasks.

Third, policy optimization inside the frozen world model. The policy backbone is OpenVLA-OFT. It is first lightly supervised with a few demonstrations to bind the policy to the new task semantics, then optimized with GRPO entirely in imagination. Because unseen-task rollouts from a generative world model can produce hallucinated successes, the paper adds a dual-noise verification mechanism: generate rollouts under different diffusion noise seeds from the same initial condition, and accept the reward only when the VLM judgment is consistent across them. This is a targeted defense against reward hacking induced by world-model hallucination. A success that appears only under one noise realization is treated as unreliable.

The novelty is therefore mostly in the system design and the constraints, not in inventing a new VLA, VLM, or video diffusion model. RAW-Dream turns existing components into a strictly task-agnostic post-training loop and adds the minimum extra machinery needed to make that loop stable on unseen tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers both simulation and real robots. In simulation, the world model is trained only on LIBERO-90 data, while four held-out suites—Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long—are used as downstream tasks that are completely unseen during world-model training. This is a stronger test than the usual low-data adaptation setting because the simulator has zero exposure to the target tasks. RAW-Dream improves over a 1-shot SFT baseline by +8.9% and outperforms online RL despite the latter using 50x more real-world data. That comparison is important: the method is not merely data-efficient at the cost of weak performance; it is competitive in a regime where real interaction is expensive.

On real robots, the world model is pretrained only on diverse, uncurated play data, again without target-task rollouts. Each new task starts from a 3-shot SFT policy and is then refined through imagined RL. The reported gain is +21.7% absolute success rate over the 3-shot SFT baseline. For robotic manipulation, that is a large enough margin to show that the imagined training signal is doing real work rather than producing simulator-only improvements.

The most important ablations appear to be: whether a task-agnostic world model can support unseen-task adaptation at all, whether zero-shot VLM reward is reliable enough to drive RL, and whether dual-noise verification reduces hallucinated success and false-positive reward hacking. Even without every table reproduced here, the paper’s empirical case depends on this combination rather than on a single headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem definition in the introduction. The phrase to keep in mind is 'target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in world models.' That is the real claim. Then read the method section with attention to the interfaces: how the imagined video is produced, how Qwen3-VL is prompted to score success, what is frozen versus trainable, and how GRPO consumes the filtered rewards. The dual-noise verification mechanism deserves close reading because it addresses a failure mode that is easy to miss if one only looks at average success rates.

In the experiments, focus on the exact train-test split for LIBERO and the real-robot setup using only play data for world-model pretraining. Those details determine whether the results truly demonstrate transferable physical priors or just hidden task overlap. If time is limited, read the pipeline figure, the main LIBERO table, the ablation on reward verification, and the real-robot results. If reading deeply, ask two questions: is the main bottleneck coverage of interaction data or fidelity of the generative world model, and is VLM-based reward merely noisy or systematically biased on imagined videos. Expect roughly 45–70 minutes for a careful pass, longer if you also inspect appendices and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表；若结果扎实，它会改变 VLA 后训练里“每任务重训 world/reward”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and main tables; if the results hold, it weakens the default of retraining world and reward models per VLA task.

paper.title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
paper.abstract: We evaluate an initial coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 in which the agent maintains an executable Python world model, verifies it against previous observations, refactors it toward simpler abstractions as a practical proxy for an MDL-like simplicity bias, and plans through the model before acting. The system is intentionally direct: it uses a scripted controller, predefined world-model interfaces, verifier programs, and a plan executor, but no hand-coded game-specific logic. We report results

summary.core_problem: 评估一个 coding-agent 系统能否通过可执行 Python 世界模型解决 ARC-AGI-3 游戏，而不是直接用对话式试错。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 评测和模型式规划系统原型。它把 coding agent、可执行环境模型、验证器和近似 MDL 的简洁性偏置结合起来，对研究 LLM 如何外化推理状态有参考，但不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 系统维护一个 executable Python world model，用历史观测验证模型，用重构把模型推向更简单抽象，作为最小描述长度偏置的工程近似；随后在该模型上规划行动。控制器是脚本化的，包含预定义 world-model interface、verifier programs 和 plan executor，但不写入具体游戏规则。
summary.experiments: 在 25 个公开 ARC-AGI-3 games 上评估。每次 playthrough 使用新的 agent 实例，不访问之前 playthrough 的文件或对话状态。系统完全解决 7 个 games，6 个 games 的 Relative Human Action Efficiency 超过 75%，平均每游戏 RHAE 为 32.58%。摘要未给出底层 LLM、采样预算和失败类型细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether a coding-agent system can solve ARC-AGI-3 games by maintaining an executable Python world model rather than relying on direct conversational trial and error.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent evaluation and a prototype for model-based planning with coding agents. It combines executable environment models, verifiers, and an engineering proxy for an MDL-like simplicity bias. It is relevant to externalized reasoning state, but it is not a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent maintains an executable Python world model, verifies it against previous observations, refactors it toward simpler abstractions, and plans through the model before acting. The system uses a scripted controller, predefined world-model interfaces, verifier programs, and a plan executor, without hand-coded game-specific logic.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. Each recorded playthrough uses a fresh agent instance without access to previous playthrough-specific files or conversation state. The system fully solves 7 games, reaches Relative Human Action Efficiency above 75% on 6 games, and obtains a mean per-game RHAE of 32.58%. The supplied abstract does not specify the underlying LLM, sampling budget, or failure taxonomy.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 setup 就够了；真正有用的是“可执行模型+验证器”接口，分数还不足以改写对 ARC 泛化的判断。
recommendation.en: Knowing the setup is enough; the useful piece is the executable-model-plus-verifier interface, while the results do not yet change the ARC generalization prior.

paper.title: What You Think is What You See: Driving Exploration in VLM Agents via Visual-Linguistic Curiosity
paper.abstract: To navigate partially observable visual environments, recent VLM agents increasingly internalize world modeling capabilities into their policies via explicit CoT reasoning, enabling them to mentally simulate futures before acting. However, relying solely on passive reasoning over visited states is insufficient for sparse-reward tasks, as it lacks the epistemic drive to actively uncover the ``known unknown'' required for robust generalization. We ask: Can VLM agents actively find signals that cha

summary.core_problem: 让 VLM Agent 在稀疏奖励、部分可观测视觉环境中主动探索，而不是只依赖已访问状态上的 CoT 推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 Agent 的探索机制；它对基座预训练没有直接方法贡献，但把语言世界模型和视觉表征之间的误差用于内在奖励，提供了一个可迁移到 embodied / GUI agent 的训练信号设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: GLANCE 将 Agent 的语言预测与 evolving target network 的稳定视觉表示对齐，用两者之间的 discrepancy 作为 curiosity signal；该信号进入强化学习训练，引导 Agent 探索那些能挑战或修正其语言世界模型的区域。方法更像是把视觉表征学习中的 target network 和 RL curiosity 迁移到 VLM Agent。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体环境、模型规模、baseline 和提升幅度；实验应评估 GLANCE 在部分可观测、稀疏奖励视觉任务中的探索效率、成功率和泛化能力，并与无 curiosity 或仅 CoT 推理的 VLM Agent 对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses active exploration for VLM agents in sparse-reward, partially observable visual environments, where passive CoT over visited states is insufficient.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an exploration signal for multimodal agents. It is not a pretraining paper, but the idea of using mismatch between linguistic world models and visual reality as intrinsic reward is relevant to embodied and GUI-agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: GLANCE grounds the agent’s linguistic world model in stable visual representations from an evolving target network. The discrepancy between the agent’s language-based prediction and the visual target representation is used as a curiosity signal inside reinforcement learning, pushing the agent toward observations that challenge its internal model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify environments, model scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected experiments compare exploration efficiency, task success, and generalization against VLM agents without curiosity or with passive CoT-only reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 想做 embodied agent 训练信号可看方法图；对预训练只提供弱信号，关键结果要等具体环境和 ablation。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance if you care about embodied-agent training signals; for pretraining it is a weak signal, and the real value depends on environment choice and ablations.

paper.title: Embody4D: A Generalist 4D World Model for Embodied AI
paper.abstract: World models have made significant progress in modeling dynamic environments; however, most embodied world models are still restricted to 2D representations, lacking the comprehensive multi-view information essential for embodied spatial reasoning. Bridging this gap is non-trivial, primarily due to challenges from severe scarcity of paired multi-view data, the difficulty of maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in generated 3D geometries, and the tendency to hallucinate manipulation details. To

summary.core_problem: 解决具身AI世界模型只建模2D动态画面、缺少多视角4D空间一致性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成世界模型和数据合成管线；对预训练研究的间接价值在于如何用合成数据和几何约束补齐稀缺的多视角交互数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Embody4D，一个面向具身场景的视频到视频世界模型，可从单目视频合成任意新视角。方法包括3D-aware compositional synthesis，用不同机械臂和背景组合构造异构数据；再用adaptive noise injection约束时空几何稳定，减少操作细节幻觉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline和具体指标；声称能在跨具身形态的机器人场景中提升泛化，并保持生成3D几何的时空一致性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化所、北京航空航天大学等机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of multi-view 4D spatial consistency in embodied world models that mostly operate in 2D video space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative embodied world model and synthetic data pipeline. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is how synthetic composition and geometric constraints are used when paired multi-view interaction data is scarce.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embody4D is a video-to-video world model that synthesizes arbitrary novel views from a monocular video. It uses a 3D-aware compositional synthesis pipeline to combine robotic arms and backgrounds, and an adaptive noise injection strategy to improve spatiotemporal geometry stability and reduce manipulation hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims improved cross-embodiment generalization and more stable 3D geometry in generated embodied scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Zhejiang University, University of Science and Technology of China, Institute of Automation CAS, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只扫数据合成和noise injection即可；它不是LLM预训练，但多视角稀缺数据的处理方式可作多模态预训练备忘。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and noise-injection parts only; not LLM pretraining, but useful as a note on scarce multi-view data.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
Institute of automation, Chinese academy of science

paper.title: Divide and Conquer: Decoupled Representation Alignment for Multimodal World Models
paper.abstract: Emerging multi-modal world models attempt to jointly generate videos across diverse modalities (e.g., RGB, depth, and mask), yet they fail to fully exploit the rich priors of existing foundation models. We propose $M^2$-REPA, the first representation alignment method tailored for multi-modal video generation. Our key insight is that foundation models trained on different modality spaces naturally capture distinct domain-specific priors, acting as complementary "experts." Specifically, we first d

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态世界模型在联合生成 RGB、深度、mask 等视频时，难以同时利用不同基础模型的模态专属先验、导致表示混叠和扩展性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态生成/世界模型方向的方法论文。虽然不属于 LLM 预训练主线，但“把不同模态 foundation model 当 expert，对中间表示做解耦对齐”的思路，对统一多模态预训练有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 M²-REPA，面向多模态视频生成的表示对齐方法。核心做法是先从 diffusion 模型中间表示中解耦出模态特异特征，再分别与对应模态的 expert foundation model 对齐；训练目标包括多模态表示对齐损失和模态特异解耦正则，以鼓励不同模态先验互补而非相互污染。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark。实验应是在多模态视频生成任务上，对比不使用 expert 对齐、只做联合生成、以及加入解耦对齐后的质量与跨模态一致性表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、华中科技大学等团队，工作更接近多模态生成与世界模型，而非语言模型预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of jointly generating RGB, depth, masks, and other modalities in multimodal world models while fully exploiting modality-specific priors from existing foundation models.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation/world-model paper rather than core LLM pretraining, but the idea of treating modality-specific foundation models as experts and aligning decoupled internal representations is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes M²-REPA, a representation alignment method for multimodal video generation. The method decouples modality-specific features from the diffusion model’s intermediate representations and aligns each part with its corresponding expert foundation model, using both a multimodal alignment loss and a modality-specific decoupling regularizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The evaluation likely compares plain joint multimodal generation against the proposed decoupled alignment, focusing on generation quality and cross-modal consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, and collaborators; the work sits closer to multimodal generation and world models than language-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 主线，但“中间表示先解耦、再按模态对 expert 对齐”这个 recipe 值得记；读方法图和 loss 设计就够了。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM-core paper, but the recipe—decouple intermediate features, then align each modality to its own expert—is worth stealing; the method figure and losses are enough.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
