paper.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
paper.abstract: World models, which are predictive representations of how environments evolve under actions, have become a central component of robot learning. They support policy learning, planning, simulation, evaluation, data generation, and have advanced rapidly with the rise of foundation models and large-scale video generation. However, the literature remains fragmented across architectures, functional roles, and embodied application domains. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive review of world

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理机器人学习中的 world model：环境如何在动作作用下演化，以及这些预测表征如何服务策略学习、规划、仿真、评估和数据生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和知识组织。它把机器人 world model、视频生成式世界模型、导航和自动驾驶中的相关工作放在一个框架里，对关注 embodied foundation model 的研究员有背景价值，但不是新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从机器人学习视角分类 world model：讨论 world model 与策略的耦合方式、作为 learned simulator 支持 RL 和评估的角色、机器人视频 world model 从 imagination-based generation 到可控、结构化和 foundation-scale formulation 的演进，并整理数据集、benchmark 和评测协议。
summary.experiments: 作为综述论文，没有新模型训练或统一实验结果。主要产出是文献分类、功能角色分析、代表性数据集和 benchmark 总结。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自南洋理工大学、UC Berkeley、Stanford、Microsoft 等机构；作者列表包括 Tatsuya Harada 和 Philip Torr 等知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes world models for robot learning: predictive representations of environment dynamics under actions and their use in policy learning, planning, simulation, evaluation, and data generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey and taxonomy contribution. It connects robot world models, video-generation-based world models, navigation, and autonomous driving under a shared framing. It is useful background for embodied foundation models but not a new training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reviews how world models are coupled with robot policies, how they act as learned simulators for reinforcement learning and evaluation, and how robotic video world models evolved from imagination-based generation to controllable, structured, and foundation-scale formulations. It also summarizes datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not train a new model or report unified empirical results. Its main output is a taxonomy, role analysis, and a catalog of representative datasets and benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes researchers from Nanyang Technological University, UC Berkeley, Stanford, and Microsoft, with well-known senior researchers such as Tatsuya Harada and Philip Torr.

recommendation.zh: 作为 embodied world model 索引可留存；预训练研究员读 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必逐节精读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an embodied world-model index; for pretraining work, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on static visual understanding, yet they still struggle with dynamic spatial reasoning that requires imagining how scenes evolve under egocentric motion. Recent efforts address this limitation either by scaling spatial supervision with synthetic data or by coupling VLMs with world models at inference time. However, the former often lacks explicit modeling of motion-conditioned state transitions, while the latter incurs substantial compu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的图文理解，而是 VLM 在“动态空间推理”上的短板：给定当前视角和一个自运动轨迹，模型往往不能稳定推断场景会如何变化，也不能从视角变化反推出相机动作。已有两条路各有明显问题：一条是继续堆静态空间数据和合成监督，但缺少显式的动作→状态转移建模；另一条是在推理时外挂 world model 做 imagination，但代价高，而且能力没有真正写进 VLM 参数里。World2VLM 的核心问题因此很明确：能不能把 world model 作为训练期教师，把“动作条件下的视角转移规律”蒸馏进 VLM 本身，让部署时仍然只用普通 VLM 推理。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在训练范式，而不在某个 benchmark 分数。它提出了一种很清楚的 teacher-student 路线：world model 不一定要作为在线推理模块存在，也可以作为离线数据与监督生成器，给 VLM 注入原本难以从静态图文对中学到的转移动力学先验。这个思路对原生多模态预训练和 post-train 接口都有启发：一是说明生成式环境模型可以作为高质量 supervision source，而不只是 inference-time tool；二是说明“空间 imagination”这类能力可以通过结构化任务设计和后训练强化被内化，而不是永远依赖外部系统。量级上，它更像一个有方法论价值的后训练框架，而不是改写 VLM 预训练主范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 transition construction。作者从锚点观测 s_t 出发，采样参数化的 egocentric action a_t，用可控 world model 生成动作后的未来视图 s_{t+1}^{WM}。文中强调 teacher 可以替换，实验里用了 Stable Virtual Camera 和 HY-WorldPlay 两类 world model，目的是验证监督信号并不强依赖某一个生成器。关键不只是生成新图，而是把“源视图—动作—目标视图”组织成几何一致、动作语义明确的转移样本。

第二部分是 bidirectional spatial supervision。作者没有只做单向的 action→future view 预测，而是同时构造 forward 和 inverse 两类任务。forward spatial reasoning 要求模型根据当前观测和动作，预测未来视角下的结果；inverse spatial reasoning 则要求模型根据前后视图恢复导致变化的动作。这个设计抓住了动态空间理解的两个面向：一是识别 latent transition，二是把 transition 向未来传播。相比只做 caption 或 QA，这种任务化监督更接近“状态转移建模”。

第三部分是两阶段 post-training。先做 SFT，让模型学会在结构化空间任务上输出稳定答案；再做 task-aware GRPO refinement，进一步优化结构化空间输出。这里的 GRPO 不是泛泛地加 RL，而是围绕空间任务的正确性信号做强化，使模型在离散动作、视角变化、结果描述上更稳。作者的立场很明确：SFT 负责把 teacher signal 写进模型，GRPO 负责 sharpen 决策边界和输出格式。

从方法取舍看，这篇工作刻意避开了 test-time coupling。原因不是 world model 没用，而是在线耦合会把推理成本、系统复杂度和误差传播都带进部署阶段。World2VLM 选择把 world model 的价值前移到训练期，用一次性蒸馏换部署时的简单性。这一点对多模态基座训练很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 SAT-Real、SAT-Synthesized、VSI-Bench、MindCube 四个带明显动态或视角变化属性的 benchmark。论文主结论是：相对 base Qwen2.5-VL，World2VLM 在四个数据集上都有一致提升；在 SFT 之上再加 GRPO，还能继续提升。作者还把它和一种 MindJourney 风格的 test-time world-model-coupled baseline 做比较，结果显示离线蒸馏后的单体 VLM 不仅部署更轻，而且效果更稳。

从全文可确认的实验重点有三类。第一类是 teacher ablation：使用不同 world model 作为教师，验证 gains 不是某个生成器偶然带来的。第二类是 training recipe ablation：比较 base model、SFT-only、SFT→GRPO，说明两阶段训练各自贡献。第三类是 benchmark/category analysis：在 SAT-Real 上做细粒度类别分析，提升主要集中在 egocentric movement、action consequence、perspective taking 这些真正依赖动态空间想象的子项，而不是静态识别项。这一点很关键，因为它说明模型不是单纯靠更强视觉识别拿分。

需要说明的是，给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数字，因此无法可靠抄出每个 benchmark 的精确分数、样本规模和训练 token 量。能确定的硬信息包括：学生模型基座是 Qwen2.5-VL；训练包含 SFT 和 GRPO 两阶段；教师 world model 至少包含 Stable Virtual Camera 与 HY-WorldPlay；作者声称相对先前方法 proving-style 的 test-time coupling 更有效且更省部署开销。若做精读，建议直接核对主结果表、teacher ablation 表和 SAT-Real 分类结果图，把每个数据集上的绝对提升幅度补齐。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题设定—监督构造—训练配方—误差归因”来读。

先看 Introduction，重点不是任务背景，而是作者为什么否定两条常见路线：纯数据扩充缺少动作条件转移，test-time coupling 成本高。这个判断决定了整篇方法设计。

然后看 Method 里的 Figure 2 和 transition construction 部分。这里是全文最重要的地方：样本是怎么从 anchor observation、camera trajectory 和 world model generation 变成可训练的结构化 supervision 的。如果这一段设计不严，后面的提升就可能只是数据增强而不是“蒸馏空间 imagination”。

接着看 bidirectional task suite。要特别注意 forward / inverse 两类任务的定义、输入输出格式、是否共享模板、是否有动作离散化或文本化编码。这些细节决定模型学到的是空间规律，还是只是在做模板匹配。

再看 SFT→GRPO 的 reward 设计与训练细节。这里值得深挖的问题有两个：一是 GRPO 奖励是否真正对齐空间正确性，还是主要奖励格式与关键词；二是 RL 阶段是否带来分布偏移，尤其在真实图像 benchmark 上是否比合成集更敏感。

实验部分建议优先看四类内容：主表、teacher 替换实验、SFT vs GRPO 消融、SAT-Real 细粒度类别分析。阅读时间大约 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要判断它对原生多模态预训练是否有迁移价值，需要再花时间看附录里的数据构造和 prompt 模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of current VLMs: dynamic spatial reasoning under egocentric motion. Standard VLMs can describe a static scene, but they often fail when asked to infer how the scene changes after a camera movement, or to recover the motion that caused a viewpoint change. Prior work mainly follows two routes: scaling synthetic spatial supervision, which still lacks explicit action-conditioned transition modeling, or coupling a VLM with a world model at inference time, which improves reasoning but adds substantial runtime cost and leaves the VLM itself unchanged. The central question here is whether a world model can act as a training-time teacher so that motion-conditioned spatial imagination is internalized into the VLM parameters.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than benchmark-centric. The paper shows a clean teacher-student recipe where a generative world model is used offline to create structured supervision for a VLM. That matters for multimodal pretraining and the pretrain/post-train interface: world models do not have to remain external inference modules; they can become supervision generators that inject transition dynamics priors into a foundation model. The contribution is not a new pretraining objective in the narrow sense, but a practical post-training framework for transferring action-conditioned spatial structure into a deployed VLM without requiring test-time world-model calls.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, transition construction. Starting from an anchor observation s_t, the framework samples a parameterized egocentric action a_t and uses a controllable world model to synthesize a future view s_{t+1}^{WM}. The teacher is intentionally modular; the experiments instantiate it with Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay to test whether the supervision depends on a specific generator. The key point is not image generation alone, but the creation of geometrically aligned source-action-target triples with explicit motion semantics.

Second, bidirectional spatial supervision. Instead of training only on forward prediction, the paper builds both forward and inverse tasks. Forward spatial reasoning asks the model to infer the consequence of an action given the current observation. Inverse spatial reasoning asks it to recover the action from the before/after views. This is a sensible design choice: dynamic spatial competence requires both identifying the latent transition and propagating it to unseen future states. Compared with generic VQA-style supervision, this is much closer to learning state transitions.

Third, a two-stage post-training recipe. The model is first trained with SFT on the structured spatial tasks, then refined with task-aware GRPO. The role split is clear: SFT transfers the teacher signal into the model, while GRPO sharpens structured outputs and decision boundaries for action-conditioned reasoning. The paper does not present RL as a generic add-on; it is used to improve correctness on spatially grounded outputs.

A notable design choice is the deliberate avoidance of test-time coupling. The authors are not arguing that world models are unnecessary; rather, they move the world-model benefit into training so deployment remains a standard single-model VLM inference pipeline. That trade-off is important for scalable multimodal systems.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers SAT-Real, SAT-Synthesized, VSI-Bench, and MindCube, all of which contain substantial viewpoint-conditioned or dynamic spatial reasoning components. The main empirical claim is consistent improvement over the base Qwen2.5-VL model on all four benchmarks. The GRPO stage further improves over the SFT checkpoint. The paper also compares against a MindJourney-style test-time world-model-coupled baseline and reports that the distilled standalone VLM is both more effective and cheaper at deployment.

The most informative experimental axes are threefold. First, teacher ablations: different world models are used as teachers, suggesting the gains are not tied to one specific generator. Second, training-recipe ablations: base model vs SFT-only vs SFT→GRPO, which isolates the contribution of each stage. Third, fine-grained category analysis on SAT-Real: the gains are concentrated on egocentric movement, action consequence, and perspective taking, which supports the claim that the method improves motion-conditioned reasoning rather than static recognition.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it is not safe to fabricate exact benchmark scores, sample counts, or training-scale numbers. What can be stated reliably is that the student backbone is Qwen2.5-VL, the training recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, and the teacher side includes at least Stable Virtual Camera and HY-WorldPlay. For a careful read, the main result table, teacher ablation table, and SAT-Real category breakdown are the places to extract the exact absolute gains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of problem framing, supervision construction, training recipe, and error attribution.

Start with the introduction, especially the argument against the two common alternatives: static data scaling without explicit transition modeling, and inference-time world-model coupling with high runtime overhead. That framing explains why the method is built the way it is.

Then move to Figure 2 and the transition-construction section. This is the core of the paper. The important question is how anchor observations, camera trajectories, and world-model generations are turned into structured supervision rather than mere data augmentation.

Next, inspect the bidirectional task suite. Pay attention to the exact definitions of forward and inverse tasks, the input/output format, and whether actions are discretized or textualized. These details determine whether the model is learning spatial regularities or just matching templates.

After that, read the SFT→GRPO section carefully. Two questions matter: whether the GRPO reward truly reflects spatial correctness rather than formatting, and whether the RL stage introduces distribution shift, especially between synthetic and real-image benchmarks.

In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, teacher replacement ablations, SFT vs GRPO ablations, and the fine-grained SAT-Real analysis. Around 30–45 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If the goal is to assess transferability to native multimodal pretraining, spend extra time on the appendix sections covering data construction and prompting templates.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把 world model 当教师而不是外挂模块”这个接口设计；先读训练 recipe 和对比 test-time coupling 的表，别把它误当成预训练突破。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is the interface: treat the world model as a teacher rather than a runtime plug-in; read the training recipe and the comparison against test-time coupling, but don’t mistake it for a pretraining breakthrough.

paper.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
paper.abstract: Autonomous agents capable of navigating Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) hold the potential to revolutionize digital productivity. However, achieving true digital autonomy extends beyond reactive element matching; it necessitates a predictive mental model of interface dynamics and the ability to foresee the "digital world state" resulting from interactions. Despite the perceptual capabilities of modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), existing benchmarks remain bifurcated (focusing either on black

summary.core_problem: 现有 GUI agent 评测要么只看任务完成率，要么只看静态元素 grounding，无法衡量模型是否真正理解界面功能和交互后的状态转移。
summary.importance: 这是一个 benchmark 工作，价值在于把 GUI agent 的评测从“看见按钮”推进到“理解功能与后果预测”。对通用 agent 研究有意义，也能给多模态世界模型评测提供更细粒度信号，但对预训练本身仍是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoGUI-v2，多模态 GUI 功能理解 benchmark。核心构建流程是 VLM-human 协同解析多平台截图，递归生成层次化功能区域与交互结果标注，从而评测功能理解、状态变化预测等更深层能力，而不只做元素定位或黑盒任务成功率统计。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出样本规模与具体参评模型。实验应覆盖多个主流 VLM/GUI agent，在功能理解、交互结果预测、静态 grounding 与端到端任务完成之间做区分，证明现有模型在“会点”与“真懂”之间仍有明显落差。作为 benchmark，关键要看标注质量、任务分布和与真实 agent failure 的相关性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、香港科技创新研究院（CASIA 体系）和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing GUI-agent benchmarks either focus on end-task success or shallow static grounding, and fail to test whether models understand interface functionality and state transitions.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark contribution that pushes GUI-agent evaluation from element matching toward functional understanding and outcome prediction. It matters for general agent research and multimodal world-model evaluation, though its relevance to pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces AutoGUI-v2, a multimodal benchmark for GUI functionality understanding. It uses a VLM-human collaborative pipeline to recursively parse screenshots from multiple platforms into hierarchical functional regions and interaction-outcome annotations, enabling evaluation of deeper capabilities beyond static grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size or the exact evaluated models. The experiments likely compare major VLMs/GUI agents on functionality understanding, interaction outcome prediction, static grounding, and end-to-end task completion, showing a gap between clicking competence and true interface understanding. For a benchmark, annotation quality and correlation with real agent failures are the main things to inspect.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from CASIA-related institutions and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 native multimodal agent，这篇的价值在评测拆得更细；读任务定义和误差分解就够，别把它当方法论文。
recommendation.en: If you care about native multimodal agents, the value is in the finer-grained evaluation; read the task taxonomy and error breakdown, not as a methods paper.

paper.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
paper.abstract: We introduce HY-World 2.0, a multi-modal world model framework that advances our prior project HY-World 1.0. HY-World 2.0 accommodates diverse input modalities, including text prompts, single-view images, multi-view images, and videos, and produces 3D world representations. With text or single-view image inputs, the model performs world generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, navigable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. This is achieved through a four-stage method: a) Panorama Generation with

summary.core_problem: 从文本/单视/多视/视频等多模态输入生成可导航的 3DGS 场景表示。
summary.importance: 腾讯 HY-World 系列的 2.0 迭代，四阶段 pipeline 的工程集成，对 3D 世界模型方向是参考但非范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 四阶段：HY-Pano 2.0 全景生成→WorldNav 轨迹规划→WorldStereo 2.0 关键帧视图扩展→WorldMirror 2.0 前馈 3D 预测与场景合成。
summary.experiments: 技术报告形式，强调全景保真度、场景理解和多视一致性提升；具体数字需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯 HY-World 团队（推测），延续 1.0 版本。

summary_en.core_problem: Generate navigable 3DGS worlds from text/image/multi-view/video inputs.
summary_en.importance: Engineering iteration of HY-World; reference point for 3D world model pipelines, not a paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: Four-stage pipeline: HY-Pano 2.0 panorama → WorldNav trajectory planning → WorldStereo 2.0 keyframe view expansion → WorldMirror 2.0 feed-forward 3D composition.
summary_en.experiments: Technical report; claims improved panorama fidelity and cross-view consistency.
summary_en.authors_note: Likely Tencent HY-World team, follow-up to 1.0.

recommendation.zh: 3D 世界模型工程整合，pretrain 研究员基本无关；想了解多模态世界模型 pipeline 可扫一眼架构图。
recommendation.en: Engineering integration for 3D world models; largely orthogonal to pretrain research—glance at the pipeline figure if curious.

paper.title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language World Models
paper.abstract: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language World Models (LWMs) that simulate domai

summary.core_problem: 现有 Agent benchmark 只覆盖少数有公共环境的领域，无法评测 Agent 在广泛专业职业场景的能力。
summary.importance: 用 LLM 驱动的 Language World Model 模拟工具响应，把 benchmark 可覆盖的职业数量从几个扩展到 100 个，是一种扩展 Agent 评测覆盖面的工程尝试。
summary.technical_approach: Language World Model (LWM) 作为环境模拟器生成工具响应；multi-agent 合成 pipeline 产出可解性、难度校准、文档锚定的评测实例；沿完成率和容错性两个维度评估。
summary.experiments: 100 个职业场景、10 大类、65 个专业领域，评测 15 个前沿模型；具体模型排名见正文。
summary.authors_note: 阿里/Qwen 团队相关人员参与（Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks only cover the few professional domains with public environments, leaving most real-world occupational tasks unevaluated.
summary_en.importance: Uses LLM-driven Language World Models to simulate tool responses, dramatically expanding benchmark coverage; a scaling attempt for agent evaluation breadth rather than a methods contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: LWMs simulate domain tool responses; a multi-agent synthesis pipeline generates solvable, difficulty-calibrated, document-grounded tasks; evaluation includes fault injection for environmental robustness.
summary_en.experiments: 100 scenarios across 10 categories and 65 domains; 15 frontier models evaluated on completion and robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Qwen-related authors (Dayiheng Liu, Fei Huang).

recommendation.zh: 用 LLM 模拟环境做 Agent benchmark 本身就有评测可信度问题——simulator 和被测模型能力相关会污染信号，作为 literature 备查，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Benchmark validity is inherently suspect when the simulator is an LLM correlated with the models under test; keep as literature reference, skip the main text.

This generative reconstruction approach combines the visual fidelity and creative capacity of video models with 3D outputs ready for real-time rendering and simulation. Scaling to large, complex environments requires 3D-consistent video generation over long camera trajectories wit

summary.importance: 针对 long-horizon 3D 生成的两个明确失效模式做系统分析和方法改进，NVIDIA 系工作，视频→3D 生成范式的延续
summary.technical_approach: 在 Lyra 基础上扩展：长相机轨迹下的 3D-consistent video generation，前馈重建做 lifting。细节需要看正文，abstract 未明说具体机制
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中给出具体数字和 baseline
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 团队（Zan Gojcic, Nicholas Sharp, Ruilong Li 等），3D 生成与 neural rendering 领域核心力量

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon video-to-3D scene generation suffers from spatial forgetting (hallucinated revisits) and temporal drifting (autoregressive error accumulation)
summary_en.importance: Systematic treatment of two well-defined failure modes in long-horizon 3D generation; continuation of the video→3D lifting paradigm from NVIDIA
summary_en.technical_approach: Extends Lyra for 3D-consistent video generation over long camera trajectories with feed-forward reconstruction; abstract does not detail the mechanism
summary_en.experiments: No concrete numbers or baselines in abstract
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA team (Zan Gojcic, Nicholas Sharp, Ruilong Li), core contributors to 3D generation and neural rendering

recommendation.zh: 3D 生成方向工作，对 LLM pretrain 基本无关；做世界模型或 video generation 的可以扫下失效模式分析，其他人作 literature 备查
recommendation.en: 3D generation work with little bearing on LLM pretrain; if you work on world models or video gen, skim the failure-mode analysis, else use as literature reference

paper.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

summary.core_problem: 交互式视频生成作为world model时，难以同时实现长时一致性（带记忆）与高分辨率实时生成，限制真实交互场景落地。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为系统/工程突破与数据-模型-推理一体化：面向720p实时长视频交互生成，强调长程记忆一致性与实时性兼得；对“生成式world model”方向有参考价值，但更偏工程系统与数据管线。
summary.technical_approach: 在Matrix-Game 2.0基础上升级：构建工业级“无限数据引擎”（UE合成+AAA游戏自动采集+真实视频增强）形成Video-Pose-Action-Prompt四元组；提出长时一致性训练框架（通过残差建模并将不完美预测再注入训练以增强长期一致性）；并在推理侧做实时/流式生成优化（摘要未给出关键算法细节）。
summary.experiments: 目标为720p实时长视频生成与交互；对比既有方法在长时一致性与实时性上的不足并展示改进（摘要未给出模型规模、训练量、定量指标与对比表）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build an interactive video-generation world model that can generate high-resolution video in real time while maintaining long-horizon temporal consistency via memory.
summary_en.importance: Represents an integrated system-level advance (data, training, inference) targeting 720p real-time, long-duration interactive generation, addressing a key bottleneck for deploying generative world models in practical interactive environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Upgrades Matrix-Game 2.0 with an ‘infinite’ data engine combining Unreal Engine synthesis, automated AAA-game capture, and real-video enhancement to produce Video–Pose–Action–Prompt tuples; proposes a long-term consistency training scheme using residual modeling and reinjecting imperfect predictions during training to strengthen long-horizon stability; and applies inference optimizations for real-time/streaming generation (details not specified in the abstract).
summary_en.experiments: Targets 720p real-time long-video interactive generation and qualitatively contrasts improved real-time performance and long-term consistency against prior methods; the abstract does not report model scale, training volume, quantitative metrics, or full baselines.

recommendation.zh: 更偏系统demo：实时720p交互+长程记忆很吸睛，但可复现门槛和数据/工程耦合高；作为world-model工程标杆知道结论即可。
recommendation.en: Primarily a systems demo: real-time 720p interactive generation with long-horizon memory is flashy, but reproducibility is gated by data/engineering; know the headline results, don’t deep-read.
